# ---- config -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _box(v):
    try:
        b = [float(x) for x in v]
        return b if len(b) == 4 and all(math.isfinite(x) for x in b) and b[2] > 0 and b[3] > 0 else None
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None


def _widget(raw):
    """Clean widget entry (extras kept) or None."""
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        return None
    t = raw.get("type")
    t = t.strip().lower() if isinstance(t, str) else ""
    if not t:
        return None
    out = copy.deepcopy(raw)
    sl = raw.get("slot")
    out.update({"type": t, "slot": sl.strip().lower() if isinstance(sl, str) else "", "box": _box(raw.get("box")), "on": _bool(raw.get("on"), True)})
    return out


def _pt(p):
    """[x, y] numbers | 'slot' token -> kept; else None."""
    if isinstance(p, str):
        return p.strip().lower() or None
    try:
        x, y = float(p[0]), float(p[1])
        return [x, y] if len(p) == 2 and math.isfinite(x) and math.isfinite(y) else None
    except (TypeError, ValueError, IndexError):
        return None


def _lines(raw):
    """None -> None (= use the preset's); list -> clean lines (>= 2 points each); anything else -> None."""
    if not isinstance(raw, (list, tuple)):
        return None
    out = []
    for r in raw:
        if not isinstance(r, dict) or not isinstance(r.get("points"), (list, tuple)):
            continue
        ln = copy.deepcopy(_LINE)
        ln["points"] = [p for p in (_pt(q) for q in r["points"]) if p is not None][:12]
        c = r.get("color")
        ln["color"] = c if isinstance(c, str) and c.strip() else ln["color"]
        ed = r.get("end_dot")
        ln["end_dot"] = ed if ed in (True, False, "both", "start") else True
        ln["width"], ln["glow"] = _flt(r.get("width"), 0.5, 30, 2.5), _flt(r.get("glow"), 0, 60, 9.0)
        if len(ln["points"]) >= 2:
            out.append(ln)
    return out


def _scene(raw):
    out = copy.deepcopy(T4_SCENE)
    out.update({k: copy.deepcopy(v) for k, v in raw.items() if k not in out})                     # extras survive
    p = raw.get("preset")
    out["preset"] = p.strip().lower() if isinstance(p, str) and p.strip() else DEFAULT_PRESET
    ws = raw.get("widgets")
    ws = [ws] if isinstance(ws, dict) else ws if isinstance(ws, (list, tuple)) else []
    out["widgets"] = [w for w in (_widget(x) for x in ws) if w is not None]
    if "widgets" not in raw and out["preset"] in DEFAULT_WIDGETS:         # a scene that only names the preset = the ready default scene
        out["widgets"] = [w for w in (_widget(x) for x in copy.deepcopy(DEFAULT_WIDGETS[out["preset"]])) if w is not None]
    trig = raw.get("trigger")
    out["trigger"] = trig.strip() if isinstance(trig, str) else ""
    out["start"] = raw["start"] if raw.get("start") is not None else (None if out["trigger"] else 0.0)
    out["end"], out["hold"] = raw.get("end"), raw.get("hold")
    a = raw.get("anim")
    a = ("reveal" if a.strip().lower() == "typewriter" else a.strip().lower()) if isinstance(a, str) else "fade"
    out["anim"] = a if a in ANIMS or a in ("pop", "none") else "fade"
    out["anim_dur"], out["stagger"] = _flt(raw.get("anim_dur"), 0.0, 5.0, 0.45), _flt(raw.get("stagger"), 0.0, 3.0, 0.2)
    out["connectors"] = _lines(raw.get("connectors"))
    out["on"] = _bool(raw.get("on"), True)
    return out


def t4_scenes_cfg(raw):
    """Normalise cfg['t4']['scenes'] -> list of complete scenes. Accepts a list, one scene dict (has 'widgets') or {on, scenes: [...]}
    (the module default {'on': False} = no scenes). Never raises; junk entries are dropped."""
    try:
        if isinstance(raw, dict) and "widgets" in raw:
            raw = [raw]
        elif isinstance(raw, dict):
            raw = raw.get("scenes") if _bool(raw.get("on"), False) else []
        return [_scene(x) for x in raw if isinstance(x, dict)] if isinstance(raw, (list, tuple)) else []
    except Exception:
        return []


# ---- placement ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _aspect(W, H):
    return "portrait" if H > W else "landscape"


def _shift(a, b, lo, hi):
    """Move needed so [a, b] lies inside [lo, hi] (0 when it does, or when it is larger than the room)."""
    if b - a > hi - lo:
        return 0
    return int(math.ceil(lo - a)) if a < lo else int(math.floor(hi - b)) if b > hi else 0


def _put(sprite, box, W, H, s):
    """Sprite whose origin (info['origin']) = the box's top-left -> (cx, cy of the Item, ink rect on the canvas, moved px) | None (empty sprite)."""
    ink = sprite.info.get("ink") or _ink_box(sprite)    
    if ink is None:
        return None
    ox, oy = sprite.info.get("origin", (0, 0))
    x0, y0, m = int(round(box[0])) - ox, int(round(box[1])) - oy, T4_SAFE * s
    dx = _shift(x0 + ink[0], x0 + ink[2], m, W - m)
    dy = _shift(y0 + ink[1], y0 + ink[3], m, H - m)
    x0, y0 = x0 + dx, y0 + dy
    return x0 + sprite.width / 2.0, y0 + sprite.height / 2.0, (x0 + ink[0], y0 + ink[1], x0 + ink[2], y0 + ink[3]), abs(dx) + abs(dy)


def _warn_overlaps(placed):
    for i, (a, ra) in enumerate(placed):
        for b, rb in placed[i + 1:]:
            if ra[0] < rb[2] and rb[0] < ra[2] and ra[1] < rb[3] and rb[1] < ra[3]:
                t4_warn("%s and %s overlap - give one of them another slot / box." % (a, b))


def _widget_items(cfg, scene, label, win, ctx, slots, rects, placed):
    """One staggered Item per widget; fills rects[slot or 'wN'] with the placed ink rect. -> (items, start of the last item)."""
    W, H, s = ctx["W"], ctx["H"], ctx["s"]
    ready = []
    for i, w in enumerate(scene["widgets"]):
        if not w["on"]:
            continue
        fn, slot = get_widget(w["type"]), (w["slot"] or WIDGET_SLOT.get(w["type"], ""))
        if fn is None:
            t4_warn("%s: unknown widget type '%s' - skipped (known: %s)." % (label, w["type"], ", ".join(sorted(WIDGETS)) or "none"))
            continue
        box = w["box"] or slots.get(slot)
        if box is None:
            t4_warn("%s: widget '%s' has no slot '%s' in preset '%s' (%s) and no box - skipped." % (label, w["type"], slot, ctx["preset"], ctx["aspect"]))
            continue
        box = tuple(float(v) * s for v in box)
        try:
            sp = fn(dict(w), box, ctx)
            pl = _put(sp, box, W, H, s) if sp is not None else None
        except Exception as e:
            t4_warn("%s: widget '%s' could not be drawn (%s: %s) - skipped." % (label, w["type"], type(e).__name__, e))
            continue
        if pl is None:
            continue
        key = slot if slot and slot not in rects else "w%d" % (i + 1)
        rects[key] = pl[2]
        placed.append(("%s widget '%s'" % (label, key), pl[2]))
        ready.append((sp, pl))
    steps, last = t4_stagger(len(ready), scene["stagger"]), max(win[0], win[1] - 0.1)
    items = [_make_item(sp, min(win[0] + d, last), win[1], pl[0], pl[1], scene) for (sp, pl), d in zip(ready, steps) if not sp.info.get("lines_only")]    
    for (sp, pl), d in zip(ready, steps):                                   # typewriter widgets: one 'reveal' Item per code line
        items += t4_widget_line_items(sp, pl[0], pl[1], min(win[0] + d, last), win[1], 0.0 if sp.info.get("lines_only") else scene["anim_dur"])
    return items, (min(win[0] + steps[-1], last) if steps else win[0])


# ---- connectors --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _resolve(p, rects, s):
    """[x, y] px | 'slot' | 'slot-side' -> canvas point, or None when that slot has no widget."""
    if not isinstance(p, str):
        return float(p[0]) * s, float(p[1]) * s
    name, side = p, "center"
    head, _, tail = p.rpartition("-")
    if head and tail in _SIDES:
        name, side = head, tail
    r = rects.get(name)
    if r is None:
        return None
    cx, cy = (r[0] + r[2]) / 2.0, (r[1] + r[3]) / 2.0
    return {"left": (r[0], cy), "right": (r[2], cy), "top": (cx, r[1]), "bottom": (cx, r[3])}.get(side, (cx, cy))


def _connector_items(scene, ctx, rects, t0, end):
    lines = scene["connectors"] if scene["connectors"] is not None else _lines(CONNECTORS.get(ctx["preset"], {}).get(ctx["aspect"], [])) or []
    W, H, s, out = ctx["W"], ctx["H"], ctx["s"], []
    for ln in lines:
        pts = [_resolve(p, rects, s) for p in ln["points"]]
        if any(p is None for p in pts):
            continue                                                       # a slot it needs holds no widget: no line
        m = (T4_SAFE + ln["glow"] * 1.6 + 2) * s
        pts = [(min(max(x, m), W - m), min(max(y, m), H - m)) for x, y in pts]
        sp = connector(pts, ln["color"], ln["end_dot"], ln["width"] * s, ln["glow"] * s)
        ox, oy = sp.info["origin"]
        out.append(Item(sp, min(t0 + scene["anim_dur"], max(t0, end - 0.1)), end, -ox + sp.width / 2.0, -oy + sp.height / 2.0, "fade", scene["anim_dur"], out=True))
    return out


def t4_scenes_items(cfg, duration):
    """Items of every scene: one per widget (staggered), then the preset's connectors; all fade out together. Never raises."""
    t4 = cfg.get("t4") if isinstance(cfg, dict) and isinstance(cfg.get("t4"), dict) else {}
    scenes = [sc for sc in t4_scenes_cfg(t4.get("scenes")) if sc["on"]]
    if not scenes:
        return []
    try:
        W, H = int(cfg["canvas"][0]), int(cfg["canvas"][1])
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, IndexError):
        t4_warn("t4 scenes: the job has no canvas - skipped.")
        return []
    items, placed = [], []
    for i, sc in enumerate(scenes):
        label = "scene %d" % (i + 1)
        try:
            items += _one_scene(cfg, sc, label, duration, W, H, placed)
        except Exception as e:
            t4_warn("t4 %s: could not be drawn (%s: %s) - skipped." % (label, type(e).__name__, e))
    _warn_overlaps(placed)
    return items


def _one_scene(cfg, sc, label, duration, W, H, placed):
    if not sc["widgets"]:
        t4_warn("%s: no widgets - skipped." % label)
        return []
    win = _window(cfg, sc, label, duration, 6.0)
    if win is None:
        return []
    preset = sc["preset"]
    if preset not in SLOTS:
        t4_warn("%s: unknown preset '%s' - using '%s' (known: %s)." % (label, preset, DEFAULT_PRESET, ", ".join(sorted(SLOTS))))
        preset = DEFAULT_PRESET
    ctx = {"W": W, "H": H, "s": min(W, H) / 1080.0, "aspect": _aspect(W, H), "preset": preset, "cfg": cfg}
    rects = {}
    items, t_last = _widget_items(cfg, sc, label, win, ctx, SLOTS[preset][ctx["aspect"]], rects, placed)
    return items + (_connector_items(sc, ctx, rects, t_last, win[1]) if items else [])


# ---- questions --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def t4_ask_scenes():
    """Question group 'scenes' (called by t4_ask_config). -> a list with ONE scene, or {'on': False}. More scenes: edit the job file."""
    if not yn("Add an infographic scene (title block + more widgets in later tasks - reference R5 / R6)?", default=False):
        return {"on": False}
    names = sorted(SLOTS)                     # 'tech_overview' sorts first = the Enter default; put web_dev first by hand if you prefer
    p = ask_choice("Scene layout", [PRESET_LABEL.get(n, n) for n in names], default=1, key="t4_scene_preset")
    preset, widgets = names[p - 1], []
    if preset in DEFAULT_WIDGETS and yn("Use the ready default scene (all widgets, placeholder texts)?", default=True):
        widgets = copy.deepcopy(DEFAULT_WIDGETS[preset])
    else:
        for name in WIDGETS:
            if name in WIDGET_ASK and yn("Add the '%s' widget?" % name, default=True):
                widgets.append(dict(WIDGET_ASK[name](), type=name, slot=WIDGET_SLOT.get(name, "")))
    sc = {"preset": preset, "widgets": widgets}
    sc.update(t4_ask_when("Scene", 6.0, key="t4_scene_when"))
    sc["anim"] = ask_anim("Scene animation (widgets appear one after another)", default="fade", key="t4_scene_anim")
    return [sc]

====================================================================================================
FILE: mt\templates\t4\scenes_reg.py
====================================================================================================
"""mt.templates.t4.scenes_reg - Template 4 'scenes': the widget registry (no drawing, no scene logic).
A widget is a function  fn(spec, box, ctx) -> RGBA sprite | None  where
    spec  the widget's dict from the scene (type, slot, box, + the widget's own keys)
    box   (x, y, w, h) in canvas px = the slot (already scaled: slots are authored at short side 1080)
    ctx   {'W', 'H', 's' (short side / 1080), 'aspect' 'portrait'|'landscape', 'preset', 'cfg'}
The sprite must carry sprite.info['origin'] = (ox, oy): where the BOX's top-left sits inside the sprite (glow margin = origin > 0).
The engine (scenes.py) puts that point on the box's top-left, keeps the visible ink inside the 48 px safe area and builds the Item.
Public: WIDGETS, WIDGET_ASK, WIDGET_SLOT, register_widget(name, fn, ask=None, slot=None), get_widget(name).
  ask  = optional question function () -> dict of widget keys (used by t4_ask_scenes); slot = the widget's default slot name."""
from mt.templates.t4.warn import t4_warn

WIDGETS = {}        # name -> fn
WIDGET_ASK = {}     # name -> ask()
WIDGET_SLOT = {}    # name -> default slot name


def register_widget(name, fn, ask=None, slot=None):
    """Add (or replace) a widget type. -> True, or False (one t4_warn) for an empty name / non-callable. Never raises."""
    key = name.strip().lower() if isinstance(name, str) else ""
    if not key or not callable(fn):
        t4_warn("scenes: register_widget(%r) needs a name and a callable - ignored." % (name,))
        return False
    WIDGETS[key] = fn
    for table, v in ((WIDGET_ASK, ask if callable(ask) else None), (WIDGET_SLOT, slot.strip().lower() if isinstance(slot, str) and slot.strip() else None)):
        if v is None:
            table.pop(key, None)
        else:
            table[key] = v
    return True


def get_widget(name):
    """-> the widget function, or None (unknown type / not a string)."""
    return WIDGETS.get(name.strip().lower()) if isinstance(name, str) else None

====================================================================================================
FILE: mt\templates\t4\cards_video.py
====================================================================================================
"""mt.templates.t4.cards_video - Template 4: VIDEO cards (refs R2 right card, R8 PiP card) - the baking half of the 'cards' module.
A card whose media is a clip file or a segment of the original video ('original' + seg_start / seg_end, see cards.py) is drawn in two layers:
  - the PICTURE = a muted clip cut by the card's chamfer mask, baked here into a small alpha video (qtrle) and overlaid by FFmpeg as a video
    layer (area 'canvas', key '_xy'), i.e. above the foreground plate, exactly like the T3 floating video cards;
  - the neon border + accent dashes + label tag = the ordinary card sprite (cards_art, with_picture=False), an Item over the clip.
Both use the same sprite size, centre and Item animation (t4_pop / chosen anim), so border and picture pop in and fade out together.
Memory: FFmpeg decodes the source straight at the picture's pixel size (-ss / -t / fps / scale / crop / rgb24 on a pipe = the pre-scaled proxy of
prepare_video_layers), so only one small frame is held at a time; nothing is written but the final alpha clip. The clip is muted (-an).
Source rules: 'original' starts at seg_start (default = the card's start time); a clip file loops when it has no seg_end and starts at 0, otherwise
it plays once; when the source ends before the card does, the last frame is held. Missing source / bake failure -> one t4_warn, that card has no picture.
Public: t4_prepare_card_layers(cfg, info, tmpdir) = the registry hook prepare_layers for id 5 (render.py calls it for template ids 2, 3, 5)."""
import math
import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image

from mt.anim import anim_state
from mt.common import FFMPEG, _read_exact
from mt.draw import draw_item
from mt.templates.t4.cards import _make_item, t4_card_plans
from mt.templates.t4.cards_art import t4_card_mask
from mt.templates.t4.warn import t4_warn

SAMPLES = 40                    # anim_state samples per direction when measuring how far the animated card reaches
MARGIN = 6                      # px around that reach
GRAY = b"\x5c"                  # filler byte when the source gives no frame at all


def _anim_name(c):
    return "t4_pop" if c["anim"] in ("auto", "pop") else c["anim"]


def _even(a0, a1, limit):
    if (a1 - a0) % 2:
        if a1 < limit:
            a1 += 1
        elif a0 > 0:
            a0 -= 1
        else:
            a1 -= 1
    return a0, a1


def _extent(plan, W, H):
    """Canvas rect (x0, y0, x1, y1) that covers the card at every moment of its animation: anim_state is sampled over the whole 0..1 range
    (plus the pop-out range for t4_pop), clamped to the canvas, even size."""
    w, h = plan["size"]
    name = _anim_name(plan["c"])
    ps = [i / float(SAMPLES) for i in range(SAMPLES + 1)]
    if name == "t4_pop":
        ps += [-p for p in ps[1:]]
    lo_x = lo_y = 1e9
    hi_x = hi_y = -1e9
    for p in ps:
        try:
            _a, dx, dy, sc, rot, _r = anim_state(name, p, W, H)
        except Exception:
            dx, dy, sc, rot = 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0
        sc = float(sc)
        if abs(rot) > 0.05:
            hw = hh = math.hypot(w, h) * sc / 2.0
        else:
            hw, hh = w * sc / 2.0, h * sc / 2.0
        lo_x, hi_x = min(lo_x, plan["cx"] + dx - hw), max(hi_x, plan["cx"] + dx + hw)
        lo_y, hi_y = min(lo_y, plan["cy"] + dy - hh), max(hi_y, plan["cy"] + dy + hh)
    x0, x1 = _even(max(0, int(math.floor(lo_x)) - MARGIN), min(W, int(math.ceil(hi_x)) + MARGIN), W)
    y0, y1 = _even(max(0, int(math.floor(lo_y)) - MARGIN), min(H, int(math.ceil(hi_y)) + MARGIN), H)
    if x1 - x0 < 2 or y1 - y0 < 2:
        raise ValueError("the card is outside the canvas")
    return x0, y0, x1, y1


def _reader_cmd(plan, win, nfr, cw, ch, fps_s):
    """FFmpeg command that decodes the source at the picture size and writes raw rgb24 frames to stdout (muted)."""
    c, original = plan["c"], plan["kind"] == "original"
    seg_s, seg_e = c["seg_start"], c["seg_end"]
    ss = seg_s if seg_s is not None else (win[0] if original else 0.0)
    if seg_e is not None and seg_e - ss < 0.05:
        seg_e = None
    cmd = [FFMPEG, "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error"]
    if (not original) and seg_e is None and ss == 0.0:
        cmd += ["-stream_loop", "-1"]                                     # a whole clip file loops while the card is shown
    cmd += ["-ss", "%.3f" % ss, "-i", str(plan["src"])]
    if seg_e is not None:
        cmd += ["-t", "%.3f" % (seg_e - ss)]
    cmd += ["-an", "-vf", f"fps={fps_s},scale={cw}:{ch}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop={cw}:{ch},format=rgb24",
            "-frames:v", str(nfr), "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "rgb24", "pipe:1"]
    return cmd


def _picture_sprite(raw, cw, ch, mask, size, pos):
    """One decoded frame -> RGBA sprite of the card's full size: the frame cut by the chamfer mask, at the picture rect, rest transparent."""
    pic = Image.frombytes("RGB", (cw, ch), raw).convert("RGBA")
    pic.putalpha(mask)
    spr = Image.new("RGBA", size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
    spr.paste(pic, pos)
    return spr


def _bake(cfg, plan, n, tmpdir, info, dur_eff):
    """Bake one card's picture into tmpdir/t4cardN.mov -> the video-layer dict for render.py."""
    c, win = plan["c"], plan["win"]
    W, H = int(cfg["canvas"][0]), int(cfg["canvas"][1])
    fps = info["fps"]
    fps_f = float(fps)
    fps_s = f"{fps.numerator}/{fps.denominator}" if fps.denominator != 1 else str(fps.numerator)
    s0, e_true = win
    e = min(e_true, dur_eff)
    nfr = max(1, int(math.ceil((e - s0) * fps_f)))
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = _extent(plan, W, H)
    Wp, Hp = x1 - x0, y1 - y0
    px, py, cw, ch = plan["pic"]
    mask, need = t4_card_mask(cw, ch), cw * ch * 3
    out = os.path.join(tmpdir, "t4card%d.mov" % n)
    print("Preparing video card %d (%s, %d frames)..." % (n + 1, Path(str(plan["src"])).name, nfr))
    rd = subprocess.Popen(_reader_cmd(plan, win, nfr, cw, ch, fps_s), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                          stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    wr = subprocess.Popen([FFMPEG, "-y", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "rgba",
                           "-video_size", f"{Wp}x{Hp}", "-framerate", fps_s, "-i", "pipe:0", "-c:v", "qtrle", "-pix_fmt", "argb", out],
                          stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    last, it = None, None
    try:
        for i in range(nfr):
            raw = _read_exact(rd.stdout, need)
            if len(raw) != need:
                raw = last if last is not None else GRAY * need          # the source ended: hold the last frame
            last = raw
            spr = _picture_sprite(raw, cw, ch, mask, plan["size"], (px, py))
            if it is None:
                it = _make_item(spr, s0, e_true, plan["cx"] - x0, plan["cy"] - y0, c)
            else:
                it.sprite = spr
            canvas = Image.new("RGBA", (Wp, Hp), (0, 0, 0, 0))
            draw_item(canvas, it, anim_state(it.anim, it.progress(s0 + i / fps_f), W, H))
            wr.stdin.write(canvas.tobytes())
        wr.stdin.close()
    except (BrokenPipeError, OSError):
        pass
    finally:
        rd.kill()
        rd.wait()
    err = wr.stderr.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
    if wr.wait() != 0 or not os.path.isfile(out):
        raise RuntimeError(err[-300:] or "FFmpeg could not write the clip")
    return {"path": out, "start": s0, "end": e, "area": "canvas", "mode": "fit", "fade": 0.0, "_xy": [x0, y0]}


def t4_prepare_card_layers(cfg, info, tmpdir):
    """Registry hook prepare_layers (id 5): one alpha clip per video / original-segment card -> list of video layers (drawn above the
    foreground plate, under the card's border Item). [] when there is none. Never raises: a failing card warns once and has no picture."""
    try:
        int(cfg["canvas"][0]), int(cfg["canvas"][1])
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, IndexError):
        return []
    dur_eff = info["duration"]
    if cfg.get("preview"):
        dur_eff = min(dur_eff, float(cfg["preview"]))
    layers = []
    for n, plan in enumerate(t4_card_plans(cfg, info["duration"])):
        if plan["win"][0] >= dur_eff:
            continue
        try:
            layers.append(_bake(cfg, plan, n, tmpdir, info, dur_eff))
        except (Exception, SystemExit) as e:
            t4_warn("cards: video card %d could not be prepared (%s: %s) - skipped." % (plan["idx"] + 1, type(e).__name__, e))
    return layers

====================================================================================================
FILE: mt\templates\t4\cards.py
====================================================================================================
"""mt.templates.t4.cards - Template 4 module 'cards' (refs R2 right card, R8 PiP card + label): IMAGE cards - a picture inside a chamfered
neon border, an optional connector line that ends in a glowing dot at a target point, and an optional label tag with slanted stripes.
Video cards: the picture is baked into an alpha clip by cards_video.py (muted); the border + label stay an Item over it. Drawing lives in cards_art.py.
cfg['t4']['cards'] = [card, ...]   (also accepted: one card dict, or {on, cards: [...]})   card = {
    media  path           the picture (png / jpg / webp ...). Missing / unreadable -> gray placeholder + one t4_warn line. A video path, or 'original' (= the main video), plus seg_start / seg_end (seconds; default seg_start = the card's start for 'original', 0 for a file; a file without seg_end loops) is baked into a muted clip.
    label  'TEXT' | {text, color, anchor}   tag overlapping a card corner (anchor bottom-right default | bottom-left | top-right | top-left).
                          Latin text is capitalised; > 11 characters -> two balanced lines (or use '\\n' / '|'); '' / '-' = no label.
    anchor 'top-right' | xy   one of the 9 positions (top-left top top-right left center right bottom-left bottom bottom-right) with inset_x /
                          inset_y px; xy = [x, y] = the centre of the card block (px or '40%'). Default anchor 'top-right' (R8).
    width 480, height     picture width px (short side 1080); height default = the picture's own shape (width / height clamped 0.75 - 1.8).
    color '#19D3FF'       border / stripes / label colour
    connector {target [x, y] | points [...], side auto|left|right|top|bottom, style elbow|line, attach 0.35, color, end_dot True|'both'|'start'|
               False, width, glow}   target = canvas px or '%' strings; points may also be 'card' / 'card-top|bottom|left|right'. Shorthand:
               connector = [x, y]. Elbow = straight - 45 degree diagonal - straight (R2); line = one straight segment (R8).
    start | trigger, end | hold (default 5 s), anim 'auto' (= 'pop'; 'fade' / 'none' / any mt.anim name), anim_dur 0.45 }
Behaviour: the card pops in (anim 't4_pop'), the connector fades in right after it, everything fades out together at the end. The connector is
drawn UNDER the card (its start is hidden inside the border). Ink (card + label + glow) stays >= 48 px from the canvas edges; frame on (P8): the
card moves inward until it clears the frame plate (same search as the name tag). One sprite Item per card (+ one for the connector), cached.
Public: T4_CARD, t4_cards_cfg(raw) -> [card], t4_cards_items(cfg, duration), t4_ask_image_cards()."""
import copy
import os

from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image, ImageChops

from mt.anim import ANIMS
from mt.ask import ask_anim
from mt.common import IMAGE_EXTS, VIDEO_EXTS, ask, ask_choice, c_existing_file, c_float, c_time, probe, yn
from mt.draw import Item
from mt.templates.t4.cards_art import (ASPECT_MAX, ASPECT_MIN, _aspect, _placeholder, t4_card_mask, t4_card_sprite, t4_load_media,
                                       t4_video_frame)
from mt.templates.t4.cfg import _hex
from mt.templates.t4.frame import t4_frame_cfg
from mt.templates.t4.kit import connector
from mt.templates.t4.nameplate import T4_SAFE, _anchor as _corner, _bool, _cached, _flt, _font, _frame_mask, _place, _window
from mt.templates.t4.tiles import ANCHORS, TileItem, _anchor, _coord, _place_xy, _point, _warn_overlaps
from mt.templates.t4.timing import _num as _secs, t4_ask_when
from mt.templates.t4.warn import t4_warn

T4_CARD = {"on": True, "media": "", "label": {}, "anchor": "top-right", "xy": None, "width": 480.0, "height": None, "inset_x": 0.0, "inset_y": 0.0,
           "color": "#19d3ff", "connector": {}, "start": 0.0, "trigger": "", "end": None, "hold": None, "anim": "auto", "anim_dur": 0.45, "seg_start": None, "seg_end": None}
_CONN = {"target": None, "points": [], "side": "auto", "style": "elbow", "attach": 0.35, "color": "", "end_dot": True, "width": 2.5, "glow": 9.0}
_TOKENS = ("card", "card-top", "card-bottom", "card-left", "card-right")
_SPR = {}


# ---- config -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _cpoint(p):
    """[x, y] | 'x,y' | a card token -> [x, y] | token | None."""
    if isinstance(p, str) and p.strip().lower() in _TOKENS:
        return p.strip().lower()
    q = _point(p)
    return q if isinstance(q, list) else None


def _label(raw):
    """'TEXT' | {text, color, anchor} -> {text, color, anchor} or {} (no label)."""
    d = raw if isinstance(raw, dict) else {"text": raw}
    t = d.get("text")
    t = str(t).strip()[:80] if isinstance(t, (str, int, float)) and not isinstance(t, bool) else ""
    if t.lower() in ("", "-", "none"):
        return {}
    c = d.get("color")
    return {"text": t, "color": _hex(c, "") if isinstance(c, str) else "", "anchor": _corner(d.get("anchor"), "bottom-right")}


def _connector(raw):
    """Connector dict | [x, y] shorthand -> complete dict, or {} when it has neither a target nor >= 2 points."""
    if isinstance(raw, (list, tuple, str)):
        raw = {"target": raw}
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        return {}
    out = copy.deepcopy(_CONN)
    out["target"] = _cpoint(raw.get("target"))
    out["target"] = out["target"] if isinstance(out["target"], list) else None
    pts = [_cpoint(p) for p in raw.get("points", [])] if isinstance(raw.get("points"), (list, tuple)) else []
    out["points"] = [p for p in pts if p is not None][:12]
    side, style = str(raw.get("side", "")).strip().lower(), str(raw.get("style", "")).strip().lower()
    out["side"] = side if side in ("left", "right", "top", "bottom") else "auto"
    out["style"] = "line" if style in ("line", "straight") else "elbow"
    out["attach"] = _flt(raw.get("attach"), 0.05, 0.95, 0.35)
    out["color"] = _hex(raw.get("color"), "") if isinstance(raw.get("color"), str) else ""
    ed = raw.get("end_dot")
    out["end_dot"] = ed if ed in (True, False, "both", "start") else True
    out["width"], out["glow"] = _flt(raw.get("width"), 0.5, 30, 2.5), _flt(raw.get("glow"), 0, 60, 9.0)
    return out if (out["target"] is not None or len(out["points"]) >= 2) else {}


def _card(raw):
    out = copy.deepcopy(T4_CARD)
    out.update({k: copy.deepcopy(v) for k, v in raw.items() if k not in out})                          # extras survive
    m = raw.get("media")
    out["media"] = m.strip() if isinstance(m, str) else ""
    out["seg_start"], out["seg_end"] = _secs(raw.get("seg_start")), _secs(raw.get("seg_end"))
    if out["seg_start"] is not None and out["seg_start"] < 0:
        out["seg_start"] = 0.0
    if out["seg_end"] is not None and out["seg_end"] <= (out["seg_start"] or 0.0) + 0.05:
        out["seg_end"] = None
    out["label"] = _label(raw.get("label"))
    out["anchor"] = _anchor(raw.get("anchor"), "top-right")
    xy = _point(raw.get("xy"))
    out["xy"] = xy if isinstance(xy, list) else None
    out["width"] = _flt(raw.get("width"), 120, 1800, 480.0)
    h = _flt(raw.get("height"), 80, 2400, None)
    out["height"] = h
    out["inset_x"], out["inset_y"] = _flt(raw.get("inset_x"), 0, 600, 0.0), _flt(raw.get("inset_y"), 0, 600, 0.0)
    out["color"] = _hex(raw.get("color"), "#19d3ff")
    out["connector"] = _connector(raw.get("connector"))
    trig = raw.get("trigger")
    out["trigger"] = trig.strip() if isinstance(trig, str) else ""
    out["start"] = raw["start"] if raw.get("start") is not None else (None if out["trigger"] else 0.0)      # a phrase never falls back to 0
    out["end"], out["hold"] = raw.get("end"), raw.get("hold")
    a = raw.get("anim")
    a = ("reveal" if a.strip().lower() == "typewriter" else a.strip().lower()) if isinstance(a, str) else "auto"
    out["anim"] = a if a in ANIMS or a in ("auto", "pop", "none") else "auto"
    out["anim_dur"] = _flt(raw.get("anim_dur"), 0.0, 5.0, 0.45)
    out["on"] = _bool(raw.get("on"), True)
    return out


def t4_cards_cfg(raw):
    """Normalise cfg['t4']['cards'] -> list of complete cards. Accepts a list, one card dict or {on, cards: [...]} (module default {'on': False}
    = no cards). Never raises; junk entries are dropped."""
    try:
        if isinstance(raw, dict) and "media" in raw:
            raw = [raw]
        elif isinstance(raw, dict):
            raw = raw.get("cards") if _bool(raw.get("on"), False) else []
        return [_card(c) for c in raw if isinstance(c, dict)] if isinstance(raw, (list, tuple)) else []
    except Exception:
        return []


# ---- connector geometry -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _side(side, rect, tx, ty):
    """'auto' = the card side that faces the target: the axis with the larger gap decides (left / right beside the card, top / bottom above or
    below it); a target inside the card's footprint leaves from the bottom."""
    if side != "auto":
        return side
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = rect
    gx, gy = max(x0 - tx, tx - x1, 0.0), max(y0 - ty, ty - y1, 0.0)
    if gx > 0 and gx >= gy:
        return "left" if tx < x0 else "right"
    return ("top" if ty < y0 else "bottom") if gy > 0 else "bottom"


def _edge_point(rect, side, attach):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = rect
    return {"left": (x0, y0 + (y1 - y0) * attach), "right": (x1, y0 + (y1 - y0) * attach),
            "top": (x0 + (x1 - x0) * attach, y0), "bottom": (x0 + (x1 - x0) * attach, y1)}[side]


def _elbow(start, target, side, style):
    """start -> target: one straight segment ('line'), or straight - 45 degree diagonal - straight along the leaving direction (R2)."""
    (sx, sy), (tx, ty) = start, target
    horiz = side in ("left", "right")
    along, across = (abs(tx - sx), abs(ty - sy)) if horiz else (abs(ty - sy), abs(tx - sx))
    if style == "line" or across < 2 or along <= across + 4:
        return [start, target]
    a = (along - across) / 2.0                                   # the diagonal eats `across` of the run; the rest is split before / after it
    d = (1 if (tx > sx if horiz else ty > sy) else -1)
    p1, p2 = ((sx + d * a, sy), (sx + d * (a + across), ty)) if horiz else ((sx, sy + d * a), (tx, sy + d * (a + across)))
    return [start, p1, p2, target]


def _conn_points(c, rect, W, H, s):
    """Resolve the connector to canvas px points; everything is clamped so the visible ink (glow tail + end dot) stays in the 48 px safe area."""
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = rect
    named = {"card": ((x0 + x1) / 2.0, (y0 + y1) / 2.0), "card-top": ((x0 + x1) / 2.0, y0), "card-bottom": ((x0 + x1) / 2.0, y1),
             "card-left": (x0, (y0 + y1) / 2.0), "card-right": (x1, (y0 + y1) / 2.0)}
    if c["points"] and len(c["points"]) >= 2:
        pts = [named[p] if isinstance(p, str) else (_coord(p[0], W, s), _coord(p[1], H, s)) for p in c["points"]]
    else:
        tx, ty = _coord(c["target"][0], W, s), _coord(c["target"][1], H, s)
        side = _side(c["side"], rect, tx, ty)
        pts = _elbow(_edge_point(rect, side, c["attach"]), (tx, ty), side, c["style"])
    m = (T4_SAFE + c["glow"] * 1.6 + 2) * s
    return [(min(max(x, m), W - m), min(max(y, m), H - m)) for x, y in pts]


# ---- items ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _kind(c):
    """'original' (a segment of the main video) | 'video' (a clip file) | 'image'."""
    m = str(c.get("media") or "").strip()
    if m.lower() == "original":
        return "original"
    return "video" if m.lower().endswith(VIDEO_EXTS) else "image"


def _src(c, cfg):
    return cfg.get("video") if _kind(c) == "original" else c.get("media")


_ASP = {}


def _vid_aspect(src):
    """Width / height of a video file, clamped like pictures; 4:3 when it cannot be probed."""
    key = (str(src), os.path.getmtime(src) if src and os.path.isfile(str(src)) else 0)
    if key not in _ASP:
        try:
            i = probe(src)
            _ASP[key] = max(ASPECT_MIN, min(ASPECT_MAX, i["w"] / float(i["h"])))
        except (Exception, SystemExit):
            _ASP[key] = 4.0 / 3.0
    return _ASP[key]


def _foot(spr):
    """Frame-only sprite + the picture's footprint in its alpha = what the finished card covers. Used only to place a video card."""
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = spr.info["card"]
    lay = Image.new("L", spr.size, 0)
    lay.paste(t4_card_mask(x1 - x0, y1 - y0), (x0, y0))
    foot = spr.copy()
    foot.putalpha(ImageChops.lighter(spr.getchannel("A"), lay))
    return foot


def _cut_card(csp, pos, cw, ch):
    """Remove the card's picture area from a connector sprite (its start stays hidden under the card, as with picture cards)."""
    org = csp.info["origin"]
    hole = Image.new("L", csp.size, 255)
    hole.paste(ImageChops.invert(t4_card_mask(cw, ch)), (int(round(pos[0])) + org[0], int(round(pos[1])) + org[1]))
    csp.putalpha(ImageChops.multiply(csp.getchannel("A"), hole))
    return csp


def _card_sprite(c, s, W, H, cfg=None, live=False, ft=0.0):
    """Cached (sprite, warning). Pictures: the full card. Video / original: live = the frame only (cards_video bakes the picture into a
    clip under it); not live = the full card with the frame at time ft (--still) or a gray placeholder (missing source)."""
    if _kind(c) == "image":
        return _card_sprite_img(c, s, W, H)
    src = _src(c, cfg or {})
    ok = bool(src) and os.path.isfile(str(src))
    cw = c["width"] * s
    ch = c["height"] * s if c["height"] else cw / (_vid_aspect(src) if ok else 4.0 / 3.0)
    lab, fp = c["label"], _font(c.get("font"))
    live = bool(live and ok)
    key = ("v", _kind(c), str(src), _mtime(src), live, round(float(ft), 2), repr(lab), round(cw), round(ch), c["color"], fp)

    def make():
        msg = None
        if not ok:
            msg, img = "cards: video '%s' is missing - gray placeholder." % (Path(str(src)).name if src else "(none)"), _placeholder()
        elif live:
            img = Image.new("RGB", (4, 4))
        else:
            img = t4_video_frame(src, ft)
            if img is None:
                msg, img = "cards: could not read a frame of '%s' - gray placeholder." % Path(str(src)).name, _placeholder()
        spr, m2 = t4_card_sprite("", lab.get("text", ""), cw, ch, c["color"], fp, lab.get("anchor", "bottom-right"),
                                 lab.get("color") or None, with_picture=not live, media_img=img)
        return spr, msg or m2
    return _cached(_SPR, key, make, 16)


def _card_sprite_img(c, s, W, H):
    """Cached (sprite, warning) of one card at canvas scale s."""
    cw = c["width"] * s
    if c["height"]:
        ch = c["height"] * s
    else:
        img, _msg = t4_load_media(c["media"])
        ch = cw / _aspect(img)
    lab, fp = c["label"], _font(c.get("font"))
    key = (c["media"], _mtime(c["media"]), repr(lab), round(cw), round(ch), c["color"], fp)
    return _cached(_SPR, key, lambda: t4_card_sprite(c["media"], lab.get("text", ""), cw, ch, c["color"], fp, lab.get("anchor", "bottom-right"),
                                                     lab.get("color") or None), 16)


def _mtime(path):
    return os.path.getmtime(path) if path and os.path.isfile(str(path)) else 0


def _make_item(spr, st, en, cx, cy, c):
    if c["anim"] in ("auto", "pop"):
        return TileItem(spr, st, en, cx, cy, "t4_pop", c["anim_dur"], out=True)
    return Item(spr, st, en, cx, cy, c["anim"], c["anim_dur"], out=True)


def _one_card(cfg, c, idx, duration, W, H, s, fm, placed, plans=None):
    label = "card %d" % (idx + 1)
    win = _window(cfg, c, label, duration, 5.0)
    if win is None:
        return []
    kind = _kind(c)
    src = _src(c, cfg)
    live = kind != "image" and bool(src) and os.path.isfile(str(src)) and not cfg.get("_t2_still")     # live = baked into a video layer
    ft = c["seg_start"] if c["seg_start"] is not None else (win[0] if kind == "original" else 0.0)
    spr, msg = _card_sprite(c, s, W, H, cfg, live, ft)
    foot = _foot(spr) if live else spr
    if msg:
        t4_warn(msg)
    pl = _place_xy(foot, c["xy"], W, H, s) if c["xy"] else _place(foot, c["anchor"], W, H, s, c["inset_x"], c["inset_y"], fm, label)
    if pl is None:
        return []
    cx, cy, ink, _ = pl
    placed.append((label, ink))
    left, top = cx - spr.width / 2.0, cy - spr.height / 2.0
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = spr.info["card"]
    rect = (left + x0, top + y0, left + x1, top + y1)
    last = max(win[0], win[1] - 0.1)
    if live and plans is not None:                            # cards_video bakes the picture of this card
        plans.append({"c": c, "idx": idx, "win": win, "cx": cx, "cy": cy, "size": spr.size, "pic": (x0, y0, x1 - x0, y1 - y0),
                      "src": src, "kind": kind})
    items = []
    if c["connector"]:
        k = c["connector"]
        col = k["color"] or c["color"]
        csp = connector(_conn_points(k, rect, W, H, s), col, k["end_dot"], k["width"] * s, k["glow"] * s)
        ox, oy = csp.info["origin"]
        if live:
            _cut_card(csp, (left + x0, top + y0), x1 - x0, y1 - y0)
        items.append(Item(csp, min(win[0] + c["anim_dur"] * 0.8, last), win[1], -ox + csp.width / 2.0, -oy + csp.height / 2.0, "fade", c["anim_dur"], out=True))
    items.append(_make_item(spr, win[0], win[1], cx, cy, c))                              # last = on top of the connector
    return items


def t4_cards_items(cfg, duration, plans=None):
    """Items of every card: [connector (fade), card (pop)] per card, all ending together. Never raises; [] when the module is off."""
    t4 = cfg.get("t4") if isinstance(cfg, dict) and isinstance(cfg.get("t4"), dict) else {}
    cards = [c for c in t4_cards_cfg(t4.get("cards")) if c["on"]]
    if not cards:
        return []
    try:
        W, H = int(cfg["canvas"][0]), int(cfg["canvas"][1])
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, IndexError):
        t4_warn("t4 cards: the job has no canvas - skipped.")
        return []
    s, items, placed = min(W, H) / 1080.0, [], []
    try:
        fm = _frame_mask(W, H, t4_frame_cfg(t4.get("frame")), s)
        for i, c in enumerate(cards):
            items += _one_card(cfg, c, i, duration, W, H, s, fm, placed, plans)
        _warn_overlaps(placed)
    except Exception as e:
        t4_warn("t4 cards: could not be drawn (%s: %s) - skipped." % (type(e).__name__, e))
    return items


# ---- questions --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def t4_card_plans(cfg, duration):
    """Placement of every video / original-segment card, computed by the same code as the Items: [{c, idx, win, cx, cy, size, pic, src, kind}]
    (pic = x, y, w, h of the picture inside the sprite). Used by cards_video to bake the clips."""
    plans = []
    t4_cards_items(cfg, duration, plans)
    return plans


def _c_target(s):
    p = _cpoint(s.strip())
    if p is None or isinstance(p, str):
        raise ValueError("enter a point like  300,900  or  25%,60%  (px or %)")
    return p


def t4_ask_image_cards():
    """Question group 'cards' (called by t4_ask_config). -> a list with ONE card, or {'on': False}. More cards: edit the job file."""
    if not yn("Add an image card (picture in a neon border, optional label + connector - references R2 / R8)?", default=False):
        return {"on": False}
    def _c_media(s):
        return "original" if s.strip().lower() == "original" else c_existing_file(IMAGE_EXTS + VIDEO_EXTS)(s)
    c = {"media": ask("Card picture or video (PNG / JPG / MP4 path, or the word original = a segment of the main video)", key="t4_card_img", cast=_c_media)}
    if c["media"] == "original" or c["media"].lower().endswith(VIDEO_EXTS):
        for k, q in (("seg_start", "Segment start (seconds or mm:ss; Enter = %s)" % ("the card's start time" if c["media"] == "original" else "0")),
                     ("seg_end", "Segment end (seconds or mm:ss; Enter = %s)" % ("the card's hold time" if c["media"] == "original" else "the clip's end / loop"))):
            v = ask(q, allow_empty=True, cast=c_time)
            if v not in (None, ""):
                c[k] = v
    lab = ask("Label text on the card (Enter / '-' = none, e.g. LIVE CODING DEVELOPMENT)", default="-", key="t4_card_label", cast=lambda s: s.strip())
    c["label"] = "" if lab in ("", "-") else lab
    c["width"] = ask("Card width (px, for a 1080 px short side)", default=T4_CARD["width"], key="t4_card_width", cast=c_float)
    a = ask_choice("Where?", ["Top-left", "Top", "Top-right", "Left", "Center", "Right", "Bottom-left", "Bottom", "Bottom-right"], default=3, key="t4_card_anchor")
    c["anchor"] = ANCHORS[a - 1]
    if yn("Add a connector line ending in a glowing dot?", default=False):
        c["connector"] = {"target": ask("Dot position  x,y  (px or %, e.g. 22%,38%)", default="20%,40%", key="t4_card_target", cast=_c_target)}
    c.update(t4_ask_when("Image card", 5.0, key="t4_card_when"))
    c["anim"] = ask_anim("Card animation (auto = pop in, fade out)", default="pop", key="t4_card_anim")
    return [c]


====================================================================================================
FILE: mt\templates\t4\tiles.py
====================================================================================================
"""mt.templates.t4.tiles - Template 4 module 'tiles' (ref R2, left side): groups of dark glass tiles, each holding a user logo (PNG ...,
fitted + centred), laid out in a grid, optionally with a neon connector polyline that ends in a glowing dot at a target point.
cfg['t4']['tiles'] = [group, ...]   (also accepted: one group dict, or {on, groups: [...]})   group = {
    images [paths]       the logos, row by row (<= 12). A missing / unreadable file -> gray placeholder tile + one t4_warn line.
    cols 2, gap 18, size 150   grid columns (a short last row is centred), px between tiles, tile edge (px at short side 1080)
    anchor 'left' | xy     anchor = one of the 9 positions (top-left top top-right left center right bottom-left bottom bottom-right) with
                           inset_x / inset_y px; xy = [x, y] = the CENTRE of the group (px, or '40%' strings). Default anchor 'left'.
    border '#C4D6EF'       tile border colour (light, as R2)
    connector {points [[x, y] ...], color, end_dot True|'both'|'start'|False, width, glow}   points in canvas px or '%' strings; a point may
                           also be 'group', 'group-top|bottom|left|right' = that point of the tile group. >= 2 points, drawn after the tiles.
    start | trigger, end | hold (default 5 s), anim 'pop' (default; 'fade' / 'none' / any mt.anim name), anim_dur 0.35, stagger 0.12 s }
Behaviour: the tiles pop in one after another (t4_stagger), the connector fades in after the last one, and everything fades out together at the
group's end (anim 'pop' = anim 't4_pop' in mt/anim.py: pop in, pure fade out; other anims run reversed). Ink stays >= 48 px from the canvas
edges (connector points are clamped into the safe area). Frame on (P8): an anchored group moves inward until it clears the frame (same search as
the name tag); an xy group is only clamped to the safe area. Each tile = ONE sprite Item (cached); nothing is drawn per frame but the animation.
Public: T4_TILES, t4_tiles_cfg(raw) -> [group], t4_tile_sprite(path, size, border, scale), t4_tiles_items(cfg, duration), t4_ask_tiles()."""
import copy
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image

from mt.anim import ANIMS, PRESETS
from mt.ask import ask_anim
from mt.common import IMAGE_EXTS, ask, ask_choice, c_color, c_existing_file, c_float, c_int, yn
from mt.draw import Item, t2_paint, t2_rrect_mask
from mt.templates.t4.cfg import _hex
from mt.templates.t4.frame import t4_frame_cfg
from mt.templates.t4.kit import connector, glass_panel, kit_paste
from mt.templates.t4.nameplate import T4_SAFE, _bool, _cached, _flt, _frame_mask, _place, _window
from mt.templates.t4.timing import t4_ask_when, t4_stagger
from mt.templates.t4.warn import t4_warn

ANCHORS = ("top-left", "top", "top-right", "left", "center", "right", "bottom-left", "bottom", "bottom-right")
MAX_IMAGES = 12
LOGO_FRAC = 0.60                                       # the logo fills this fraction of the tile (R2: ~55-65 %)
TINT = (8, 16, 36, 150)                                # tile glass (rgba): translucent, the video shows through
T4_TILES = {"on": True, "images": [], "cols": 2, "gap": 18.0, "size": 150.0, "anchor": "left", "xy": None, "inset_x": 0.0, "inset_y": 0.0,
            "border": "#c4d6ef", "connector": {}, "start": 0.0, "trigger": "", "end": None, "hold": None, "anim": "pop", "anim_dur": 0.35,
            "stagger": 0.12}
_CONN = {"points": [], "color": "#19d3ff", "end_dot": True, "width": 2.5, "glow": 9.0}
_TOKENS = ("group", "group-top", "group-bottom", "group-left", "group-right")
_TILE = {}


# ---- config -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _anchor(v, default):
    s = str(v).strip().lower().replace("_", "-").replace(" ", "-") if isinstance(v, (str, int)) and not isinstance(v, bool) else ""
    s = PRESETS.get(s, s)
    s = {"middle": "center", "centre": "center", "top-center": "top", "bottom-center": "bottom"}.get(s, s)
    return s if s in ANCHORS else default


def _num_or_pct(v):
    """12, '12', '40%' -> kept as given (number or 'NN%' string); anything else -> None."""
    if isinstance(v, bool):
        return None
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
        return float(v) if math.isfinite(v) else None
    if isinstance(v, str):
        t = v.strip()
        try:
            return t if t.endswith("%") and math.isfinite(float(t[:-1])) else float(t)
        except ValueError:
            return None
    return None


def _point(p):
    """[x, y] / (x, y) / 'x,y' / a group token -> [x, y] | token | None."""
    if isinstance(p, str):
        t = p.strip().lower()
        if t in _TOKENS:
            return t
        p = [a for a in t.replace(";", ",").split(",")]
    if isinstance(p, (list, tuple)) and len(p) == 2:
        a, b = _num_or_pct(p[0]), _num_or_pct(p[1])
        return [a, b] if a is not None and b is not None else None
    return None


def _conn(raw):
    out = copy.deepcopy(_CONN)
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        return {}
    pts = [_point(p) for p in raw.get("points", [])] if isinstance(raw.get("points"), (list, tuple)) else []
    out["points"] = [p for p in pts if p is not None][:12]
    out["color"] = _hex(raw.get("color"), out["color"])
    ed = raw.get("end_dot")
    out["end_dot"] = ed if ed in (True, False, "both", "start") else True
    out["width"], out["glow"] = _flt(raw.get("width"), 0.5, 30, 2.5), _flt(raw.get("glow"), 0, 60, 9.0)
    return out if len(out["points"]) >= 2 else {}


def _group(raw):
    out = copy.deepcopy(T4_TILES)
    out.update({k: copy.deepcopy(v) for k, v in raw.items() if k not in out})                       # extras survive
    imgs = raw.get("images")
    out["images"] = [i.strip() for i in imgs if isinstance(i, str) and i.strip()][:MAX_IMAGES] if isinstance(imgs, (list, tuple)) else []
    try:
        out["cols"] = max(1, min(8, int(raw.get("cols", 2))))
    except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError):
        out["cols"] = 2
    out["gap"], out["size"] = _flt(raw.get("gap"), 0, 200, 18.0), _flt(raw.get("size"), 40, 600, 150.0)
    out["anchor"] = _anchor(raw.get("anchor"), "left")
    xy = _point(raw.get("xy"))
    out["xy"] = xy if isinstance(xy, list) else None
    out["inset_x"], out["inset_y"] = _flt(raw.get("inset_x"), 0, 600, 0.0), _flt(raw.get("inset_y"), 0, 600, 0.0)
    out["border"] = _hex(raw.get("border"), "#c4d6ef")
    out["connector"] = _conn(raw.get("connector"))
    trig = raw.get("trigger")
    out["trigger"] = trig.strip() if isinstance(trig, str) else ""
    out["start"] = raw["start"] if raw.get("start") is not None else (None if out["trigger"] else 0.0)      # a phrase never falls back to 0
    out["end"], out["hold"] = raw.get("end"), raw.get("hold")
    a = raw.get("anim")
    a = ("reveal" if a.strip().lower() == "typewriter" else a.strip().lower()) if isinstance(a, str) else "pop"
    out["anim"] = a if a in ANIMS or a in ("pop", "none") else "pop"
    out["anim_dur"], out["stagger"] = _flt(raw.get("anim_dur"), 0.0, 5.0, 0.35), _flt(raw.get("stagger"), 0.0, 2.0, 0.12)
    out["on"] = _bool(raw.get("on"), True)
    return out


def t4_tiles_cfg(raw):
    """Normalise cfg['t4']['tiles'] -> list of complete groups. Accepts a list of groups, one group dict or {on, groups: [...]} (module
    default {'on': False} = no groups). Never raises; junk entries are dropped."""
    try:
        if isinstance(raw, dict) and "images" in raw:
            raw = [raw]
        elif isinstance(raw, dict):
            raw = raw.get("groups") if _bool(raw.get("on"), False) else []
        return [_group(g) for g in raw if isinstance(g, dict)] if isinstance(raw, (list, tuple)) else []
    except Exception:
        return []


# ---- sprites ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _load_logo(path):
    """-> RGBA image, or None (missing / not an image). First frame of animated files."""
    try:
        if not path or not os.path.isfile(str(path)):
            return None
        with Image.open(str(path)) as im:
            im.seek(0)
            return im.convert("RGBA")
    except Exception:
        return None


def _placeholder(box):
    """Gray rounded square with a small 'image' mark - stands in for a missing logo (box = px)."""
    n = max(8, int(box))
    ph = Image.new("RGBA", (n, n), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    t2_paint(ph, t2_rrect_mask((0, 0, n, n), n * 0.16), (128, 132, 140), 0.85)
    t2_paint(ph, t2_rrect_mask((n * 0.20, n * 0.24, n * 0.80, n * 0.76), n * 0.06), (60, 64, 72), 0.9)
    t2_paint(ph, t2_rrect_mask((n * 0.30, n * 0.56, n * 0.50, n * 0.68), n * 0.03), (160, 166, 176))
    return ph


def _build_tile(path, size, border, scale):
    sz = max(24, int(round(size * scale)))
    sp = glass_panel((sz, sz), sz * 0.22, TINT, border, 0, max(1.4, sz * 0.010), max(2.5, sz * 0.022))      # thin soft border as R2
    ox, oy = sp.info["origin"]
    box, msg = int(round(sz * LOGO_FRAC)), None
    logo = _load_logo(path)
    if logo is None:
        msg = "tiles: image '%s' is missing or not a readable image - gray placeholder." % (Path(str(path)).name or "(empty path)")
        logo = _placeholder(box)
    k = min(box / logo.width, box / logo.height)
    lw, lh = max(1, int(round(logo.width * k))), max(1, int(round(logo.height * k)))
    logo = logo.resize((lw, lh), Image.LANCZOS)
    kit_paste(sp, logo, ox + (sz - lw) / 2.0, oy + (sz - lh) / 2.0)
    sp.info["panel"] = sz
    return sp, msg


def t4_tile_sprite(path, size=150, border="#c4d6ef", scale=1.0):
    """One glass tile with the logo fitted + centred -> RGBA sprite (glow margin included; sprite.info['origin'] = the tile's top-left,
    sprite.info['panel'] = tile edge px). A missing / unreadable file gives a gray placeholder (the one-line warning goes through t4_warn).
    Cached per (path, size, border, scale); a cache hit warns again so a new render still reports it (t4_warn prints once per render)."""
    key = (str(path), round(float(size) * float(scale)), str(border), round(float(scale), 3), os.path.getmtime(path) if path and os.path.isfile(str(path)) else 0)
    sp, msg = _cached(_TILE, key, lambda: _build_tile(path, float(size), border, float(scale)), 48)
    if msg:
        t4_warn(msg)
    return sp


# ---- layout -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _grid(n, cols, size, gap):
    """Top-left of every tile inside the group box + the box size; a short last row is centred. -> ([(x, y)], gw, gh)."""
    cols = max(1, min(cols, n))
    rows = int(math.ceil(n / float(cols)))
    gw, gh = cols * size + (cols - 1) * gap, rows * size + (rows - 1) * gap
    pos = []
    for i in range(n):
        r, c = divmod(i, cols)
        in_row = min(cols, n - r * cols)
        pos.append((c * (size + gap) + (cols - in_row) * (size + gap) / 2.0, r * (size + gap)))
    return pos, gw, gh


def _footprint(tiles, pos, gw, gh, pad):
    """All tiles composited into one sprite - only used to measure the group's ink for the anchor / frame placement."""
    fp = Image.new("RGBA", (int(gw) + 2 * pad, int(gh) + 2 * pad), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    for sp, (x, y) in zip(tiles, pos):
        ox, oy = sp.info["origin"]
        fp.alpha_composite(sp, (int(round(pad + x)) - ox, int(round(pad + y)) - oy))
    return fp


def _coord(v, total, s):
    return total * float(v[:-1]) / 100.0 if isinstance(v, str) else float(v) * s


def _conn_points(c, gbox, W, H, s):
    """Resolve numbers / '%' / group tokens to canvas px, clamped so the line's VISIBLE ink (glow tail + end dot) stays in the 48 px safe area."""
    m, out = (T4_SAFE + c["glow"] * 1.6 + 2) * s, []
    gx0, gy0, gx1, gy1 = gbox
    named = {"group": ((gx0 + gx1) / 2.0, (gy0 + gy1) / 2.0), "group-top": ((gx0 + gx1) / 2.0, gy0), "group-bottom": ((gx0 + gx1) / 2.0, gy1),
             "group-left": (gx0, (gy0 + gy1) / 2.0), "group-right": (gx1, (gy0 + gy1) / 2.0)}
    for p in c["points"]:
        x, y = named[p] if isinstance(p, str) else (_coord(p[0], W, s), _coord(p[1], H, s))
        out.append((min(max(x, m), W - m), min(max(y, m), H - m)))
    return out


# ---- items ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class TileItem(Item):
    """Tile with anim 't4_pop': in = pop, out = pure fade (progress < 0 encodes the exit, see mt/anim.py)."""

    def progress(self, t):
        L = self.end - self.start
        d = min(self.dur, L / 2.0)
        if d <= 1e-6:
            return 1.0
        pin, pout = (t - self.start) / d, (self.end - t) / d
        if pout < 1.0 and pout <= pin:
            return -max(0.0, pout)
        return max(0.0, min(1.0, pin))


def _make_item(sp, st, en, cx, cy, c):
    if c["anim"] == "pop":
        return TileItem(sp, st, en, cx, cy, "t4_pop", c["anim_dur"], out=True)
    return Item(sp, st, en, cx, cy, c["anim"], c["anim_dur"], out=True)


def _conn_sprite(c, pts, s):
    """Connector sprite + the item centre that puts its local (0, 0) back on the canvas origin (points are canvas coordinates)."""
    k = c["connector"]
    sp = connector(pts, k["color"], k["end_dot"], k["width"] * s, k["glow"] * s)
    ox, oy = sp.info["origin"]
    return sp, -ox + sp.width / 2.0, -oy + sp.height / 2.0


def _one_group(cfg, c, idx, duration, W, H, s, fm, placed):
    label = "tiles group %d" % (idx + 1)
    if not c["images"]:
        t4_warn("%s: no images - skipped." % label)
        return []
    win = _window(cfg, c, label, duration, 5.0)
    if win is None:
        return []
    n, size, gap = len(c["images"]), c["size"] * s, c["gap"] * s
    tiles = [t4_tile_sprite(p, c["size"], c["border"], s) for p in c["images"]]
    pos, gw, gh = _grid(n, c["cols"], size, gap)
    pad = tiles[0].info["origin"][0]
    fp = _footprint(tiles, pos, gw, gh, pad)
    if c["xy"]:
        pl = _place_xy(fp, c["xy"], W, H, s)
    else:
        pl = _place(fp, c["anchor"], W, H, s, c["inset_x"], c["inset_y"], fm, label)
    if pl is None:
        return []
    fcx, fcy, rect, _ = pl
    placed.append((label, rect))
    left, top = fcx - fp.width / 2.0, fcy - fp.height / 2.0                       # the footprint sprite's top-left on the canvas
    steps = t4_stagger(n, c["stagger"])
    last = max(win[0], win[1] - 0.1)
    items = [_make_item(sp, min(win[0] + d, last), win[1], left + pad + x + size / 2.0, top + pad + y + size / 2.0, c)
             for sp, (x, y), d in zip(tiles, pos, steps)]
    if c["connector"]:
        gbox = (left + pad, top + pad, left + pad + gw, top + pad + gh)
        sp, cx, cy = _conn_sprite(c, _conn_points(c["connector"], gbox, W, H, s), s)
        items.append(Item(sp, min(win[0] + (steps[-1] if steps else 0.0) + c["anim_dur"], last), win[1], cx, cy, "fade", c["anim_dur"], out=True))
    return items


def _place_xy(fp, xy, W, H, s):
    """Group centred on xy (px / '%'), then clamped so its ink keeps the 48 px safe margin -> same tuple as nameplate._place."""
    from mt.templates.t4.nameplate import _ink_box
    box = _ink_box(fp)
    if box is None:
        return None
    w, h, m = box[2] - box[0], box[3] - box[1], T4_SAFE * s
    x = int(round(min(max(_coord(xy[0], W, s) - w / 2.0, m), W - m - w)))
    y = int(round(min(max(_coord(xy[1], H, s) - h / 2.0, m), H - m - h)))
    return x - box[0] + fp.width / 2.0, y - box[1] + fp.height / 2.0, (x, y, x + w, y + h), 0


def _warn_overlaps(placed):
    for i, (a, ra) in enumerate(placed):
        for b, rb in placed[i + 1:]:
            if ra[0] < rb[2] and rb[0] < ra[2] and ra[1] < rb[3] and rb[1] < ra[3]:
                t4_warn("%s and %s overlap - give one of them another anchor / xy." % (a, b))


def t4_tiles_items(cfg, duration):
    """Items of every tiles group: one per tile (staggered pop-in) + one for the connector; all fade out together. Never raises."""
    t4 = cfg.get("t4") if isinstance(cfg, dict) and isinstance(cfg.get("t4"), dict) else {}
    groups = [g for g in t4_tiles_cfg(t4.get("tiles")) if g["on"]]
    if not groups:
        return []
    try:
        W, H = int(cfg["canvas"][0]), int(cfg["canvas"][1])
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, IndexError):
        t4_warn("t4 tiles: the job has no canvas - skipped.")
        return []
    s, items, placed = min(W, H) / 1080.0, [], []
    try:
        fm = _frame_mask(W, H, t4_frame_cfg(t4.get("frame")), s)
        for i, g in enumerate(groups):
            items += _one_group(cfg, g, i, duration, W, H, s, fm, placed)
        _warn_overlaps(placed)
    except Exception as e:
        t4_warn("t4 tiles: could not be drawn (%s: %s) - skipped." % (type(e).__name__, e))
    return items


# ---- questions --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _c_points(s):
    pts = [_point(p.strip()) for p in s.replace("|", ";").split(";") if p.strip()]
    if len(pts) < 2 or any(p is None for p in pts):
        raise ValueError("enter at least 2 points like  100,900; 250,1000  (px or %, or the words group-bottom / group-right ...)")
    return pts


def t4_ask_tiles():
    """Question group 'tiles' (called by t4_ask_config). -> a list with ONE group, or {'on': False}. More groups: edit the job file."""
    if not yn("Add glass logo tiles (PNG logos in a grid - reference R2)?", default=False):
        return {"on": False}
    imgs = []
    while len(imgs) < MAX_IMAGES:
        p = ask("Logo %d (PNG / image path, Enter = %s)" % (len(imgs) + 1, "done" if imgs else "at least one is needed"),
                key="t4_tiles_img%d" % (len(imgs) + 1), cast=c_existing_file(IMAGE_EXTS), allow_empty=bool(imgs))
        if not p:
            break
        imgs.append(p)
    g = {"images": imgs, "cols": ask("Columns", default=2, key="t4_tiles_cols", cast=c_int),
         "size": ask("Tile size (px, for a 1080 px short side)", default=T4_TILES["size"], key="t4_tiles_size", cast=c_float)}
    a = ask_choice("Where?", ["Top-left", "Top", "Top-right", "Left", "Center", "Right", "Bottom-left", "Bottom", "Bottom-right"],
                   default=4, key="t4_tiles_anchor")
    g["anchor"] = ANCHORS[a - 1]
    if yn("Add a connector line ending in a glowing dot?", default=False):
        pts = ask("Connector points  x,y; x,y; ...  (px or %, first may be group-bottom / group-right)", default="group-bottom; 30%,55%",
                  key="t4_tiles_conn", cast=_c_points)
        g["connector"] = {"points": pts, "end_dot": yn("Dot at both ends (No = only at the target)?", default=False) and "both" or True}
    g.update(t4_ask_when("Logo tiles", 5.0, key="t4_tiles_when"))
    g["anim"] = ask_anim("Tile animation (pop = staggered pop-in, fade-out together)", default="pop", key="t4_tiles_anim")
    return [g]

"""mt.templates.t4.nameplate_tags - Template 4: the two name-tag sprites of the 'nameplate' module.
  tag_a  ref R2:  dark glass panel with hexagon-cut ends (big cuts on the left), neon border, '</>' icon | divider | name + role,
                  three slanted stripes inside the bottom-right corner.
  tag_b  ref R10: chamfered panel with a faint second outline, icon | divider | NAME (white) + ROLE (neon colour) in capitals, a bright
                  bar on the bottom edge and five slanted stripes hanging below it.
Public: TAG_STYLES, T4_TAG, t4_tag_sprite(style, name, role, icon, color, font, scale, max_w) -> RGBA sprite | None.
Authored in px at short side 1080 (scale = short side / 1080). The sprite carries its own glow margin (about 30 px); the placement
code (nameplate.py) measures the visible ink, so the margin never counts against the 48 px safe area. Arabic / RTL text is shaped with
mt.fonts.shape and right-aligned in the text area; Latin text is left-aligned."""
import os
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

from mt.draw import t2_lighten, t2_rgb
from mt.fonts import default_font, is_rtl_text, load_font, shape
from mt.templates.t4.kit import chamfer_rect, connector, glass_panel, hazard_stripes, kit_paste, neon_icon, neon_stroke

TAG_STYLES = ("tag_a", "tag_b")
T4_TAG = {                                    # px at short side 1080; cut = chamfers (top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left)
    "tag_a": {"h": 124, "min_w": 440, "icon_w": 112, "icon": 58, "name": 38, "role": 26, "right": 104, "cut": (26, 16, 12, 26), "caps": False},
    "tag_b": {"h": 112, "min_w": 520, "icon_w": 108, "icon": 54, "name": 34, "role": 24, "right": 44, "cut": (24, 24, 24, 16), "caps": True},
}
GLOW_PAD = 30                                 # transparent margin around the panel (glow room), px at short side 1080
TINT = (5, 12, 30, 214)                       # panel fill (rgba): darker than the kit's default glass, as R2 / R10


def _is_bold(path):
    n = Path(str(path)).stem.lower().replace("-", "").replace(" ", "")
    return any(k in n for k in ("bold", "black", "heavy", "extrabold", "semibold"))


def _fade(sp, a):
    sp.putalpha(sp.getchannel("A").point(lambda v: int(v * a)))
    return sp


def _fit(lines, fp, sizes, avail):
    """Shrink both font sizes together (down to 55 %), then cut the widest line with '...' until it fits `avail` px.
    -> (fonts, shaped lines, widest width). An empty line is allowed (width 0)."""
    texts, k = [str(t) for t in lines], 1.0
    for _ in range(120):
        fonts = [load_font(fp, max(8, int(round(sz * k)))) for sz in sizes]
        shaped = [shape(t) for t in texts]
        ws = [f.getlength(t) if t else 0.0 for f, t in zip(fonts, shaped)]
        if max(ws) <= avail or max(len(t) for t in texts) <= 2:
            break
        if k > 0.55:
            k -= 0.05
        else:
            i = ws.index(max(ws))
            texts[i] = texts[i][:-2].rstrip() + "â€¦"
    return fonts, shaped, max(ws)


# ---- parts ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _panel(spr, style, w, H, g, col, s):
    """Glass panel + the style's extras (tag_a: stripes inside the corner; tag_b: outer outline, bottom bar, hanging stripes)."""
    sp = T4_TAG[style]
    cut = tuple(c * s for c in sp["cut"])
    if style == "tag_b":                                                # faint second outline, 8 px outside (R10's double border)
        d = 8 * s
        outer = neon_stroke(chamfer_rect((w + 2 * d, H + 2 * d), tuple(c + d for c in cut)), col, 1.4 * s, 5 * s)
        kit_paste(spr, _fade(outer, 0.45), g - d, g - d)
        ln = connector([(g + 44 * s, g + H + 9 * s), (g + w * 0.50, g + H + 9 * s)], col, False, 1.5 * s, 5 * s)
        kit_paste(spr, _fade(ln, 0.55), 0, 0)
    kit_paste(spr, glass_panel((w, H), 0, TINT, col, cut, 2.6 * s, 11 * s), g, g)
    if style == "tag_a":
        sw, sh = int(round(62 * s)), int(round(24 * s))
        kit_paste(spr, hazard_stripes((sw, sh), 35.0, col, 5, 10 * s, 6 * s), g + w - 24 * s - sw, g + H - 15 * s - sh)
    else:
        bar = connector([(g + w * 0.24, g + H), (g + w * 0.36, g + H)], t2_lighten(col, 0.30), False, 5 * s, 10 * s)
        kit_paste(spr, bar, 0, 0)
        sw, sh = int(round(116 * s)), int(round(18 * s))
        kit_paste(spr, hazard_stripes((sw, sh), 35.0, col, 5, 12 * s, 7 * s), g + w * 0.53, g + H - 4 * s)


def _emblem(spr, icon, left, H, g, col, s):
    """Neon icon centred in the left block + the thin vertical divider on its right edge. No icon -> nothing."""
    if not icon:
        return
    isz = int(round(T4_TAG["tag_a"]["icon"] * s))
    ic = neon_icon(icon, isz, col, 8 * s)
    kit_paste(spr, ic, g + left / 2.0 - isz / 2.0, g + H / 2.0 - isz / 2.0)
    x = g + left
    kit_paste(spr, connector([(x, g + H * 0.24), (x, g + H * 0.76)], t2_lighten(col, 0.15), False, 2.0 * s, 5 * s), 0, 0)


def _texts(spr, fonts, shaped, x0, x1, ymid, rtl, bold, fills, s):
    """Lines stacked and centred on ymid. LTR: left edge x0; RTL: right edge x1. Non-bold fonts get a thin same-colour stroke."""
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(spr)
    gap = 7 * s
    lines = [(f, t, c) for f, t, c in zip(fonts, shaped, fills) if t]
    total = sum(f.getmetrics()[0] + f.getmetrics()[1] for f, _, _ in lines) + gap * (len(lines) - 1)
    y = ymid - total / 2.0
    for i, (f, t, c) in enumerate(lines):
        asc, desc = f.getmetrics()
        sw = 1 if (i == 0 and not bold and f.size >= 24) else 0
        d.text((x1 if rtl else x0, y + asc), t, font=f, fill=c + (255,), anchor="rs" if rtl else "ls", stroke_width=sw, stroke_fill=c + (255,))
        y += asc + desc + gap


# ---- public -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def t4_tag_sprite(style, name, role="", icon="code", color="#19D3FF", font=None, scale=1.0, max_w=None):
    """RGBA sprite of a name tag, or None when name and role are both empty. Unknown style -> 'tag_a'. max_w = widest allowed PANEL (px):
    text shrinks, then is cut with '...'. sprite.info: panel (w, h in px), rtl. Never raises on odd text / colour / font values."""
    style = style if style in T4_TAG else "tag_a"
    sp = T4_TAG[style]
    name, role = str(name or "").strip(), str(role or "").strip()
    if not name and not role:
        return None
    if sp["caps"]:
        name, role = name.upper(), role.upper()
    s = max(0.2, float(scale))
    fp = font if font and os.path.isfile(str(font)) else default_font()
    col = t2_rgb(color)
    H, g = int(round(sp["h"] * s)), int(round(GLOW_PAD * s))
    left, right = int(round((sp["icon_w"] if icon else 34) * s)), int(round(sp["right"] * s))
    gapx = int(round(26 * s)) if icon else 0                              # divider -> text
    avail = (float(max_w) - left - gapx - right) if max_w else 10.0 ** 6
    fonts, shaped, tw = _fit([name, role], fp, (sp["name"] * s, sp["role"] * s), max(40.0, avail))
    w = int(max(sp["min_w"] * s, left + gapx + tw + right))
    if max_w:
        w = min(w, int(max_w))
    ext = int(round(14 * s)) if style == "tag_b" else 0
    spr = Image.new("RGBA", (w + 2 * g, H + ext + 2 * g), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    _panel(spr, style, w, H, g, col, s)
    _emblem(spr, icon, left, H, g, col, s)
    rtl = is_rtl_text(name + " " + role)
    role_col = t2_lighten(col, 0.15) if style == "tag_b" else (226, 234, 246)
    area0, area1 = g + left + gapx, g + w - right
    _texts(spr, fonts, shaped, area0, area1, g + H / 2.0, rtl, _is_bold(fp), [(255, 255, 255), role_col], s)
    spr.info["panel"], spr.info["rtl"] = (w, H), rtl
    return spr


====================================================================================================
FILE: mt\templates\t4\scenes_widgets.py

"""mt.templates.t4.scenes_widgets - Template 4 scenes: widget 'code_window' (refs R5 portrait / R6 landscape, measured in T4_P15_ADDENDUM).
[ red yellow green dots | tab: file icon + file name ]     tab bar (49 px at R5 size)
  1  def create_better_future():                           line numbers (gutter) + syntax-coloured monospace code
  2      return "Learn â€¢ Build â€¢ Grow"
spec keys (all optional): file 'main.py' (tab name; the extension picks the icon: .py / .js / .html / other), lang '' ('py' | 'js' | 'plain';
  '' = from the extension; python and javascript rules), code (str with \\n, or a list of lines; missing = the R5 demo snippet), font '' (path;
  '' = first monospace font found: Consolas, Cascadia Mono, Source Code Pro, Ubuntu Mono, Lucida Console, DejaVu Sans Mono, Courier New, else the
  default font), numbers True (line numbers), reveal 'none' | 'typewriter' (one Item per non-empty line, 'reveal' anim, staggered),
  line_step 0.35 (s between lines), line_dur 0.4 (s one line takes to be typed).
Everything scales with u = min(box.w / 434, box.h / 242) (R5 window = 434 x 242 px). The code font shrinks (down to 60 %) when a line is too
wide or there are too many lines; more lines than fit are cut with one t4_warn. Characters the monospace font lacks (the bullet) and Arabic
runs are drawn with the default font per run (Arabic shaped with mt.fonts.shape); the line stays left-aligned at the code column.
The static window (frame + tab + gutter) is ONE cached sprite. 'typewriter': the lines are NOT in it; they sit in sprite.info['lines'] =
[(line sprite, x, y)] (top-left in sprite coords) with info['line_step'] / ['line_dur'] and the engine adds one Item per line through
t4_widget_line_items(). Public: T4_CODE_WINDOW, t4_tokenize(line, lang), t4_code_window(spec, box, ctx), t4_widget_line_items(...),
