"""mt.templates.t4.kit_icons - Template 4 vector icons + the soft-erode helper shared with kit.py.
Every icon is drawn at 4x on an 'L' canvas and shrunk with LANCZOS (no jagged edges), then tinted by kit.icon().
Reused from mt.draw._draw_icon (drawn at 4x): code, phone, chip, shield. New here: laptop, gear, database, server,
cloud (upload arrow, as in R5), bulb, globe (lighter than the old one: its crowded strokes clogged at 96 px). Unknown names never raise: one t4_warn line + an empty icon."""
import math

from PIL import Image, ImageChops, ImageDraw, ImageFilter

from mt.draw import _draw_icon
from mt.templates.t4.warn import t4_warn

SS = 4
ICON_NAMES = ("code", "laptop", "phone", "gear", "globe", "database", "server", "cloud", "bulb", "chip", "shield")
_REUSED = ("code", "phone", "chip", "shield")


def soft_erode(L, d):
    """Coverage ('L') of the shape in L shrunk by d px - isotropic and anti-aliased (gaussian blur + soft threshold)."""
    if d <= 0:
        return L
    sigma = max(1.2, d / 1.1)
    z = d / sigma
    p = 0.5 * (1.0 + math.erf(z / math.sqrt(2.0)))
    slope = math.exp(-z * z / 2.0) / math.sqrt(2.0 * math.pi) / sigma          # d(blur)/d(px) at the edge
    b = L.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(sigma))
    return b.point(lambda v: int(255 * min(1.0, max(0.0, 0.5 + (v / 255.0 - p) / slope))))


class _Pen:
    """Unit-square pen on a big 'L' canvas: coordinates 0..1, stroke width w (unit), round caps / joints."""

    def __init__(self, S, w=0.075):
        self.S = S
        self.W = max(2, int(round(w * S)))
        self.im = Image.new("L", (S, S), 0)
        self.d = ImageDraw.Draw(self.im)

    def P(self, pts):
        return [(x * self.S, y * self.S) for x, y in pts]

    def line(self, pts, closed=False):
        P = self.P(pts + ([pts[0]] if closed else []))
        self.d.line(P, fill=255, width=self.W, joint="curve")
        r = self.W / 2.0
        for x, y in P:
            self.d.ellipse((x - r, y - r, x + r, y + r), fill=255)

    def dot(self, cx, cy, r, fill=255):
        S = self.S
        self.d.ellipse(((cx - r) * S, (cy - r) * S, (cx + r) * S, (cy + r) * S), fill=fill)

    def ring(self, cx, cy, r):
        S = self.S
        self.d.ellipse(((cx - r) * S, (cy - r) * S, (cx + r) * S, (cy + r) * S), outline=255, width=self.W)

    def rrect(self, box, rad):
        self.d.rounded_rectangle([v * self.S for v in box], radius=rad * self.S, outline=255, width=self.W)

    def arc(self, box, a0, a1):
        self.d.arc([v * self.S for v in box], a0, a1, fill=255, width=self.W)

    def fill_union(self, circles, rects):
        S = self.S
        for cx, cy, r in circles:
            self.d.ellipse(((cx - r) * S, (cy - r) * S, (cx + r) * S, (cy + r) * S), fill=255)
        for x0, y0, x1, y1 in rects:
            self.d.rectangle((x0 * S, y0 * S, x1 * S, y1 * S), fill=255)


def _arc_pts(cx, cy, r, a0, a1, n=48):
    return [(cx + r * math.cos(math.radians(a0 + (a1 - a0) * i / n)),
             cy + r * math.sin(math.radians(a0 + (a1 - a0) * i / n))) for i in range(n + 1)]


def _laptop(S):
    p = _Pen(S, 0.07)
    p.rrect((0.20, 0.20, 0.80, 0.64), 0.04)
    p.line([(0.08, 0.77), (0.92, 0.77)])
    p.line([(0.40, 0.77), (0.44, 0.71), (0.56, 0.71), (0.60, 0.77)])
    return p.im


def _gear(S):
    p = _Pen(S, 0.07)
    n, R, r = 8, 0.43, 0.32
    per = 2 * math.pi / n
    pts = []
    for k in range(n):
        c = k * per
        for rr, off in ((r, -0.30), (R, -0.17), (R, 0.17), (r, 0.30)):
            a = c + off * per
            pts.append((0.5 + rr * math.cos(a), 0.5 + rr * math.sin(a)))
    p.line(pts, closed=True)
    p.ring(0.5, 0.5, 0.13)
    return p.im


def _database(S):
    p = _Pen(S, 0.07)
    p.d.ellipse((0.20 * S, 0.12 * S, 0.80 * S, 0.30 * S), outline=255, width=p.W)
    p.line([(0.20, 0.21), (0.20, 0.79)])
    p.line([(0.80, 0.21), (0.80, 0.79)])
    for top in (0.32, 0.52, 0.70):
        p.arc((0.20, top, 0.80, top + 0.18), 0, 180)
    return p.im


def _server(S):
    p = _Pen(S, 0.06)
    for y0 in (0.12, 0.39, 0.66):
        p.rrect((0.12, y0, 0.88, y0 + 0.22), 0.04)
        p.dot(0.27, y0 + 0.11, 0.032)
        p.dot(0.39, y0 + 0.11, 0.032)
        p.line([(0.62, y0 + 0.11), (0.76, y0 + 0.11)])
    return p.im


def _cloud(S):
    p = _Pen(S, 0.075)
    big = Image.new("L", (S, S), 0)
    q = _Pen(S)
    q.im, q.d = big, ImageDraw.Draw(big)
    q.fill_union([(0.27, 0.60, 0.17), (0.47, 0.42, 0.22), (0.72, 0.58, 0.18)], [(0.27, 0.58, 0.72, 0.77)])
    ring = ImageChops.subtract(big, soft_erode(big, p.W))
    p.im = ring
    p.d = ImageDraw.Draw(ring)
    p.line([(0.49, 0.66), (0.49, 0.42)])
    p.line([(0.40, 0.50), (0.49, 0.41), (0.58, 0.50)])
    return p.im


def _bulb(S):
    p = _Pen(S, 0.07)
    arc = _arc_pts(0.5, 0.40, 0.27, 125, 415)
    p.line(arc + [(0.59, 0.73), (0.41, 0.73)], closed=True)
    p.line([(0.42, 0.85), (0.58, 0.85)])
    p.line([(0.43, 0.56), (0.5, 0.47), (0.57, 0.56)])
    p.line([(0.5, 0.47), (0.5, 0.73)])
    return p.im


def _globe(S):
    p = _Pen(S, 0.06)
    p.ring(0.5, 0.5, 0.40)
    p.d.ellipse((0.33 * S, 0.10 * S, 0.67 * S, 0.90 * S), outline=255, width=p.W)
    p.line([(0.10, 0.5), (0.90, 0.5)])
    p.line([(0.5, 0.10), (0.5, 0.90)])
    p.line([(0.17, 0.30), (0.83, 0.30)])
    p.line([(0.17, 0.70), (0.83, 0.70)])
    return p.im


_NEW = {"globe": _globe, "laptop": _laptop, "gear": _gear, "database": _database, "server": _server, "cloud": _cloud, "bulb": _bulb}


def icon_mask(name, size):
    """White-on-black 'L' mask (size x size) of icon `name`, anti-aliased. Unknown name -> empty mask + one warning."""
    size = max(4, int(round(size)))
    S = size * SS
    if name in _NEW:
        big = _NEW[name](S)
    elif name in _REUSED:
        rgba = Image.new("RGBA", (S, S), (0, 0, 0, 0))
        _draw_icon(rgba, name, (0, 0, S, S))
        big = rgba.getchannel("A")
    else:
        t4_warn("t4 icon: unknown name %r (known: %s)" % (name, ", ".join(ICON_NAMES)))
        big = Image.new("L", (S, S), 0)
    return big.resize((size, size), Image.LANCZOS)


================================================================================
##### FILE: mt\templates\t4\nameplate.py #####
================================================================================
"""mt.templates.t4.nameplate - Template 4 modules 'nameplate' (name tag, styles tag_a = ref R2 / tag_b = ref R10) and 'corner_list'
(ref R10: laptop icon in one bottom corner + a 3-row icon list in the other). Both are timed + animated overlay ITEMS (one sprite each,
drawn above the frame plate) - not part of the static foreground plate.
cfg['t4']['nameplate'] = {on, style 'tag_a'|'tag_b', name, role, icon, color, anchor, inset_x, inset_y, start|trigger, end|hold, anim, anim_dur}
cfg['t4']['corner_list'] = {on, color, icon ('laptop' | kit icon | '' = none), icon_anchor, anchor, rows [{icon, text}], size, inset_x, inset_y,
                            start|trigger, end|hold, anim, anim_dur}
  anchor     top-left | top-right | bottom-left | bottom-right (default: tag_a bottom-left, tag_b top-left, list bottom-right, laptop bottom-left).
  inset_x/y  extra px (short side 1080) inward from the corner margin.
  timing     as t4/timing.t4_time: `trigger` (spoken phrase in the captions) or `start` (default 0); `end` or `hold` (tag default 5 s; list
             default = to the end of the video); trigger not found -> one warning, skipped.
  anim       'auto' (default: slides in from its own side) | none | any mt.anim name; anim_dur seconds (default 0.45).
Placement: the VISIBLE ink (alpha > 24, glow tails included) sits at least 48 px (short side 1080) from every canvas edge. Frame on (cfg['t4']['frame']):
the item is moved along the vertical (down from a top corner, up from a bottom one) just far enough that its ink keeps ~10 px away from every
solid frame pixel (brackets, hazard stripes, tab, icon) - measured against the real frame plate, so a frame redesign needs no change here.
Public: T4_NAMEPLATE, T4_CORNER_LIST, t4_nameplate_cfg(raw), t4_corner_list_cfg(raw), t4_nameplate_items(cfg, duration), t4_ask_nameplate(), t4_ask_corner_list()."""
import copy
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image, ImageChops, ImageFilter

from mt.anim import ANIMS, PRESETS
from mt.ask import ask_anim
from mt.captions import caption_streams, parse_srt
from mt.common import ask, ask_choice, c_color, c_float, yn
from mt.draw import Item
from mt.fonts import default_font, t2_font
from mt.templates.t4.cfg import _hex
from mt.templates.t4.frame import t4_frame_cfg, t4_frame_plate
from mt.templates.t4.kit_icons import ICON_NAMES
from mt.templates.t4.nameplate_list import LIST_ICONS, T4_LIST, t4_laptop_sprite, t4_list_sprite
from mt.templates.t4.nameplate_tags import TAG_STYLES, t4_tag_sprite
from mt.templates.t4.timing import t4_ask_when, t4_time
from mt.templates.t4.warn import t4_warn

T4_SAFE = 48                                       # px at short side 1080: no ink closer than this to a canvas edge
INK_THR, FRAME_THR, GAP = 24, 60, 10               # sprite alpha = ink | frame alpha = solid | px kept between ink and frame
CORNERS = ("top-left", "top-right", "bottom-left", "bottom-right")
STYLE_ANCHOR = {"tag_a": "bottom-left", "tag_b": "top-left"}             # R2 / R10
DEFAULT_ROWS = [{"icon": "globe", "text": "Web Development"}, {"icon": "phone", "text": "Mobile Development"},
                {"icon": "gear", "text": "Tech Content Creator"}]
MAX_ROWS = 5
_COMMON = {"on": False, "color": "#19D3FF", "inset_x": 0.0, "inset_y": 0.0, "start": 0.0, "trigger": "", "end": None, "hold": None,
           "anim": "auto", "anim_dur": 0.45}
T4_NAMEPLATE = dict(_COMMON, style="tag_a", name="Ahmed Ibrahim", role="Full Stack Developer", icon="code", anchor="bottom-left")
T4_CORNER_LIST = dict(_COMMON, icon="laptop", icon_anchor="bottom-left", anchor="bottom-right", rows=DEFAULT_ROWS, size=22.0)
_OFF = ("", "none", "off", "false", "no", "0", "-")
_ALIAS = {"tl": "top-left", "tr": "top-right", "bl": "bottom-left", "br": "bottom-right", "left-top": "top-left",
          "right-top": "top-right", "left-bottom": "bottom-left", "right-bottom": "bottom-right"}


# ---- config -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _bool(v, default):
    if isinstance(v, str):
        return default if not v.strip() else v.strip().lower() not in _OFF
    return default if v is None else bool(v)


def _flt(v, lo, hi, default):
    try:
        x = float(v)
    except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError):
        return default
    return x if not isinstance(v, bool) and lo <= x <= hi else default           # nan fails the comparison -> default


def _anchor(v, default):
    s = str(v).strip().lower().replace("_", "-").replace(" ", "-") if isinstance(v, (str, int)) and not isinstance(v, bool) else ""
    s = _ALIAS.get(PRESETS.get(s, s), PRESETS.get(s, s))
    return s if s in CORNERS else default


def _anim(v):
    s = v.strip().lower() if isinstance(v, str) else ""
    s = "reveal" if s == "typewriter" else s
    return s if s in ANIMS or s in ("none", "auto") else "auto"


def _icon(v, default):
    if v is False:
        return ""
    return ("" if v.strip().lower() in _OFF else v.strip().lower()) if isinstance(v, str) else default


def _common(raw, out, anchor):
    """Fields both modules share: on, colour, anchor, insets, timing (start / trigger / end / hold) and animation."""
    out["on"] = _bool(raw.get("on"), False)
    out["color"] = _hex(raw.get("color"), out["color"])
    out["anchor"] = _anchor(raw.get("anchor"), anchor)
    out["inset_x"], out["inset_y"] = _flt(raw.get("inset_x"), 0, 600, 0.0), _flt(raw.get("inset_y"), 0, 600, 0.0)
    trig = raw.get("trigger")
    out["trigger"] = trig.strip() if isinstance(trig, str) else ""
    out["start"] = raw["start"] if raw.get("start") is not None else (None if out["trigger"] else 0.0)    # a phrase never falls back to 0
    out["end"], out["hold"] = raw.get("end"), raw.get("hold")
    out["anim"] = _anim(raw.get("anim"))
    out["anim_dur"] = _flt(raw.get("anim_dur"), 0.0, 5.0, 0.45)


def _style(v):
    s = str(v).strip().lower().replace("-", "_") if isinstance(v, (str, int)) and not isinstance(v, bool) else ""
    return {"tag_b": "tag_b", "b": "tag_b", "2": "tag_b", "tagb": "tag_b"}.get(s, "tag_a")


def t4_nameplate_cfg(raw):
    """Normalise cfg['t4']['nameplate'] -> complete dict (extra keys such as 'font' survive). Never raises; junk -> defaults."""
    out = dict(T4_NAMEPLATE)
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        return out
    try:
        out.update({k: v for k, v in raw.items() if k not in out})
        out["style"] = _style(raw.get("style"))
        for k in ("name", "role"):
            v = raw.get(k)
            if isinstance(v, str):
                out[k] = "" if v.strip().lower() in ("-", "none") else v.strip()[:60]
        out["icon"] = _icon(raw.get("icon"), T4_NAMEPLATE["icon"])
        _common(raw, out, STYLE_ANCHOR[out["style"]])
    except Exception:
        return dict(T4_NAMEPLATE)
    return out


def _rows(v):
    """[{'icon', 'text'} | ('icon', 'text') | 'text' | 'icon|text'] -> clean rows (<= 5). Nothing usable -> the three R10 rows."""
    out = []
    for i, r in enumerate(v[:MAX_ROWS] if isinstance(v, (list, tuple)) else []):
        ic, tx = None, None
        if isinstance(r, dict):
            ic, tx = r.get("icon"), r.get("text")
        elif isinstance(r, (list, tuple)) and len(r) == 2:
            ic, tx = r
        elif isinstance(r, str):
            head, _, tail = r.partition("|")
            ic, tx = (head, tail) if tail and head.strip().lower() in ICON_NAMES else (None, r)
        tx = tx.strip()[:40] if isinstance(tx, str) else ""
        if tx:
            out.append({"icon": _icon(ic, LIST_ICONS[len(out) % len(LIST_ICONS)]), "text": tx})
    return out or copy.deepcopy(DEFAULT_ROWS)


def t4_corner_list_cfg(raw):
    """Normalise cfg['t4']['corner_list'] -> complete dict. Never raises; junk -> defaults (rows: the three R10 rows)."""
    out = copy.deepcopy(T4_CORNER_LIST)
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        return out
    try:
        out.update({k: copy.deepcopy(v) for k, v in raw.items() if k not in out})
        out["icon"] = _icon(raw.get("icon"), "laptop")
        out["icon_anchor"] = _anchor(raw.get("icon_anchor"), "bottom-left")
        out["rows"] = _rows(raw.get("rows"))
        out["size"] = _flt(raw.get("size"), 8, 120, 22.0)
        _common(raw, out, "bottom-right")
    except Exception:
        return copy.deepcopy(T4_CORNER_LIST)
    return out


# ---- placement --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
_FM, _SPR = {}, {}


def _cached(cache, key, make, limit=12):
    if key not in cache:
        if len(cache) >= limit:
            cache.pop(next(iter(cache)))
        cache[key] = make()
    return cache[key]


def _frame_mask(W, H, fcfg, s):
    """Quarter-size 'L' mask of where the frame is solid, grown by GAP px (conservative). None when the frame is off."""
    if not fcfg["on"]:
        return None

    def make():
        a = t4_frame_plate(W, H, fcfg).getchannel("A").point(lambda v: 255 if v > FRAME_THR else 0)
        q = a.resize(((W + 3) // 4, (H + 3) // 4), Image.BOX).point(lambda v: 255 if v > 0 else 0)
        return q.filter(ImageFilter.MaxFilter(2 * int(math.ceil((GAP * s + 4) / 4.0)) + 1))
    return _cached(_FM, (W, H, round(s, 3), repr(sorted(fcfg.items()))), make, 4)


def _ink_box(spr):
    return spr.getchannel("A").point(lambda v: 255 if v > INK_THR else 0).getbbox()


def _pooled(spr, box):
    """Quarter-size ink mask of the sprite (cropped to its ink), grown by one cell so a placement that is not a multiple of 4 px stays safe."""
    a = spr.getchannel("A").crop(box).point(lambda v: 255 if v > INK_THR else 0)
    q = a.resize((max(1, (a.width + 3) // 4), max(1, (a.height + 3) // 4)), Image.BOX).point(lambda v: 255 if v > 0 else 0)
    padded = Image.new("L", (q.width + 2, q.height + 2), 0)             # 1 cell of room on every side, then grow by 1 cell
    padded.paste(q, (1, 1))
    return padded.filter(ImageFilter.MaxFilter(3))


def _hits(fm, q, x, y):
    qx, qy = int(x // 4), int(y // 4)
    return ImageChops.multiply(fm.crop((qx - 1, qy - 1, qx - 1 + q.width, qy - 1 + q.height)), q).getbbox() is not None


def _place(spr, anchor, W, H, s, inx, iny, fm, label):
    """Item centre for `spr` anchored at a corner -> (cx, cy, ink rect on the canvas, moved px) or None for an empty sprite.
    Ink at the 48 px safe margin (+ inset); with a frame mask: moved vertically (down from the top, up from the bottom) until clear."""
    box = _ink_box(spr)
    if box is None:
        return None
    w, h = box[2] - box[0], box[3] - box[1]
    m = T4_SAFE * s
    sx = 1 if anchor.endswith("left") else -1 if anchor.endswith("right") else 0          # inward direction; 0 = centred on that axis
    sy = 1 if anchor.startswith("top") else -1 if anchor.startswith("bottom") else 0     # (the 4 corners behave exactly as before)
    x = m + inx * s if sx > 0 else W - m - inx * s - w if sx < 0 else (W - w) / 2.0
    y = m + iny * s if sy > 0 else H - m - iny * s - h if sy < 0 else (H - h) / 2.0
    x, y = int(round(min(max(x, m), W - m - w))), int(round(min(max(y, m), H - m - h)))
    moved = 0
    if fm is not None:
        dx, dy = _clear_shift(fm, _pooled(spr, box), x, y, sx, sy, W, H, s)
        if dx is None:
            t4_warn("%s: no free place next to the frame in the %s corner - kept at the safe margin." % (label, anchor))
        else:
            x, y, moved = x + dx, y + dy, abs(dx) + abs(dy)
    return x - box[0] + spr.width / 2.0, y - box[1] + spr.height / 2.0, (x, y, x + w, y + h), moved


def _clear_shift(fm, q, x, y, sx, sy, W, H, s):
    """Smallest inward shift (dx toward the canvas centre horizontally first, then dy vertically) that leaves the sprite clear of the
    frame mask -> (dx, dy), or (None, None). Rails run the full side height, so a horizontal step is tried before a vertical one."""
    step = max(2, int(round(4 * s)))
    nx, ny = int(180 * s) // step, int(H * 0.45) // step
    for c in range(0, nx + ny + 1):                                     # total shift in steps: the cheapest clear place wins
        for i in range(max(0, c - ny), min(c, nx) + 1):                 # i steps inward horizontally, c - i vertically
            dx, dy = i * step, (c - i) * step
            xx, yy = x + sx * dx, y + sy * dy
            if xx < 0 or yy < 0 or xx + q.width * 4 > W + 8 or yy + q.height * 4 > H + 8:
                continue
            if not _hits(fm, q, xx, yy):
                return sx * dx, sy * dy
    return None, None


# ---- items ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _font(path):
    if path and os.path.isfile(str(path)):
        return str(path)
    if path:
        t4_warn("t4 nameplate: font '%s' not found - using the default bold font." % Path(str(path)).name)
    p = t2_font("arabic", "ع")[0]
    return p if p and os.path.isfile(p) else default_font()


def _cues(cfg):
    out = []
    for c in caption_streams(cfg):
        try:
            out.append(parse_srt(c["srt"]))
        except Exception:
            continue
    return out


def _window(cfg, entry, label, duration, default_hold):
    return t4_time(dict(entry, label=label), _cues(cfg) if entry.get("trigger") else None, duration, default_hold)


def _item(spr, win, anchor, c, W, H, s, fm, label, placed, duration):
    pos = _place(spr, anchor, W, H, s, c["inset_x"], c["inset_y"], fm, label)
    if pos is None:
        return None
    cx, cy, rect, _ = pos
    placed.append((label, rect))
    anim = c["anim"] if c["anim"] != "auto" else ("slide_right" if anchor.endswith("left") else "slide_left")
    persistent = win[1] >= float(duration) - 0.01                       # lasts to the end of the video -> no fade-out at the very end
    return Item(spr, win[0], win[1], cx, cy, anim, c["anim_dur"], out=not persistent, rtl=bool(spr.info.get("rtl")))


def _tag_items(cfg, c, duration, W, H, s, fm, placed):
    label = "name tag '%s'" % (c["name"] or c["role"])[:30]
    win = _window(cfg, c, label, duration, 5.0)
    if win is None:
        return []
    icon = c["icon"]
    if icon and icon not in ICON_NAMES:
        t4_warn("%s: icon '%s' unknown (use one of: %s) - no icon." % (label, icon, ", ".join(ICON_NAMES)))
        icon = ""
    # widest panel: canvas - safe margin - glow tails (~30 px) on both sides; frame on: +36 px each side so the tag can still clear the rails
    fp, max_w = _font(c.get("font")), W - 2 * (T4_SAFE + 30 + (36 if fm is not None else 0)) * s
    spr = _cached(_SPR, ("tag", c["style"], c["name"], c["role"], icon, c["color"], fp, W, H),
                  lambda: t4_tag_sprite(c["style"], c["name"], c["role"], icon, c["color"], fp, s, max_w))
    if spr is None:
        t4_warn("%s: name and role are both empty - skipped." % label)
        return []
    it = _item(spr, win, c["anchor"], c, W, H, s, fm, label, placed, duration)
    return [it] if it else []


def _list_items(cfg, c, duration, W, H, s, fm, placed):
    win = _window(cfg, c, "corner list", duration, None)
    if win is None:
        return []
    out, fp = [], _font(c.get("font"))
    if c["icon"]:
        lap = _cached(_SPR, ("lap", c["icon"], c["color"], W, H), lambda: t4_laptop_sprite(c["icon"], T4_LIST["laptop_w"], c["color"], s))
        out.append(_item(lap, win, c["icon_anchor"], c, W, H, s, fm, "corner list icon", placed, duration))
    key = ("list", repr(c["rows"]), c["size"], c["color"], fp, W, H)
    lst = _cached(_SPR, key, lambda: t4_list_sprite(c["rows"], c["size"], c["color"], fp, s, (W - 2 * T4_SAFE * s) * 0.6))
    out.append(_item(lst, win, c["anchor"], c, W, H, s, fm, "corner list", placed, duration))
    return [i for i in out if i]


def _warn_overlaps(placed):
    for i, (a, ra) in enumerate(placed):
        for b, rb in placed[i + 1:]:
            if ra[0] < rb[2] and rb[0] < ra[2] and ra[1] < rb[3] and rb[1] < ra[3]:
                t4_warn("%s and %s overlap - give one of them another corner (anchor) or an inset." % (a, b))


def t4_nameplate_items(cfg, duration):
    """Items of the name tag and the corner list (each one sprite, timed + animated); [] when both are off. Never raises."""
    t4 = cfg.get("t4") if isinstance(cfg, dict) and isinstance(cfg.get("t4"), dict) else {}
    tag, lst = t4_nameplate_cfg(t4.get("nameplate")), t4_corner_list_cfg(t4.get("corner_list"))
    if not (tag["on"] or lst["on"]):
        return []
    try:
        W, H = int(cfg["canvas"][0]), int(cfg["canvas"][1])
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, IndexError):
        t4_warn("t4 nameplate: the job has no canvas - skipped.")
        return []
    s = min(W, H) / 1080.0
    placed, items = [], []
    try:
        fm = _frame_mask(W, H, t4_frame_cfg(t4.get("frame")), s)
        if tag["on"]:
            items += _tag_items(cfg, tag, duration, W, H, s, fm, placed)
        if lst["on"]:
            items += _list_items(cfg, lst, duration, W, H, s, fm, placed)
        _warn_overlaps(placed)
    except Exception as e:
        t4_warn("t4 nameplate: could not be drawn (%s: %s) - skipped." % (type(e).__name__, e))
    return items


# ---- questions --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _ask_corner(prompt, default, key, allow_none=False):
    """Corner question -> 'top-left' | ... (or '' for 'none' when allowed)."""
    labels = (["None (hide it)"] if allow_none else []) + ["Top-left", "Top-right", "Bottom-left", "Bottom-right"]
    n = ask_choice(prompt, labels, default=CORNERS.index(default) + 1 + (1 if allow_none else 0), key=key) - (1 if allow_none else 0)
    return CORNERS[n - 1] if n >= 1 else ""


def _ask_motion(prompt, corner, key, whole_video):
    """Timing + animation questions -> dict(start|trigger, hold?, anim, anim_dur). whole_video: offer 'keep it for the whole video' first."""
    if whole_video and yn("Keep the %s on screen for the whole video?" % prompt, default=True):
        out = {"start": 0.0}
    else:
        out = t4_ask_when(prompt.capitalize(), 5.0, key=key + "_when")
    out["anim"] = ask_anim("%s animation" % prompt.capitalize(), default="slide_right" if (corner or "left").endswith("left") else "slide_left",
                           key=key + "_anim")
    out["anim_dur"] = ask("Animation duration (seconds)", default=0.45, key=key + "_adur", cast=c_float)
    return out


def t4_ask_nameplate():
    """Question group 'nameplate' (called by t4_ask_config). -> the dict for cfg['t4']['nameplate']."""
    if not yn("Add a name tag (name + role - references R2 / R10)?", default=False):
        return {"on": False}
    st = ask_choice("Tag style:", ["tag_a - hexagon-cut glass panel, code icon | name + role, stripes in the corner (R2)",
                                   "tag_b - chamfered panel, capitals, bright bar + stripes on the bottom edge (R10)"],
                    default=1, key="t4_np_style")
    style = TAG_STYLES[st - 1]
    d = T4_NAMEPLATE
    clean = lambda s: "" if s.strip() in ("-", "none") else s.strip()
    name = ask("Name (Arabic works too)", default=d["name"], key="t4_np_name", cast=clean)
    role = ask("Role / subtitle ('-' = none)", default=d["role"], key="t4_np_role", cast=clean)
    ic = ask_choice("Icon in the tag:", ["None"] + list(ICON_NAMES), default=2, key="t4_np_icon")
    color = ask("Tag colour (hex or name)", default=d["color"], key="t4_np_color", cast=c_color)
    anchor = _ask_corner("Corner:", STYLE_ANCHOR[style], "t4_np_corner_" + style)
    out = {"on": True, "style": style, "name": name, "role": role, "icon": "" if ic == 1 else ICON_NAMES[ic - 2], "color": color, "anchor": anchor}
    out.update(_ask_motion("name tag", anchor, "t4_np", whole_video=False))
    return out


def t4_ask_corner_list():
    """Question group 'corner_list' (called by t4_ask_config). -> the dict for cfg['t4']['corner_list']."""
    if not yn("Add the corner list (laptop icon + service rows - reference R10)?", default=False):
        return {"on": False}
    d = T4_CORNER_LIST
    rows = []
    for i, r in enumerate(DEFAULT_ROWS, 1):
        v = ask("Row %d: text, or icon|text (icons: %s; '-' = no row)" % (i, ", ".join(ICON_NAMES)), default="%s|%s" % (r["icon"], r["text"]),
                key="t4_cl_row%d" % i, cast=lambda s: s.strip())
        if v and v != "-":
            rows.append(v)
    laptop = _ask_corner("Laptop icon corner:", d["icon_anchor"], "t4_cl_icon_corner", allow_none=True)
    anchor = _ask_corner("List corner:", d["anchor"], "t4_cl_corner")
    color = ask("Colour (hex or name)", default=d["color"], key="t4_cl_color", cast=c_color)
    out = {"on": True, "rows": rows, "icon": "laptop" if laptop else "", "icon_anchor": laptop or d["icon_anchor"], "anchor": anchor, "color": color}
    out.update(_ask_motion("corner list", anchor, "t4_cl", whole_video=True))
    return out


================================================================================
##### FILE: mt\templates\t4\nameplate_list.py #####
================================================================================
"""mt.templates.t4.nameplate_list - Template 4: the two sprites of the 'corner_list' module (ref R10, bottom corners).
  laptop  a thin neon laptop (screen outline + keyboard deck) with a glowing '</>' on the screen. Any other kit icon name gives
          that icon as a plain neon icon instead.
  list    up to 5 rows: neon icon + small white text (soft dark shadow so it reads on a bright video). R10 has 3 rows.
Public: LIST_ICONS, T4_LIST, t4_laptop_sprite(icon, width, color, scale), t4_list_sprite(rows, size, color, font, scale, max_w).
Authored in px at short side 1080 (scale = short side / 1080); each sprite has a ~14-26 px glow margin that the placement code
ignores (it measures the visible ink). Arabic / RTL rows are mirrored: icon on the right, text right-aligned."""
import os

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter

from mt.draw import t2_paint, t2_poly_mask, t2_rgb
from mt.fonts import default_font, is_rtl_text, load_font, shape
from mt.templates.t4.kit import connector, kit_paste, neon_icon

LIST_ICONS = ("globe", "phone", "gear", "database", "cloud")           # row icon by position when a row names none
T4_LIST = {"size": 22, "laptop_w": 172, "pitch": 1.75, "icon": 1.38, "gap": 0.72, "pad": 14}   # pitch / icon / gap in font sizes


def _closed(pts):
    return pts + [pts[0]]


def t4_laptop_sprite(icon="laptop", width=172, color="#19D3FF", scale=1.0):
    """Neon laptop of the given width (px at short side 1080) with '</>' on its screen. icon != 'laptop' -> that kit icon, neon, as is."""
    s = max(0.2, float(scale))
    W, col = max(24, int(round(float(width) * s))), t2_rgb(color)
    if icon != "laptop":
        return neon_icon(icon or "code", max(16, int(W * 0.7)), col)
    g, Hh = int(round(26 * s)), int(round(W * 0.68))
    spr = Image.new("RGBA", (W + 2 * g, Hh + 2 * g), (0, 0, 0, 0))

    def P(pts):
        return [(g + x * W, g + y * Hh) for x, y in pts]
    c = 0.035
    screen = [(0.10 + c, 0.0), (0.90 - c, 0.0), (0.90, 0.045), (0.90, 0.66), (0.10, 0.66), (0.10, 0.045)]
    t2_paint(spr, t2_poly_mask(P(screen)), (4, 12, 30), 0.60)                                   # dark glass behind the glyph
    deck = [(0.13, 0.72), (0.87, 0.72), (1.0, 1.0), (0.0, 1.0)]
    for pts, w in ((_closed(screen), 3.4), (_closed(deck), 3.0), ([(0.22, 0.80), (0.78, 0.80)], 1.8), ([(0.17, 0.88), (0.83, 0.88)], 1.8),
                   ([(0.42, 0.945), (0.58, 0.945)], 2.4)):
        kit_paste(spr, connector(P(pts), col, False, w * s, 9 * s), 0, 0)
    isz = int(round(W * 0.34))
    kit_paste(spr, neon_icon("code", isz, col, 6 * s), g + W * 0.5 - isz / 2.0, g + Hh * 0.33 - isz / 2.0)
    return spr


def _fit_rows(rows, fp, size, avail):
    """Shrink the text size (down to 60 %) then cut the longest row with '...' until icon + gap + text fit `avail`. -> (font, shaped, widths, size)."""
    texts, k = [r["text"] for r in rows], 1.0
    for _ in range(120):
        f = load_font(fp, max(8, int(round(size * k))))
        shaped = [shape(t) for t in texts]
        ws = [f.getlength(t) for t in shaped]
        room = avail - (size * k * (T4_LIST["icon"] + T4_LIST["gap"]))
        if max(ws) <= room or max(len(t) for t in texts) <= 2:
            break
        if k > 0.6:
            k -= 0.05
        else:
            i = ws.index(max(ws))
            texts[i] = texts[i][:-2].rstrip() + "…"
    return f, shaped, ws, size * k


def t4_list_sprite(rows, size=22, color="#19D3FF", font=None, scale=1.0, max_w=None):
    """rows = [{'icon': kit icon name | '', 'text': str}] -> RGBA sprite, or None for no rows. max_w = widest allowed block (px).
    sprite.info: rows (int), rtl (any row is RTL). Never raises on odd values."""
    rows = [r for r in (rows or []) if isinstance(r, dict) and str(r.get("text", "")).strip()]
    if not rows:
        return None
    s = max(0.2, float(scale))
    fp = font if font and os.path.isfile(str(font)) else default_font()
    col = t2_rgb(color)
    f, shaped, ws, sz = _fit_rows(rows, fp, float(size) * s, float(max_w) if max_w else 10.0 ** 6)
    isz, gap, pitch, pad = int(round(sz * T4_LIST["icon"])), sz * T4_LIST["gap"], sz * T4_LIST["pitch"], int(round(T4_LIST["pad"] * s))
    bw = int(max(w + isz + gap for w in ws))
    spr = Image.new("RGBA", (bw + 2 * pad, int(pitch * (len(rows) - 1) + isz) + 2 * pad), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    ink = Image.new("L", spr.size, 0)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(ink)
    asc, desc = f.getmetrics()
    anyrtl = False
    for i, (r, t, w) in enumerate(zip(rows, shaped, ws)):
        cy = pad + isz / 2.0 + i * pitch
        rtl = is_rtl_text(str(r["text"]))
        anyrtl = anyrtl or rtl
        if r.get("icon"):
            ic = neon_icon(r["icon"], isz, col, max(3.0, isz * 0.16))
            kit_paste(spr, ic, pad + (bw - isz if rtl else 0), cy - isz / 2.0)
        x = pad + (bw - isz - gap if rtl else isz + gap)
        d.text((x, cy + (asc - desc) / 2.0), t, font=f, fill=255, anchor="rs" if rtl else "ls")
    t2_paint(spr, (ink.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(max(1.5, sz * 0.11))).point(lambda v: min(255, int(v * 1.8))), (0, 0)), (0, 0, 0), 0.7)
    t2_paint(spr, (ink, (0, 0)), (255, 255, 255))
    spr.info["rows"], spr.info["rtl"] = len(rows), anyrtl
    return spr


================================================================================
##### FILE: mt\templates\t4\nameplate_tags.py #####
================================================================================
"""mt.templates.t4.nameplate_tags - Template 4: the two name-tag sprites of the 'nameplate' module.
  tag_a  ref R2:  dark glass panel with hexagon-cut ends (big cuts on the left), neon border, '</>' icon | divider | name + role,
                  three slanted stripes inside the bottom-right corner.
  tag_b  ref R10: chamfered panel with a faint second outline, icon | divider | NAME (white) + ROLE (neon colour) in capitals, a bright
                  bar on the bottom edge and five slanted stripes hanging below it.
Public: TAG_STYLES, T4_TAG, t4_tag_sprite(style, name, role, icon, color, font, scale, max_w) -> RGBA sprite | None.
Authored in px at short side 1080 (scale = short side / 1080). The sprite carries its own glow margin (about 30 px); the placement
code (nameplate.py) measures the visible ink, so the margin never counts against the 48 px safe area. Arabic / RTL text is shaped with
mt.fonts.shape and right-aligned in the text area; Latin text is left-aligned."""
import os
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

from mt.draw import t2_lighten, t2_rgb
from mt.fonts import default_font, is_rtl_text, load_font, shape
from mt.templates.t4.kit import chamfer_rect, connector, glass_panel, hazard_stripes, kit_paste, neon_icon, neon_stroke

TAG_STYLES = ("tag_a", "tag_b")
T4_TAG = {                                    # px at short side 1080; cut = chamfers (top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left)
    "tag_a": {"h": 124, "min_w": 440, "icon_w": 112, "icon": 58, "name": 38, "role": 26, "right": 104, "cut": (26, 16, 12, 26), "caps": False},
    "tag_b": {"h": 112, "min_w": 520, "icon_w": 108, "icon": 54, "name": 34, "role": 24, "right": 44, "cut": (24, 24, 24, 16), "caps": True},
}
GLOW_PAD = 30                                 # transparent margin around the panel (glow room), px at short side 1080
TINT = (5, 12, 30, 214)                       # panel fill (rgba): darker than the kit's default glass, as R2 / R10


def _is_bold(path):
    n = Path(str(path)).stem.lower().replace("-", "").replace(" ", "")
    return any(k in n for k in ("bold", "black", "heavy", "extrabold", "semibold"))


def _fade(sp, a):
    sp.putalpha(sp.getchannel("A").point(lambda v: int(v * a)))
    return sp


def _fit(lines, fp, sizes, avail):
    """Shrink both font sizes together (down to 55 %), then cut the widest line with '...' until it fits `avail` px.
    -> (fonts, shaped lines, widest width). An empty line is allowed (width 0)."""
    texts, k = [str(t) for t in lines], 1.0
    for _ in range(120):
        fonts = [load_font(fp, max(8, int(round(sz * k)))) for sz in sizes]
        shaped = [shape(t) for t in texts]
        ws = [f.getlength(t) if t else 0.0 for f, t in zip(fonts, shaped)]
        if max(ws) <= avail or max(len(t) for t in texts) <= 2:
            break
        if k > 0.55:
            k -= 0.05
        else:
            i = ws.index(max(ws))
            texts[i] = texts[i][:-2].rstrip() + "…"
    return fonts, shaped, max(ws)


# ---- parts ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _panel(spr, style, w, H, g, col, s):
    """Glass panel + the style's extras (tag_a: stripes inside the corner; tag_b: outer outline, bottom bar, hanging stripes)."""
    sp = T4_TAG[style]
    cut = tuple(c * s for c in sp["cut"])
    if style == "tag_b":                                                # faint second outline, 8 px outside (R10's double border)
        d = 8 * s
        outer = neon_stroke(chamfer_rect((w + 2 * d, H + 2 * d), tuple(c + d for c in cut)), col, 1.4 * s, 5 * s)
        kit_paste(spr, _fade(outer, 0.45), g - d, g - d)
        ln = connector([(g + 44 * s, g + H + 9 * s), (g + w * 0.50, g + H + 9 * s)], col, False, 1.5 * s, 5 * s)
        kit_paste(spr, _fade(ln, 0.55), 0, 0)
    kit_paste(spr, glass_panel((w, H), 0, TINT, col, cut, 2.6 * s, 11 * s), g, g)
    if style == "tag_a":
        sw, sh = int(round(62 * s)), int(round(24 * s))
        kit_paste(spr, hazard_stripes((sw, sh), 35.0, col, 5, 10 * s, 6 * s), g + w - 24 * s - sw, g + H - 15 * s - sh)
    else:
        bar = connector([(g + w * 0.24, g + H), (g + w * 0.36, g + H)], t2_lighten(col, 0.30), False, 5 * s, 10 * s)
        kit_paste(spr, bar, 0, 0)
        sw, sh = int(round(116 * s)), int(round(18 * s))
        kit_paste(spr, hazard_stripes((sw, sh), 35.0, col, 5, 12 * s, 7 * s), g + w * 0.53, g + H - 4 * s)


def _emblem(spr, icon, left, H, g, col, s):
    """Neon icon centred in the left block + the thin vertical divider on its right edge. No icon -> nothing."""
    if not icon:
        return
    isz = int(round(T4_TAG["tag_a"]["icon"] * s))
    ic = neon_icon(icon, isz, col, 8 * s)
    kit_paste(spr, ic, g + left / 2.0 - isz / 2.0, g + H / 2.0 - isz / 2.0)
    x = g + left
    kit_paste(spr, connector([(x, g + H * 0.24), (x, g + H * 0.76)], t2_lighten(col, 0.15), False, 2.0 * s, 5 * s), 0, 0)


def _texts(spr, fonts, shaped, x0, x1, ymid, rtl, bold, fills, s):
    """Lines stacked and centred on ymid. LTR: left edge x0; RTL: right edge x1. Non-bold fonts get a thin same-colour stroke."""
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(spr)
    gap = 7 * s
    lines = [(f, t, c) for f, t, c in zip(fonts, shaped, fills) if t]
    total = sum(f.getmetrics()[0] + f.getmetrics()[1] for f, _, _ in lines) + gap * (len(lines) - 1)
    y = ymid - total / 2.0
    for i, (f, t, c) in enumerate(lines):
        asc, desc = f.getmetrics()
        sw = 1 if (i == 0 and not bold and f.size >= 24) else 0
        d.text((x1 if rtl else x0, y + asc), t, font=f, fill=c + (255,), anchor="rs" if rtl else "ls", stroke_width=sw, stroke_fill=c + (255,))
        y += asc + desc + gap


# ---- public -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def t4_tag_sprite(style, name, role="", icon="code", color="#19D3FF", font=None, scale=1.0, max_w=None):
    """RGBA sprite of a name tag, or None when name and role are both empty. Unknown style -> 'tag_a'. max_w = widest allowed PANEL (px):
    text shrinks, then is cut with '...'. sprite.info: panel (w, h in px), rtl. Never raises on odd text / colour / font values."""
    style = style if style in T4_TAG else "tag_a"
    sp = T4_TAG[style]
    name, role = str(name or "").strip(), str(role or "").strip()
    if not name and not role:
        return None
    if sp["caps"]:
        name, role = name.upper(), role.upper()
    s = max(0.2, float(scale))
    fp = font if font and os.path.isfile(str(font)) else default_font()
    col = t2_rgb(color)
    H, g = int(round(sp["h"] * s)), int(round(GLOW_PAD * s))
    left, right = int(round((sp["icon_w"] if icon else 34) * s)), int(round(sp["right"] * s))
    gapx = int(round(26 * s)) if icon else 0                              # divider -> text
    avail = (float(max_w) - left - gapx - right) if max_w else 10.0 ** 6
    fonts, shaped, tw = _fit([name, role], fp, (sp["name"] * s, sp["role"] * s), max(40.0, avail))
    w = int(max(sp["min_w"] * s, left + gapx + tw + right))
    if max_w:
        w = min(w, int(max_w))
    ext = int(round(14 * s)) if style == "tag_b" else 0
    spr = Image.new("RGBA", (w + 2 * g, H + ext + 2 * g), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    _panel(spr, style, w, H, g, col, s)
    _emblem(spr, icon, left, H, g, col, s)
    rtl = is_rtl_text(name + " " + role)
    role_col = t2_lighten(col, 0.15) if style == "tag_b" else (226, 234, 246)
    area0, area1 = g + left + gapx, g + w - right
    _texts(spr, fonts, shaped, area0, area1, g + H / 2.0, rtl, _is_bold(fp), [(255, 255, 255), role_col], s)
    spr.info["panel"], spr.info["rtl"] = (w, H), rtl
    return spr


================================================================================
##### FILE: mt\templates\t4\tiles.py #####
================================================================================
"""mt.templates.t4.tiles - Template 4 module 'tiles' (ref R2, left side): groups of dark glass tiles, each holding a user logo (PNG ...,
fitted + centred), laid out in a grid, optionally with a neon connector polyline that ends in a glowing dot at a target point.
cfg['t4']['tiles'] = [group, ...]   (also accepted: one group dict, or {on, groups: [...]})   group = {
    images [paths]       the logos, row by row (<= 12). A missing / unreadable file -> gray placeholder tile + one t4_warn line.
    cols 2, gap 18, size 150   grid columns (a short last row is centred), px between tiles, tile edge (px at short side 1080)
    anchor 'left' | xy     anchor = one of the 9 positions (top-left top top-right left center right bottom-left bottom bottom-right) with
                           inset_x / inset_y px; xy = [x, y] = the CENTRE of the group (px, or '40%' strings). Default anchor 'left'.
    border '#C4D6EF'       tile border colour (light, as R2)
    connector {points [[x, y] ...], color, end_dot True|'both'|'start'|False, width, glow}   points in canvas px or '%' strings; a point may
                           also be 'group', 'group-top|bottom|left|right' = that point of the tile group. >= 2 points, drawn after the tiles.
    start | trigger, end | hold (default 5 s), anim 'pop' (default; 'fade' / 'none' / any mt.anim name), anim_dur 0.35, stagger 0.12 s }
Behaviour: the tiles pop in one after another (t4_stagger), the connector fades in after the last one, and everything fades out together at the
group's end (anim 'pop' = anim 't4_pop' in mt/anim.py: pop in, pure fade out; other anims run reversed). Ink stays >= 48 px from the canvas
edges (connector points are clamped into the safe area). Frame on (P8): an anchored group moves inward until it clears the frame (same search as
the name tag); an xy group is only clamped to the safe area. Each tile = ONE sprite Item (cached); nothing is drawn per frame but the animation.
Public: T4_TILES, t4_tiles_cfg(raw) -> [group], t4_tile_sprite(path, size, border, scale), t4_tiles_items(cfg, duration), t4_ask_tiles()."""
import copy
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image

from mt.anim import ANIMS, PRESETS
from mt.ask import ask_anim
from mt.common import IMAGE_EXTS, ask, ask_choice, c_color, c_existing_file, c_float, c_int, yn
from mt.draw import Item, t2_paint, t2_rrect_mask
from mt.templates.t4.cfg import _hex
from mt.templates.t4.frame import t4_frame_cfg
from mt.templates.t4.kit import connector, glass_panel, kit_paste
from mt.templates.t4.nameplate import T4_SAFE, _bool, _cached, _flt, _frame_mask, _place, _window
from mt.templates.t4.timing import t4_ask_when, t4_stagger
from mt.templates.t4.warn import t4_warn

ANCHORS = ("top-left", "top", "top-right", "left", "center", "right", "bottom-left", "bottom", "bottom-right")
MAX_IMAGES = 12
LOGO_FRAC = 0.60                                       # the logo fills this fraction of the tile (R2: ~55-65 %)
TINT = (8, 16, 36, 150)                                # tile glass (rgba): translucent, the video shows through
T4_TILES = {"on": True, "images": [], "cols": 2, "gap": 18.0, "size": 150.0, "anchor": "left", "xy": None, "inset_x": 0.0, "inset_y": 0.0,
            "border": "#c4d6ef", "connector": {}, "start": 0.0, "trigger": "", "end": None, "hold": None, "anim": "pop", "anim_dur": 0.35,
            "stagger": 0.12}
_CONN = {"points": [], "color": "#19d3ff", "end_dot": True, "width": 2.5, "glow": 9.0}
_TOKENS = ("group", "group-top", "group-bottom", "group-left", "group-right")
_TILE = {}


# ---- config -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _anchor(v, default):
    s = str(v).strip().lower().replace("_", "-").replace(" ", "-") if isinstance(v, (str, int)) and not isinstance(v, bool) else ""
    s = PRESETS.get(s, s)
    s = {"middle": "center", "centre": "center", "top-center": "top", "bottom-center": "bottom"}.get(s, s)
    return s if s in ANCHORS else default


def _num_or_pct(v):
    """12, '12', '40%' -> kept as given (number or 'NN%' string); anything else -> None."""
    if isinstance(v, bool):
        return None
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
        return float(v) if math.isfinite(v) else None
    if isinstance(v, str):
        t = v.strip()
        try:
            return t if t.endswith("%") and math.isfinite(float(t[:-1])) else float(t)
        except ValueError:
            return None
    return None


def _point(p):
    """[x, y] / (x, y) / 'x,y' / a group token -> [x, y] | token | None."""
    if isinstance(p, str):
        t = p.strip().lower()
        if t in _TOKENS:
            return t
        p = [a for a in t.replace(";", ",").split(",")]
    if isinstance(p, (list, tuple)) and len(p) == 2:
        a, b = _num_or_pct(p[0]), _num_or_pct(p[1])
        return [a, b] if a is not None and b is not None else None
    return None


def _conn(raw):
    out = copy.deepcopy(_CONN)
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        return {}
    pts = [_point(p) for p in raw.get("points", [])] if isinstance(raw.get("points"), (list, tuple)) else []
    out["points"] = [p for p in pts if p is not None][:12]
    out["color"] = _hex(raw.get("color"), out["color"])
    ed = raw.get("end_dot")
    out["end_dot"] = ed if ed in (True, False, "both", "start") else True
    out["width"], out["glow"] = _flt(raw.get("width"), 0.5, 30, 2.5), _flt(raw.get("glow"), 0, 60, 9.0)
    return out if len(out["points"]) >= 2 else {}


def _group(raw):
    out = copy.deepcopy(T4_TILES)
    out.update({k: copy.deepcopy(v) for k, v in raw.items() if k not in out})                       # extras survive
    imgs = raw.get("images")
    out["images"] = [i.strip() for i in imgs if isinstance(i, str) and i.strip()][:MAX_IMAGES] if isinstance(imgs, (list, tuple)) else []
    try:
        out["cols"] = max(1, min(8, int(raw.get("cols", 2))))
    except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError):
        out["cols"] = 2
    out["gap"], out["size"] = _flt(raw.get("gap"), 0, 200, 18.0), _flt(raw.get("size"), 40, 600, 150.0)
    out["anchor"] = _anchor(raw.get("anchor"), "left")
    xy = _point(raw.get("xy"))
    out["xy"] = xy if isinstance(xy, list) else None
    out["inset_x"], out["inset_y"] = _flt(raw.get("inset_x"), 0, 600, 0.0), _flt(raw.get("inset_y"), 0, 600, 0.0)
    out["border"] = _hex(raw.get("border"), "#c4d6ef")
    out["connector"] = _conn(raw.get("connector"))
    trig = raw.get("trigger")
    out["trigger"] = trig.strip() if isinstance(trig, str) else ""
    out["start"] = raw["start"] if raw.get("start") is not None else (None if out["trigger"] else 0.0)      # a phrase never falls back to 0
    out["end"], out["hold"] = raw.get("end"), raw.get("hold")
    a = raw.get("anim")
    a = ("reveal" if a.strip().lower() == "typewriter" else a.strip().lower()) if isinstance(a, str) else "pop"
    out["anim"] = a if a in ANIMS or a in ("pop", "none") else "pop"
    out["anim_dur"], out["stagger"] = _flt(raw.get("anim_dur"), 0.0, 5.0, 0.35), _flt(raw.get("stagger"), 0.0, 2.0, 0.12)
    out["on"] = _bool(raw.get("on"), True)
    return out


def t4_tiles_cfg(raw):
    """Normalise cfg['t4']['tiles'] -> list of complete groups. Accepts a list of groups, one group dict or {on, groups: [...]} (module
    default {'on': False} = no groups). Never raises; junk entries are dropped."""
    try:
        if isinstance(raw, dict) and "images" in raw:
            raw = [raw]
        elif isinstance(raw, dict):
            raw = raw.get("groups") if _bool(raw.get("on"), False) else []
        return [_group(g) for g in raw if isinstance(g, dict)] if isinstance(raw, (list, tuple)) else []
    except Exception:
        return []


# ---- sprites ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _load_logo(path):
    """-> RGBA image, or None (missing / not an image). First frame of animated files."""
    try:
        if not path or not os.path.isfile(str(path)):
            return None
        with Image.open(str(path)) as im:
            im.seek(0)
            return im.convert("RGBA")
    except Exception:
        return None


def _placeholder(box):
    """Gray rounded square with a small 'image' mark - stands in for a missing logo (box = px)."""
    n = max(8, int(box))
    ph = Image.new("RGBA", (n, n), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    t2_paint(ph, t2_rrect_mask((0, 0, n, n), n * 0.16), (128, 132, 140), 0.85)
    t2_paint(ph, t2_rrect_mask((n * 0.20, n * 0.24, n * 0.80, n * 0.76), n * 0.06), (60, 64, 72), 0.9)
    t2_paint(ph, t2_rrect_mask((n * 0.30, n * 0.56, n * 0.50, n * 0.68), n * 0.03), (160, 166, 176))
    return ph


def _build_tile(path, size, border, scale):
    sz = max(24, int(round(size * scale)))
    sp = glass_panel((sz, sz), sz * 0.22, TINT, border, 0, max(1.4, sz * 0.010), max(2.5, sz * 0.022))      # thin soft border as R2
    ox, oy = sp.info["origin"]
    box, msg = int(round(sz * LOGO_FRAC)), None
    logo = _load_logo(path)
    if logo is None:
        msg = "tiles: image '%s' is missing or not a readable image - gray placeholder." % (Path(str(path)).name or "(empty path)")
        logo = _placeholder(box)
    k = min(box / logo.width, box / logo.height)
    lw, lh = max(1, int(round(logo.width * k))), max(1, int(round(logo.height * k)))
    logo = logo.resize((lw, lh), Image.LANCZOS)
    kit_paste(sp, logo, ox + (sz - lw) / 2.0, oy + (sz - lh) / 2.0)
    sp.info["panel"] = sz
    return sp, msg


def t4_tile_sprite(path, size=150, border="#c4d6ef", scale=1.0):
    """One glass tile with the logo fitted + centred -> RGBA sprite (glow margin included; sprite.info['origin'] = the tile's top-left,
    sprite.info['panel'] = tile edge px). A missing / unreadable file gives a gray placeholder (the one-line warning goes through t4_warn).
    Cached per (path, size, border, scale); a cache hit warns again so a new render still reports it (t4_warn prints once per render)."""
    key = (str(path), round(float(size) * float(scale)), str(border), round(float(scale), 3), os.path.getmtime(path) if path and os.path.isfile(str(path)) else 0)
    sp, msg = _cached(_TILE, key, lambda: _build_tile(path, float(size), border, float(scale)), 48)
    if msg:
        t4_warn(msg)
    return sp


# ---- layout -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _grid(n, cols, size, gap):
    """Top-left of every tile inside the group box + the box size; a short last row is centred. -> ([(x, y)], gw, gh)."""
    cols = max(1, min(cols, n))
    rows = int(math.ceil(n / float(cols)))
    gw, gh = cols * size + (cols - 1) * gap, rows * size + (rows - 1) * gap
    pos = []
    for i in range(n):
        r, c = divmod(i, cols)
        in_row = min(cols, n - r * cols)
        pos.append((c * (size + gap) + (cols - in_row) * (size + gap) / 2.0, r * (size + gap)))
    return pos, gw, gh


def _footprint(tiles, pos, gw, gh, pad):
    """All tiles composited into one sprite - only used to measure the group's ink for the anchor / frame placement."""
    fp = Image.new("RGBA", (int(gw) + 2 * pad, int(gh) + 2 * pad), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    for sp, (x, y) in zip(tiles, pos):
        ox, oy = sp.info["origin"]
        fp.alpha_composite(sp, (int(round(pad + x)) - ox, int(round(pad + y)) - oy))
    return fp


def _coord(v, total, s):
    return total * float(v[:-1]) / 100.0 if isinstance(v, str) else float(v) * s


def _conn_points(c, gbox, W, H, s):
    """Resolve numbers / '%' / group tokens to canvas px, clamped so the line's VISIBLE ink (glow tail + end dot) stays in the 48 px safe area."""
    m, out = (T4_SAFE + c["glow"] * 1.6 + 2) * s, []
    gx0, gy0, gx1, gy1 = gbox
    named = {"group": ((gx0 + gx1) / 2.0, (gy0 + gy1) / 2.0), "group-top": ((gx0 + gx1) / 2.0, gy0), "group-bottom": ((gx0 + gx1) / 2.0, gy1),
             "group-left": (gx0, (gy0 + gy1) / 2.0), "group-right": (gx1, (gy0 + gy1) / 2.0)}
    for p in c["points"]:
        x, y = named[p] if isinstance(p, str) else (_coord(p[0], W, s), _coord(p[1], H, s))
        out.append((min(max(x, m), W - m), min(max(y, m), H - m)))
    return out


# ---- items ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class TileItem(Item):
    """Tile with anim 't4_pop': in = pop, out = pure fade (progress < 0 encodes the exit, see mt/anim.py)."""

    def progress(self, t):
        L = self.end - self.start
        d = min(self.dur, L / 2.0)
        if d <= 1e-6:
            return 1.0
        pin, pout = (t - self.start) / d, (self.end - t) / d
        if pout < 1.0 and pout <= pin:
            return -max(0.0, pout)
        return max(0.0, min(1.0, pin))


def _make_item(sp, st, en, cx, cy, c):
    if c["anim"] == "pop":
        return TileItem(sp, st, en, cx, cy, "t4_pop", c["anim_dur"], out=True)
    return Item(sp, st, en, cx, cy, c["anim"], c["anim_dur"], out=True)


def _conn_sprite(c, pts, s):
    """Connector sprite + the item centre that puts its local (0, 0) back on the canvas origin (points are canvas coordinates)."""
    k = c["connector"]
    sp = connector(pts, k["color"], k["end_dot"], k["width"] * s, k["glow"] * s)
    ox, oy = sp.info["origin"]
    return sp, -ox + sp.width / 2.0, -oy + sp.height / 2.0


def _one_group(cfg, c, idx, duration, W, H, s, fm, placed):
    label = "tiles group %d" % (idx + 1)
    if not c["images"]:
        t4_warn("%s: no images - skipped." % label)
        return []
    win = _window(cfg, c, label, duration, 5.0)
    if win is None:
        return []
    n, size, gap = len(c["images"]), c["size"] * s, c["gap"] * s
    tiles = [t4_tile_sprite(p, c["size"], c["border"], s) for p in c["images"]]
    pos, gw, gh = _grid(n, c["cols"], size, gap)
    pad = tiles[0].info["origin"][0]
    fp = _footprint(tiles, pos, gw, gh, pad)
    if c["xy"]:
        pl = _place_xy(fp, c["xy"], W, H, s)
    else:
        pl = _place(fp, c["anchor"], W, H, s, c["inset_x"], c["inset_y"], fm, label)
    if pl is None:
        return []
    fcx, fcy, rect, _ = pl
    placed.append((label, rect))
    left, top = fcx - fp.width / 2.0, fcy - fp.height / 2.0                       # the footprint sprite's top-left on the canvas
    steps = t4_stagger(n, c["stagger"])
    last = max(win[0], win[1] - 0.1)
    items = [_make_item(sp, min(win[0] + d, last), win[1], left + pad + x + size / 2.0, top + pad + y + size / 2.0, c)
             for sp, (x, y), d in zip(tiles, pos, steps)]
    if c["connector"]:
        gbox = (left + pad, top + pad, left + pad + gw, top + pad + gh)
        sp, cx, cy = _conn_sprite(c, _conn_points(c["connector"], gbox, W, H, s), s)
        items.append(Item(sp, min(win[0] + (steps[-1] if steps else 0.0) + c["anim_dur"], last), win[1], cx, cy, "fade", c["anim_dur"], out=True))
    return items


def _place_xy(fp, xy, W, H, s):
    """Group centred on xy (px / '%'), then clamped so its ink keeps the 48 px safe margin -> same tuple as nameplate._place."""
    from mt.templates.t4.nameplate import _ink_box
    box = _ink_box(fp)
    if box is None:
        return None
    w, h, m = box[2] - box[0], box[3] - box[1], T4_SAFE * s
    x = int(round(min(max(_coord(xy[0], W, s) - w / 2.0, m), W - m - w)))
    y = int(round(min(max(_coord(xy[1], H, s) - h / 2.0, m), H - m - h)))
    return x - box[0] + fp.width / 2.0, y - box[1] + fp.height / 2.0, (x, y, x + w, y + h), 0


def _warn_overlaps(placed):
    for i, (a, ra) in enumerate(placed):
        for b, rb in placed[i + 1:]:
            if ra[0] < rb[2] and rb[0] < ra[2] and ra[1] < rb[3] and rb[1] < ra[3]:
                t4_warn("%s and %s overlap - give one of them another anchor / xy." % (a, b))


def t4_tiles_items(cfg, duration):
    """Items of every tiles group: one per tile (staggered pop-in) + one for the connector; all fade out together. Never raises."""
    t4 = cfg.get("t4") if isinstance(cfg, dict) and isinstance(cfg.get("t4"), dict) else {}
    groups = [g for g in t4_tiles_cfg(t4.get("tiles")) if g["on"]]
    if not groups:
        return []
    try:
        W, H = int(cfg["canvas"][0]), int(cfg["canvas"][1])
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, IndexError):
        t4_warn("t4 tiles: the job has no canvas - skipped.")
        return []
    s, items, placed = min(W, H) / 1080.0, [], []
    try:
        fm = _frame_mask(W, H, t4_frame_cfg(t4.get("frame")), s)
        for i, g in enumerate(groups):
            items += _one_group(cfg, g, i, duration, W, H, s, fm, placed)
        _warn_overlaps(placed)
    except Exception as e:
        t4_warn("t4 tiles: could not be drawn (%s: %s) - skipped." % (type(e).__name__, e))
    return items


# ---- questions --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _c_points(s):
    pts = [_point(p.strip()) for p in s.replace("|", ";").split(";") if p.strip()]
    if len(pts) < 2 or any(p is None for p in pts):
        raise ValueError("enter at least 2 points like  100,900; 250,1000  (px or %, or the words group-bottom / group-right ...)")
    return pts


def t4_ask_tiles():
    """Question group 'tiles' (called by t4_ask_config). -> a list with ONE group, or {'on': False}. More groups: edit the job file."""
    if not yn("Add glass logo tiles (PNG logos in a grid - reference R2)?", default=False):
        return {"on": False}
    imgs = []
    while len(imgs) < MAX_IMAGES:
        p = ask("Logo %d (PNG / image path, Enter = %s)" % (len(imgs) + 1, "done" if imgs else "at least one is needed"),
                key="t4_tiles_img%d" % (len(imgs) + 1), cast=c_existing_file(IMAGE_EXTS), allow_empty=bool(imgs))
        if not p:
            break
        imgs.append(p)
    g = {"images": imgs, "cols": ask("Columns", default=2, key="t4_tiles_cols", cast=c_int),
         "size": ask("Tile size (px, for a 1080 px short side)", default=T4_TILES["size"], key="t4_tiles_size", cast=c_float)}
    a = ask_choice("Where?", ["Top-left", "Top", "Top-right", "Left", "Center", "Right", "Bottom-left", "Bottom", "Bottom-right"],
                   default=4, key="t4_tiles_anchor")
    g["anchor"] = ANCHORS[a - 1]
    if yn("Add a connector line ending in a glowing dot?", default=False):
        pts = ask("Connector points  x,y; x,y; ...  (px or %, first may be group-bottom / group-right)", default="group-bottom; 30%,55%",
                  key="t4_tiles_conn", cast=_c_points)
        g["connector"] = {"points": pts, "end_dot": yn("Dot at both ends (No = only at the target)?", default=False) and "both" or True}
    g.update(t4_ask_when("Logo tiles", 5.0, key="t4_tiles_when"))
    g["anim"] = ask_anim("Tile animation (pop = staggered pop-in, fade-out together)", default="pop", key="t4_tiles_anim")
    return [g]


================================================================================
##### FILE: mt\templates\t4\timing.py #####
================================================================================
"""mt.templates.t4.timing - Template 4: when does an overlay module show? Pure functions, no drawing.
t4_time(entry, cues, duration, default_hold) -> (start, end) | None;  t4_stagger(n, step) -> [delay];  t4_ask_when(prompt, default_hold).
t4_warn / t4_warn_reset live in t4/warn.py (P2, once per render - the same pattern as t3_warn) and are re-exported here so every
timing user imports from one place; a second message set would print the same warning twice."""
import math

from mt.captions import find_trigger
from mt.common import ask, ask_choice, c_float, c_time
from mt.templates.t4.warn import t4_warn, t4_warn_reset  # noqa: F401  (re-export)

MIN_SPAN = 0.05                                  # a window shorter than this is not worth drawing


def _num(v):
    """Seconds from a number or '12', '0:45', '3s' -> float; anything else (None, bool, nan, junk) -> None. Never raises."""
    if v is None or isinstance(v, bool):
        return None
    try:
        x = float(c_time(v)) if isinstance(v, str) else float(v)
    except (ValueError, TypeError, OverflowError):
        return None
    return x if math.isfinite(x) else None


def _streams(cues):
    """cues = one SRT cue list [(s, e, text)] or a list of such lists (every caption stream) -> list of cue lists."""
    try:
        if cues and isinstance(cues[0], (list, tuple)) and cues[0] and isinstance(cues[0][0], (list, tuple)):
            return [c for c in cues if c]
        return [cues] if cues else []
    except (TypeError, IndexError, KeyError):
        return []


def _find(cues, phrase):
    """First stream that contains the phrase wins -> its start time, else None. Never raises."""
    for st in _streams(cues):
        try:
            t = find_trigger(st, phrase)
        except Exception:
            t = None
        if t is not None:
            return float(t)
    return None


def _label(entry):
    for k in ("label", "name", "title", "text", "trigger"):
        v = entry.get(k)
        if isinstance(v, str) and v.strip():
            return "'%s'" % v.strip()[:40]
    return "entry"


def _start(entry, cues, lab):
    """trigger (spoken phrase) first, else the fixed start; None + one warning when neither gives a time."""
    fixed = _num(entry.get("start"))
    phrase = entry.get("trigger")
    phrase = phrase.strip() if isinstance(phrase, str) else ""
    if phrase:
        t = _find(cues, phrase)
        if t is not None:
            return t
        if fixed is None:
            t4_warn("%s: phrase '%s' not found in the captions and no start time - skipped." % (lab, phrase))
            return None
        t4_warn("%s: phrase '%s' not found in the captions - using its start time." % (lab, phrase))
    if fixed is None:
        t4_warn("%s: no start time and no trigger phrase - skipped." % lab)
    return fixed


def t4_time(entry, cues, duration, default_hold):
    """-> (start, end) in seconds, or None (skip the entry).
    start: `trigger` (spoken phrase found in cues via find_trigger; cues = one cue list or a list of streams) else `start`.
    end:   `end` (absolute, must be after start) else start + `hold` else start + default_hold (None / <= 0 -> to the video end).
    Start at or after the video end -> None; an end past the video end is clamped to `duration` (duration None / <= 0 = unknown,
    no clamping). A negative start becomes 0. Junk input never raises (one t4_warn line, None)."""
    if not isinstance(entry, dict):
        t4_warn("timing: entry is not a dict - skipped.")
        return None
    lab = _label(entry)
    st = _start(entry, cues, lab)
    if st is None:
        return None
    st = max(0.0, st)
    dur = _num(duration)
    dur = dur if dur and dur > 0 else None
    if dur is not None and st >= dur:
        t4_warn("%s: starts at %.2f s, after the video end (%.2f s) - skipped." % (lab, st, dur))
        return None
    en = _num(entry.get("end"))
    if en is not None and en <= st + MIN_SPAN:
        t4_warn("%s: end %.2f s is not after the start %.2f s - using the hold time." % (lab, en, st))
        en = None
    if en is None:
        hold = _num(entry.get("hold"))
        if hold is None or hold <= 0:
            hold = _num(default_hold)
        en = st + hold if hold and hold > 0 else (dur if dur is not None else None)
    if en is None:
        t4_warn("%s: no end / hold and the video length is unknown - skipped." % lab)
        return None
    if dur is not None:
        en = min(en, dur)
    return (st, en) if en - st >= MIN_SPAN else None


def t4_stagger(n, step):
    """Entry delays for n items that appear one after another: [0, step, 2*step, ...]. n <= 0 -> []; bad step -> 0.0."""
    try:
        n = max(0, int(n))
    except (ValueError, TypeError, OverflowError):
        return []
    s = _num(step)
    s = s if s is not None and s > 0 else 0.0
    return [round(i * s, 6) for i in range(n)]


def _c_hold(s):
    v = c_float(s)
    if not v > 0:
        raise ValueError("enter a number of seconds above 0")
    return v


def t4_ask_when(prompt, default_hold=4.0, key=None):
    """The one shared 'when does it show' question. -> {"start": seconds, "hold": s} or {"trigger": phrase, "hold": s}
    (both shapes are accepted by t4_time). key = optional prefix that remembers the answers (mt.common.D)."""
    k = (lambda n: key + n) if key else (lambda n: None)
    mode = ask_choice(f"{prompt} - when should it appear?",
                      ["At a fixed time (seconds or mm:ss)", "When a phrase is spoken (it must be in the captions)"],
                      default=1, key=k("_mode"))
    if mode == 1:
        out = {"start": ask("Start at  (seconds or mm:ss)", default=0, key=k("_start"), cast=c_time)}
    else:
        out = {"trigger": ask("Spoken phrase", key=k("_trigger")).strip()}
    out["hold"] = ask("Keep it on screen for how many seconds", default=default_hold, key=k("_hold"), cast=_c_hold)
    return out

"""mt.templates.t4.warn - Template 4: one-line [!] messages, printed once per render (items are rebuilt per frame / segment)."""
_MSGS = set()


def t4_warn_reset():
    _MSGS.clear()


def t4_warn(msg):
    """Print '   [!] msg' once per render; never raises."""
    msg = "   [!] " + str(msg).strip()
    if msg not in _MSGS:
        _MSGS.add(msg)
        print(msg)

import os

def _full_box(canvas, fit):
    return {"x": 0, "y": 0, "w": int(canvas[0]), "h": int(canvas[1]), "mode": fit}


def t4_ask_config(video_info):
    """Canvas (auto / reels / youtube), fill or fit, letterbox colour (fit only). -> tpl dict; video_box = the whole canvas."""
    print("\n=== Template 4 - Overlay Studio ===")
    cm = ask_choice("Canvas:", ["Auto (by the video shape)", "Reels / Shorts 1080x1920", "YouTube 1920x1080"], default=1,
                    key="t4_canvas")
    mode = ("auto", "reels", "youtube")[cm - 1]
    canvas = t4_canvas(mode, video_info)
    print(f"   -> canvas {canvas[0]}x{canvas[1]}")
    ft = ask_choice("Video inside the canvas:", ["Fill (crop to the canvas)", "Fit (whole video, letterboxed)"], default=1,
                    key="t4_fit")
    fit = "fill" if ft == 1 else "fit"
    t4 = {"canvas_mode": mode, "fit": fit}
    if fit == "fit":
        t4["backdrop"] = _ask_backdrop()
    t4["frame"] = t4_ask_frame()                       # question group 'frame' (T4-8)
    t4["nameplate"] = t4_ask_nameplate()               # question groups 'nameplate' (tag_a / tag_b) and 'corner_list' (T4-9)
    t4["corner_list"] = t4_ask_corner_list()
    t4["tiles"] = t4_ask_tiles()                       # question group 'tiles' (T4-10): a list with one group, or {'on': False}
    t4["cards"] = t4_ask_image_cards()                 # question group 'cards' (T4-11): a list with one image card, or {'on': False}
    t4 = t4_cfg(t4)
    return {"template_id": 5, "canvas": canvas, "video_box": _full_box(canvas, fit), "background": {"type": "color", "value": t4["backdrop"]["value"]},
            "layers": [], "t4": t4}


def _ask_backdrop():
    """What shows around a 'fit' video: solid colour / image / blurred copy of the video. -> backdrop dict (t4_cfg normalises it)."""
    kind = ask_choice("Around the video (backdrop):", ["Solid colour (black by default)", "Image", "Blurred copy of the video"],
                      default=1, key="t4_backdrop_type")
    if kind == 2:
        return {"type": "image", "path": ask("Backdrop image (PNG/JPG...)", cast=c_existing_file(IMAGE_EXTS))}
    if kind == 3:
        return {"type": "blur", "strength": ask("Blur strength 1-10", default=5, key="t4_blur", cast=c_int)}
    return {"type": "color", "value": ask("Backdrop colour (hex or name)", default="#000000", key="t4_backdrop", cast=c_color)}


def t4_ask_cards(cues):
    return []                      # Template 4 has no generic cards; its card modules come later (cfg["t4"]["cards"])


def _canvas_ok(c):
    try:
        return len(c) == 2 and all(int(v) > 0 for v in c)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return False


# ---- the T4 foreground plate (cfg['_t2_fg']): ONE transparent full-canvas PNG over the video, merged from the static parts ---------------
# Each part = (name, builder); builder(W, H, t4) -> RGBA image W x H | None (module off). List order = bottom -> top. A later module
# (nameplate, tags, ...) adds ONE line here: T4_FG_PARTS.append(("nameplate", t4_nameplate_part)) - never its own _t2_fg.
T4_FG_PARTS = [("frame", t4_frame_part)]


def t4_compose_fg(cfg, tmp):
    """Alpha-composite every active part into one plate, save tmp/t4_fg.png and point cfg['_t2_fg'] at it (the pipeline's generic
    foreground slot). No active part -> cfg['_t2_fg'] removed, returns None. A failing part warns once and is skipped; never raises."""
    cfg.pop("_t2_fg", None)
    try:
        W, H = int(cfg["canvas"][0]), int(cfg["canvas"][1])
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, IndexError):
        return None
    plate = None
    for name, build in T4_FG_PARTS:
        try:
            part = build(W, H, cfg.get("t4"))
        except Exception as e:
            t4_warn(f"{name}: could not be drawn ({type(e).__name__}: {e}) - skipped")
            continue
        if part is None:
            continue
        if part.size != (W, H):
            t4_warn(f"{name}: plate is {part.size[0]}x{part.size[1]}, canvas is {W}x{H} - skipped")
            continue
        if plate is None:
            plate = part.convert("RGBA")
        else:
            plate.alpha_composite(part.convert("RGBA"))
    if plate is None:
        return None
    path = os.path.join(tmp or tempfile.gettempdir(), "t4_fg.png")
    plate.save(path, compress_level=1)
    cfg["_t2_fg"] = path
    return path


def t4_build_static_layers(cfg, tmp):
    """Hook build_background: solid backdrop + the foreground plate. The video is the base, so video_box is forced to the full canvas
    (fill / fit from cfg["t4"]); a job without a usable canvas gets one from canvas_mode + the video shape."""
    t4_warn_reset()
    t4 = t4_cfg(cfg.get("t4"))
    cfg["t4"] = t4
    if not _canvas_ok(cfg.get("canvas")):
        info = None
        try:
            info = probe(cfg["video"]) if cfg.get("video") and os.path.isfile(str(cfg["video"])) else None
        except Exception:
            info = None
        cfg["canvas"] = t4_canvas(t4["canvas_mode"], info)
    cfg["canvas"] = [int(cfg["canvas"][0]), int(cfg["canvas"][1])]
    cfg["video_box"] = _full_box(cfg["canvas"], t4["fit"])
    t4_apply_backdrop(cfg, t4)
    t4["frame"] = t4_frame_cfg(t4.get("frame"))        # complete {on, text, color, icon, show_ticks} (extras kept)
    t4["nameplate"] = t4_nameplate_cfg(t4.get("nameplate"))          # complete dicts (extras kept); drawn as Items by t4_build_items
    t4["corner_list"] = t4_corner_list_cfg(t4.get("corner_list"))
    t4["tiles"] = t4_tiles_cfg(t4.get("tiles")) or {"on": False}      # complete groups (extras kept), drawn as Items by t4_build_items
    t4["cards"] = t4_cards_cfg(t4.get("cards")) or {"on": False}      # complete image cards (extras kept), drawn as Items by t4_build_items
    t4_compose_fg(cfg, tmp)


def t4_build_items(cfg, duration, splits, lbox, rbox):
    return t4_caption_items(cfg, duration) + t4_nameplate_items(cfg, duration) + t4_tiles_items(cfg, duration) + t4_cards_items(cfg, duration)   # captions (render.py skips t4_style) + tag / list + logo tiles + image cards

from mt.fonts import has_arabic, load_font, shape, wrap_lines

def resolve_pos(pos, sw, sh, W, H):
    """Return the sprite CENTER (cx, cy) on the canvas."""
    if isinstance(pos, (list, tuple)):
        def one(v, total):
            v = str(v)
            return float(v[:-1]) / 100.0 * total if v.endswith("%") else float(v)
        return one(pos[0], W), one(pos[1], H)
    mx, my = 0.05 * W, 0.04 * H
    name = pos or "center"
    cx = W / 2
    cy = H / 2
    if "left" in name:
        cx = mx + sw / 2
    elif "right" in name:
        cx = W - mx - sw / 2
    if name.startswith("top"):
        cy = my + sh / 2
    elif name.startswith("bottom"):
        cy = H - my - sh / 2
    return cx, cy


def make_text_sprite(text, font_path, size, fill, stroke_fill=None, stroke_w=0, max_w=10 ** 6):
    stroke_w = int(stroke_w or 0)
    if stroke_w and not stroke_fill:
        stroke_fill = "#000000"
    avail = max_w - 2 * (stroke_w + 6)
    while True:
        font = load_font(font_path, int(size))
        lines = wrap_lines(text, font, avail)
        shaped = [shape(l) for l in lines]
        widths = [font.getlength(s) for s in shaped]
        if max(widths) <= avail or size <= 14:
            break
        size = max(14, int(size * 0.92))
    asc, desc = font.getmetrics()
    lh = asc + desc
    gap = int(size * 0.18)
    pad = stroke_w + int(size * 0.18) + 3
    w = int(max(widths)) + 2 * pad
    h = len(lines) * lh + (len(lines) - 1) * gap + 2 * pad
    img = Image.new("RGBA", (max(w, 4), max(h, 4)), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    for i, s in enumerate(shaped):
        y = pad + asc + i * (lh + gap)
        d.text((w / 2, y), s, font=font, fill=fill, anchor="ms",
               stroke_width=stroke_w, stroke_fill=stroke_fill)
    return img


def load_image_sprite(path, width_spec, W):
    im = Image.open(path)
    try:
        im.seek(0)
    except Exception:
        pass
    im = im.convert("RGBA")
    if width_spec:
        ws = str(width_spec).strip()
        if ws.endswith("%"):
            tw = int(float(ws[:-1]) / 100.0 * W)
        else:
            tw = int(float(ws))
        tw = max(2, tw)
        th = max(2, int(round(im.height * tw / im.width)))
        im = im.resize((tw, th), Image.LANCZOS)
    return im

CYAN = (30, 170, 255)


CYAN_TXT = (0, 184, 255)


def _draw_icon(img, kind, box, path=None):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = box
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    s = x1 - x0
    cx, cy = (x0 + x1) / 2.0, (y0 + y1) / 2.0
    wid = max(2, int(s * 0.09))
    white = (255, 255, 255, 255)
    if kind == "code":
        a = s * 0.30
        d.line([(cx - a * 0.55, cy - a * 0.9), (cx - a * 1.45, cy), (cx - a * 0.55, cy + a * 0.9)],
               fill=white, width=wid, joint="curve")
        d.line([(cx + a * 0.55, cy - a * 0.9), (cx + a * 1.45, cy), (cx + a * 0.55, cy + a * 0.9)],
               fill=white, width=wid, joint="curve")
        d.line([(cx + a * 0.25, cy - a * 1.0), (cx - a * 0.25, cy + a * 1.0)], fill=white, width=wid)
    elif kind == "phone":
        d.rounded_rectangle((cx - s * 0.22, y0 + s * 0.02, cx + s * 0.22, y1 - s * 0.02),
                            radius=s * 0.08, outline=white, width=wid)
        d.line([(cx - s * 0.07, y0 + s * 0.12), (cx + s * 0.07, y0 + s * 0.12)], fill=white, width=max(2, wid // 2))
        r = s * 0.035
        d.ellipse((cx - r, y1 - s * 0.14 - r, cx + r, y1 - s * 0.14 + r), fill=white)
    elif kind == "chip":
        q = s * 0.20
        d.rounded_rectangle((cx - q, cy - q, cx + q, cy + q), radius=s * 0.04, outline=white, width=wid)
        r = s * 0.09
        d.rectangle((cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r), fill=white)
        for off in (-0.11, 0.0, 0.11):
            d.line([(cx + s * off, cy - q), (cx + s * off, cy - q - s * 0.12)], fill=white, width=max(2, wid // 2))
            d.line([(cx + s * off, cy + q), (cx + s * off, cy + q + s * 0.12)], fill=white, width=max(2, wid // 2))
            d.line([(cx - q, cy + s * off), (cx - q - s * 0.12, cy + s * off)], fill=white, width=max(2, wid // 2))
            d.line([(cx + q, cy + s * off), (cx + q + s * 0.12, cy + s * off)], fill=white, width=max(2, wid // 2))
    elif kind == "globe":                       # T3-6
        r = s * 0.40
        d.ellipse((cx - r, cy - r, cx + r, cy + r), outline=white, width=wid)
        d.ellipse((cx - r * 0.45, cy - r, cx + r * 0.45, cy + r), outline=white, width=max(2, wid * 2 // 3))
        d.line([(cx - r, cy), (cx + r, cy)], fill=white, width=max(2, wid * 2 // 3))
        d.line([(cx, cy - r), (cx, cy + r)], fill=white, width=max(2, wid * 2 // 3))
    elif kind == "cloud":
        yb = cy + s * 0.20
        d.line([(cx - s * 0.30, yb), (cx + s * 0.32, yb)], fill=white, width=wid)
        d.arc((cx - s * 0.42, cy - s * 0.08, cx - s * 0.18, yb), 90, 270, fill=white, width=wid)
        d.arc((cx - s * 0.28, cy - s * 0.34, cx + s * 0.10, cy + s * 0.04), 180, 340, fill=white, width=wid)
        d.arc((cx - s * 0.02, cy - s * 0.22, cx + s * 0.30, cy + s * 0.10), 200, 360, fill=white, width=wid)
        d.arc((cx + s * 0.14, cy - s * 0.08, cx + s * 0.42, yb), 270, 90, fill=white, width=wid)
    elif kind == "shield":
        pts = [(cx - s * 0.30, cy - s * 0.30), (cx, cy - s * 0.42), (cx + s * 0.30, cy - s * 0.30), (cx + s * 0.28, cy + s * 0.06),
               (cx, cy + s * 0.42), (cx - s * 0.28, cy + s * 0.06)]
        d.line(pts + [pts[0]], fill=white, width=wid, joint="curve")
        d.line([(cx - s * 0.12, cy), (cx - s * 0.03, cy + s * 0.10), (cx + s * 0.14, cy - s * 0.10)], fill=white, width=wid,
               joint="curve")
    elif kind == "image" and path:
        try:
            ic = Image.open(path).convert("RGBA")
            ic.thumbnail((int(s), int(s)), Image.LANCZOS)
            img.alpha_composite(ic, (int(cx - ic.width / 2), int(cy - ic.height / 2)))
        except Exception:
            pass

# Procedural "Tech HUD" background (dark blue, glowing frame, floor grid, divider)
