"""mt.templates.t3.slot - T3-8: CENTER CONTENT SLOT of the bottom panel (replaces the poster's "Editing Layers" table).

Header (icon + editable title + thin line, hidden when the slot has no blocks) and timed CONTENT BLOCKS inside
t3_panel_center_rect(): points (<=6 lines, bullet/number, reveal one by one), stat (big orange heavy-italic number, optional
count-up, label, sub-text), media (image or short video segment in a rounded frame + caption), chips (<=8 keyword pills, the
spoken one turns orange).  Blocks follow each other (a block holds until the next one starts; the old one animates out, then the
new one animates in).  Rendering is cheap: every block is a static sprite (Items); only count-up steps, per-line reveals, chip
highlights and the baked media clip change.  Media video = video layer baked like the floating cards (alpha clip, qtrle).
cfg["t3"]["slot"] = {on, title, icon, anim, anim_dur, blocks:[{type, start, trigger, hold, ...type keys}]}  (see t3_slot_cfg).
The slot is drawn only when cfg["t3"]["panel"]["on"] (it lives in the panel's centre column)."""
import math
import os
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageOps

from mt.anim import anim_state
from mt.draw import Item, draw_item
from mt.fonts import is_rtl_text, shape
from mt.templates.t3 import panels as _pn
from mt.templates.t3.static import t3_warn, K, t3_font

TYPES = ("points", "stat", "media", "chips")
ICONS = ("layers", "star", "bulb", "chart", "tag")
MAX_LINES, MAX_CHIPS, MAX_BLOCKS = 6, 8, 8
ANIMS = ("fade", "tile_up", "slide_up", "slide_left", "slide_right", "none")
SLOT_DEFAULTS = {"on": False, "title": "KEY POINTS", "icon": "layers", "anim": "fade", "anim_dur": 0.35, "blocks": None}
DEMO_BLOCKS = [
    {"type": "points", "lines": ["Template-driven edits", "Animated captions", "Adaptive video frame", "One-click styles"],
     "stagger": 0.5},
    {"type": "stat", "value": "250+", "label": "VIDEOS EDITED", "sub": "and counting", "count_up": True},
    {"type": "chips", "chips": ["Design", "Motion", "Code", "Audio", "Story", "Reels"]},
]
GAP_DEFAULT = 4.0                                      # seconds between block starts when no start is given
_SPR = {}


def _num(v):
    try:
        return float(v)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None


def _s(v):
    return str(v or "").strip()


def _norm_items(src, limit):
    out = []
    for r in list(src or [])[:limit]:
        r = {"text": r} if not isinstance(r, dict) else r
        if _s(r.get("text")):
            out.append({"text": _s(r["text"]), "trigger": _s(r.get("trigger"))})
    return out


def _norm_block(b):
    if not isinstance(b, dict):
        return None
    t = _s(b.get("type")).lower()
    if t not in TYPES:
        return None
    o = {"type": t, "start": _num(b.get("start")), "trigger": _s(b.get("trigger")), "hold": _num(b.get("hold"))}
    if o["hold"] is not None and o["hold"] <= 0:
        o["hold"] = None
    if t == "points":
        o["lines"] = _norm_items(b.get("lines"), MAX_LINES)
        o["bullet"] = "number" if _s(b.get("bullet")).lower() in ("number", "numbers", "num") else "dot"
        rv = _s(b.get("reveal") or "stagger").lower()
        o["reveal"] = rv if rv in ("stagger", "trigger", "all") else "stagger"
        o["stagger"] = max(0.0, min(3.0, _num(b.get("stagger")) if _num(b.get("stagger")) is not None else 0.5))
        if not o["lines"]:
            return None
    elif t == "stat":
        o.update(value=_s(b.get("value")) or "100", label=_s(b.get("label")), sub=_s(b.get("sub")),
                 count_up=bool(b.get("count_up", False)), count_dur=max(0.3, min(3.0, _num(b.get("count_dur")) or 1.0)))
    elif t == "media":
        o.update(image=_s(b.get("image")), video=_s(b.get("video")), caption=_s(b.get("caption")),
                 seg_start=max(0.0, _num(b.get("seg_start")) or 0.0), seg_end=_num(b.get("seg_end")))
        if o["seg_end"] is not None and o["seg_end"] <= o["seg_start"]:
            o["seg_end"] = None
    else:
        o["chips"] = _norm_items(b.get("chips"), MAX_CHIPS)
        if not o["chips"]:
            return None
    return o


def t3_slot_cfg(raw=None):
    """Normalise cfg['t3']['slot'] (idempotent). blocks missing/None -> the 3 demo blocks (points, stat, chips); an explicit [] =
    empty slot (header hidden). Bad blocks are dropped; up to 8 blocks."""
    raw = raw if isinstance(raw, dict) else {}
    d = dict(SLOT_DEFAULTS)
    d["on"] = bool(raw.get("on", False))
    if "title" in raw:
        d["title"] = _s(raw["title"])
    ic = _s(raw.get("icon")).lower()
    d["icon"] = ic if ic in ICONS else "layers"
    an = _s(raw.get("anim")).lower()
    d["anim"] = an if an in ANIMS else "fade"
    d["anim_dur"] = max(0.1, min(1.5, _num(raw.get("anim_dur")) or 0.35))
    src = raw.get("blocks")
    src = DEMO_BLOCKS if src is None else src
    d["blocks"] = [b for b in (_norm_block(x) for x in list(src)[:MAX_BLOCKS]) if b]
    return d


def _scfg(cfg):
    s = (cfg.get("t3") or {}).get("slot")
    return s if isinstance(s, dict) and isinstance(s.get("blocks"), list) and "icon" in s and \
        all("type" in b for b in s["blocks"]) else t3_slot_cfg(s)


def slot_active(cfg):
    p = _pn._pcfg(cfg)
    return bool(p["on"] and _scfg(cfg)["on"])


# ---- geometry -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def slot_rects():
    """-> (center rect, header height, content area rect), canvas px."""
    cx, cy, cw, ch = _pn.t3_panel_center_rect(_pn.t3_panel_rect())
    hh = int(round(36 * K))
    return (cx, cy, cw, ch), hh, (cx + 4, cy + hh + 8, cw - 8, ch - hh - 14)


def _acc(cfg):
    a = (cfg.get("t3") or {}).get("accent", "#F56D1F")
    try:
        return tuple(int(str(a).lstrip("#")[i:i + 2], 16) for i in (0, 2, 4)) + (255,)
    except ValueError:
        return (245, 109, 31, 255)


def _font(text, size, fonts, role="caps"):
    return _pn._ptfont(text, size, fonts, role)


def _fit(texts, maxw, size, fonts, role="caps", lo=12):
    """largest font size <= size at which every text fits maxw (never below lo)."""
    size = int(size)
    while size > lo:
        f = _font(texts[0], size, fonts, role)
        if all(_font(t, size, fonts, role).getlength(shape(t)) <= maxw for t in texts):
            break
        size -= 1
    return max(lo, size)


def _ellipsize(text, f, maxw):
    t = text
    while t and f.getlength(shape(t)) > maxw:
        t = t[:-1]
        if f.getlength(shape(t + "…")) <= maxw:
            return t.rstrip() + "…"
    return t


def _draw_text(d, xy, text, f, fill, anchor):
    d.text(xy, shape(text), font=f, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)


# ---- header ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _draw_icon_slot(d, name, cx, cy, s, col):
    if name == "star":
        pts = []
        for i in range(10):
            r = s * (0.5 if i % 2 == 0 else 0.22)
            a = -math.pi / 2 + i * math.pi / 5
            pts.append((cx + r * math.cos(a), cy + r * math.sin(a)))
        d.polygon(pts, fill=col)
    elif name == "bulb":
        d.ellipse((cx - s * 0.32, cy - s * 0.5, cx + s * 0.32, cy + s * 0.14), fill=col)
        d.rectangle((cx - s * 0.16, cy + s * 0.18, cx + s * 0.16, cy + s * 0.42), fill=col)
    elif name == "chart":
        for i, hh in enumerate((0.45, 0.8, 0.62)):
            x = cx - s * 0.46 + i * s * 0.34
            d.rectangle((x, cy + s * 0.45 - s * hh, x + s * 0.24, cy + s * 0.45), fill=col)
    elif name == "tag":
        d.polygon([(cx - s * 0.5, cy - s * 0.2), (cx + s * 0.1, cy - s * 0.2), (cx + s * 0.5, cy), (cx + s * 0.1, cy + s * 0.2),
                   (cx - s * 0.5, cy + s * 0.2)], fill=col)
    else:                                                # layers: three stacked rhombi
        for i, dy in enumerate((0.26, 0.0, -0.26)):
            y = cy + s * dy
            pts = [(cx, y - s * 0.2), (cx + s * 0.5, y), (cx, y + s * 0.2), (cx - s * 0.5, y)]
            if i == 2:
                d.polygon(pts, fill=col)
            else:
                d.line(pts + [pts[0]], fill=col, width=max(2, int(s * 0.09)), joint="curve")


def slot_header(cfg, band_xy, w, h_total):
    """Draw the header (icon + title + thin line) onto an ImageDraw of the band: band_xy = (band_x0, band_y0) canvas origin.
    Returns a transparent-safe RGBA overlay layer of size (w, h_total) (band size) or None when the slot hides it."""
    s = _scfg(cfg)
    if not (s["on"] and s["blocks"]):
        return None
    (cx, cy, cw, ch), hh, _ = slot_rects()
    ox, oy = cx - band_xy[0], cy - band_xy[1]
    lay = Image.new("RGBA", (w, h_total), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(lay)
    acc = _acc(cfg)
    isz = 24 * K
    _draw_icon_slot(d, s["icon"], ox + isz / 2 + 2, oy + hh * 0.46, isz, acc)
    title = s["title"]
    if title:
        fonts = (cfg.get("t3") or {}).get("fonts")
        f = _font(title, _fit([title], cw - isz - 14, 17 * K, fonts, lo=11), fonts)
        if is_rtl_text(title):
            _draw_text(d, (ox + cw - 2, oy + hh * 0.46), title, f, _pn.CREAM + (255,), "rm")
        else:
            _draw_text(d, (ox + isz + 12, oy + hh * 0.46), title, f, _pn.CREAM + (255,), "lm")
    d.line([(ox, oy + hh), (ox + cw, oy + hh)], fill=_pn.CREAM + (70,), width=1)
    return lay


# ---- timeline -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def slot_resolve(cfg, duration):
    """-> [] or list of block dicts: normalised block + {t0, t1} seconds (+ 'lines_t' reveal times / 'chips_t' highlight windows).
    Blocks run inside the panel window; each lasts until the next block starts (or `hold`)."""
    s = _scfg(cfg)
    res = _pn.panel_resolve(cfg, duration)
    if not (s["on"] and res and s["blocks"]):
        return []
    tr = float(((cfg.get("t3") or {}).get("layout") or {}).get("trans", 0.5))
    cues = _pn._cues(cfg)
    base = max(res["start"], res["band_start"] + tr + 0.05)
    out, prev = [], None
    for b in s["blocks"]:
        t0 = _pn._panel_trigger_time(cues, b["trigger"]) if b["trigger"] else None
        if b["trigger"] and t0 is None:
            t3_warn(f"   [!] slot block '{b['type']}': phrase '{b['trigger']}' not found - placed after the previous block.")
        if t0 is None:
            t0 = b["start"]
        if t0 is None:
            t0 = base if prev is None else prev["t0"] + GAP_DEFAULT
        t0 = max(t0, base if prev is None else prev["t0"] + 0.5)
        x = dict(b, t0=t0)
        if prev is not None and prev["hold"] is None:
            prev["t1"] = t0
        out.append(x)
        prev = x
        x["t1"] = None
    last_end = res["end"] - 0.05
    for x in out:
        end = x["t0"] + x["hold"] if x["hold"] else x["t1"]
        end = last_end if end is None else min(end, last_end)
        if x is not out[-1] and x["hold"] and x["t0"] + x["hold"] > out[out.index(x) + 1]["t0"]:
            end = out[out.index(x) + 1]["t0"]
        x["t1"] = end
    out = [x for x in out if x["t1"] - x["t0"] > 0.2 and x["t0"] < duration]
    for x in out:
        if x["type"] == "points":
            tt = []
            for i, ln in enumerate(x["lines"]):
                t = _pn._panel_trigger_time(cues, ln["trigger"]) if (x["reveal"] == "trigger" and ln["trigger"]) else None
                if x["reveal"] == "trigger" and ln["trigger"] and t is None:
                    t3_warn(f"   [!] slot line '{ln['text']}': phrase '{ln['trigger']}' not found - staggered instead.")
                tt.append(x["t0"] + (0.0 if x["reveal"] == "all" else i * x["stagger"]) if t is None else max(x["t0"], t))
            x["lines_t"] = tt
        elif x["type"] == "chips":
            hits = []
            for i, c in enumerate(x["chips"]):
                t = _pn._panel_trigger_time(cues, c["trigger"]) if c["trigger"] else None
                if c["trigger"] and t is None:
                    t3_warn(f"   [!] slot chip '{c['text']}': phrase '{c['trigger']}' not found - not highlighted.")
                if t is not None:
                    hits.append((max(x["t0"], t), i))
            hits.sort()
            x["chips_t"] = [(a, hits[k + 1][0] if k + 1 < len(hits) else x["t1"], i) for k, (a, i) in enumerate(hits)]
    return out


# ---- sprites --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _cache(key, fn):
    v = _SPR.get(key)
    if v is None:
        v = _SPR[key] = fn()
    return v


def _points_line_sprite(text, n, bullet, w, h, size, acc, fonts):
    rtl = is_rtl_text(text)
    spr = Image.new("RGBA", (w * 2, h * 2), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(spr)
    r = h * 2 * (0.30 if bullet == "number" else 0.13)
    bx = (w * 2 - r - 6) if rtl else (r + 6)
    d.ellipse((bx - r, h - r, bx + r, h + r), fill=acc)
    if bullet == "number":
        nf = _font(str(n), r * 1.3, fonts, "caps")
        d.text((bx, h), str(n), font=nf, fill=_pn.BROWN + (255,), anchor="mm")
    spr = spr.resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(spr)
    bw = int(2 * r / 2 + 14)
    f = _font(text, size, fonts)
    t = _ellipsize(text, f, w - bw - 6)
    if rtl:
        _draw_text(d, (w - bw, h / 2.0), t, f, (255, 255, 255, 255), "rm")
    else:
        _draw_text(d, (bw, h / 2.0), t, f, (255, 255, 255, 255), "lm")
    return spr


def points_sprites(cfg, blk, area):
    """-> [(sprite, cx_off, cy_off)] one per line (centre offsets inside the area)."""
    ax, ay, aw, ah = area
    fonts = (cfg.get("t3") or {}).get("fonts")
    texts = [ln["text"] for ln in blk["lines"]]
    n = len(texts)
    lh = int(min(ah / max(n, 1), 56 * K * 0.8))
    bw = int(0.13 * 2 * lh + 14 + 8) if blk["bullet"] == "dot" else int(0.30 * 2 * lh + 14 + 8)
    size = _fit(texts, aw - bw - 6, lh * 0.5, fonts, lo=12)
    y0 = (ah - n * lh) / 2.0
    acc = _acc(cfg)
    out = []
    for i, tx in enumerate(texts):
        key = ("pt", tx, i + 1, blk["bullet"], int(aw), lh, size, acc, repr(fonts))
        spr = _cache(key, lambda tx=tx, i=i: _points_line_sprite(tx, i + 1, blk["bullet"], int(aw), lh, size, acc, fonts))
        out.append((spr, aw / 2.0, y0 + i * lh + lh / 2.0))
    return out


_NUM_RE = re.compile(r"^(\D*?)(\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?)(.*)$", re.S)


def _count_texts(value, steps):
    m = _NUM_RE.match(value)
    if not m:
        return [value]
    pre, num, suf = m.groups()
    dec = len(num.split(".")[1]) if "." in num else 0
    comma = "," in num
    target = float(num.replace(",", ""))
    outs = []
    for k in range(steps):
        p = 1 - (1 - (k + 1) / steps) ** 3
        v = target * p
        s = f"{v:,.{dec}f}" if comma else f"{v:.{dec}f}"
        outs.append(pre + s + suf)
    return outs


def _stat_sprite(value, label, sub, w, h, acc, fonts):
    """Composite (value + label + sub) sprite w x h; heavy italic number (sheared when the font is not italic), orange."""
    spr = Image.new("RGBA", (w, h), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    rtl = is_rtl_text(label)
    path, shear = t3_font("head", value, fonts)
    size = int(h * 0.50)
    while size > 18:
        f = ImageFont.truetype(path, size)
        if f.getlength(value) + shear * size <= w * 0.96:
            break
        size -= 2
    f = ImageFont.truetype(path, size)
    nh = int(size * 1.25)
    pad = int(shear * nh) + 4
    lay = Image.new("RGBA", (int(f.getlength(value)) + pad * 2 + 6, nh), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    ImageDraw.Draw(lay).text((pad, nh / 2.0), value, font=f, fill=acc, anchor="lm", stroke_width=1 if size > 30 else 0,
                             stroke_fill=acc)
    if shear:
        lay = lay.transform(lay.size, Image.AFFINE, (1, shear, -shear * nh / 2.0, 0, 1, 0), Image.BICUBIC)
    top = int(h * 0.50) - nh // 2 - int(h * 0.04)
    spr.alpha_composite(lay, (max(0, (w - lay.width) // 2), max(0, top)))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(spr)
    y = top + nh + int(h * 0.04)
    if label:
        lf = _font(label, _fit([label], w - 8, h * 0.13, fonts, lo=11), fonts)
        _draw_text(d, (w / 2.0, y), label, lf, _pn.CREAM + (255,), "ma")
        y += int(lf.size * 1.35)
    if sub:
        sf = _font(sub, _fit([sub], w - 8, h * 0.10, fonts, "light", lo=10), fonts, "light")
        _draw_text(d, (w / 2.0, y), sub, sf, _pn.CREAM + (190,), "ma")
    return spr


def stat_sprites(cfg, blk, area):
    """-> [sprite per count step] (a single sprite when no count-up)."""
    ax, ay, aw, ah = area
    acc = _acc(cfg)
    fonts = (cfg.get("t3") or {}).get("fonts")
    texts = _count_texts(blk["value"], 12) if blk["count_up"] else []
    texts = texts[:-1] + [blk["value"]] if texts else [blk["value"]]
    return [_cache(("st", v, blk["label"], blk["sub"], int(aw), int(ah), acc, repr(fonts)),
                   lambda v=v: _stat_sprite(v, blk["label"], blk["sub"], int(aw), int(ah), acc, fonts)) for v in texts]


def _rounded_frame(photo, w, h, radius=14):
    ph = ImageOps.fit(photo.convert("RGB"), (w * 2, h * 2), Image.LANCZOS, centering=(0.5, 0.4)).convert("RGBA")
    m = Image.new("L", (w * 2, h * 2), 0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(m).rounded_rectangle((0, 0, w * 2 - 1, h * 2 - 1), radius=radius * 2, fill=255)
    ImageDraw.Draw(ph).rounded_rectangle((1, 1, w * 2 - 2, h * 2 - 2), radius=radius * 2, outline=_pn.CREAM + (235,), width=5)
    out = Image.new("RGBA", (w * 2, h * 2), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    out.paste(ph, (0, 0), m)
    return out.resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)


def _media_geom(blk, area):
    ax, ay, aw, ah = area
    cap_h = int(22 * K * 0.8) if blk["caption"] else 0
    fh = int(ah - cap_h - 4)
    return int(aw), fh, cap_h


def _caption_sprite(text, w, h, fonts):
    spr = Image.new("RGBA", (w, h), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    f = _font(text, _fit([text], w - 6, h * 0.8, fonts, lo=10), fonts)
    _draw_text(ImageDraw.Draw(spr), (w / 2.0, h / 2.0), _ellipsize(text, f, w - 6), f, _pn.CREAM + (235,), "mm")
    return spr


def _media_photo(cfg, blk):
    """RGB still of a media block: the image, or the video frame at the segment start (original video or the given file)."""
    if blk["image"]:
        try:
            im = Image.open(blk["image"]).convert("RGB")
            im.load()
            return im
        except Exception:
            t3_warn(f"   [!] slot media image unreadable: {blk['image']}")
    elif blk["video"] or cfg.get("video"):
        im = _pn._video_frame(blk["video"] or cfg["video"], blk["seg_start"])
        if im is not None:
            return im
    return Image.new("RGB", (64, 64), (96, 96, 96))


def chips_layout(cfg, blk, area):
    """-> (chip rects [(x, y, w, h)] relative to the area, font size, text list). Rows wrap; the font shrinks until all fit."""
    ax, ay, aw, ah = area
    fonts = (cfg.get("t3") or {}).get("fonts")
    texts = [c["text"] for c in blk["chips"]]
    size = int(22 * K * 0.7)
    while True:
        f = _font(texts[0], size, fonts)
        ph, gap = int(size * 1.9), int(size * 0.55)
        rows, cur, curw = [], [], 0
        ws = [min(int(_font(t, size, fonts).getlength(shape(t))) + int(size * 1.6), int(aw)) for t in texts]
        for i, wd in enumerate(ws):
            if cur and curw + gap + wd > aw:
                rows.append((cur, curw))
                cur, curw = [], 0
            cur.append(i)
            curw += wd + (gap if len(cur) > 1 else 0)
        rows.append((cur, curw))
        tot = len(rows) * ph + (len(rows) - 1) * gap
        if (tot <= ah and all(r[1] <= aw for r in rows)) or size <= 11:
            break
        size -= 1
    rects = [None] * len(texts)
    y = (ah - tot) / 2.0
    for idxs, rw in rows:
        x = (aw - rw) / 2.0
        for i in idxs:
            rects[i] = (x, y, ws[i], ph)
            x += ws[i] + gap
        y += ph + gap
    return rects, size, texts


def _pill(text, w, h, size, fonts, acc, hot):
    spr = Image.new("RGBA", (w * 2, h * 2), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(spr)
    if hot:
        d.rounded_rectangle((0, 0, w * 2 - 1, h * 2 - 1), radius=h, fill=acc)
    else:
        d.rounded_rectangle((1, 1, w * 2 - 2, h * 2 - 2), radius=h, outline=_pn.CREAM + (235,), width=3)
    spr = spr.resize((w, h), Image.LANCZOS)
    f = _font(text, size, fonts)
    _draw_text(ImageDraw.Draw(spr), (w / 2.0, h / 2.0), _ellipsize(text, f, w - 8), f,
               (_pn.BROWN + (255,)) if hot else (_pn.CREAM + (255,)), "mm")
    return spr


def chips_sprites(cfg, blk, area):
    """-> (base sprite with all cream pills (area-sized), [(hot pill sprite, cx_off, cy_off)])"""
    ax, ay, aw, ah = area
    fonts = (cfg.get("t3") or {}).get("fonts")
    acc = _acc(cfg)
    rects, size, texts = chips_layout(cfg, blk, area)
    base = Image.new("RGBA", (int(aw), int(ah)), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    hot = []
    for t, (x, y, w, h) in zip(texts, rects):
        base.alpha_composite(_pill(t, int(w), int(h), size, fonts, acc, False), (int(x), int(y)))
        hot.append((_pill(t, int(w), int(h), size, fonts, acc, True), x + w / 2.0, y + h / 2.0))
    return base, hot


# ---- items ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class SlotItem(Item):
    """Item whose in / out animations can be switched off separately (fin / fout)."""
    __slots__ = ("fin", "fout")

    def __init__(self, sprite, start, end, cx, cy, anim, dur, fin=True, fout=True, rtl=False):
        Item.__init__(self, sprite, start, end, cx, cy, anim, dur, True, 1.0, rtl)
        self.fin, self.fout = fin, fout

    def progress(self, t):
        d = min(self.dur, (self.end - self.start) / 2.0)
        if d <= 1e-6 or self.anim in (None, "none"):
            return 1.0
        pin = (t - self.start) / d if self.fin else 1.0
        pout = (self.end - t) / d if self.fout else 1.0
        return max(0.0, min(1.0, pin, pout))


def slot_items(cfg, duration):
    """All slot Items (static sprites; animated overlays only for points reveal, count-up, chip highlight). [] when off."""
    if not slot_active(cfg):
        return []
    from mt.templates.t3 import dynamic as _dyn
    s = _scfg(cfg)
    (rx, ry, rw, rh), hh, area = slot_rects()
    ax, ay, aw, ah = area
    fonts = (cfg.get("t3") or {}).get("fonts")
    an, ad = s["anim"], s["anim_dur"]
    items = []
    still = bool(cfg.get("_t2_still"))
    for b in slot_resolve(cfg, duration):
        t0, t1 = b["t0"], b["t1"]
        if not _dyn._vis(t0, t1):
            continue

        def add(spr, a, b_, cx, cy, fin=True, fout=True, dur=ad, anim=an):
            items.append(SlotItem(spr, a, b_, ax + cx, ay + cy, anim, dur, fin, fout, rtl=False))
        if b["type"] == "points":
            for (spr, cx, cy), t in zip(points_sprites(cfg, b, area), b["lines_t"]):
                if t < t1 - 0.1:
                    add(spr, t, t1, cx, cy, fin=True, fout=True)
        elif b["type"] == "stat":
            sp = stat_sprites(cfg, b, area)
            n = len(sp)
            step = b["count_dur"] / max(n, 1) if n > 1 else 0
            for k, spr in enumerate(sp):
                a = t0 + k * step
                e = t0 + (k + 1) * step if k < n - 1 else t1
                if a >= t1 - 0.05:
                    break
                add(spr, a, min(e, t1), aw / 2.0, ah / 2.0, fin=(k == 0), fout=(k == n - 1))
        elif b["type"] == "chips":
            base, hot = chips_sprites(cfg, b, area)
            add(base, t0, t1, aw / 2.0, ah / 2.0)
            for a, e, i in b.get("chips_t", []):
                spr, cx, cy = hot[i]
                add(spr, a, e, cx, cy, fin=True, fout=(abs(e - t1) < 1e-6), dur=0.15, anim="fade")
        else:                                              # media
            fw, fh, ch_ = _media_geom(b, area)
            is_vid = (not b["image"])
            if (not is_vid) or still or not _vid_ok(cfg, b):
                photo = _cache(("mp", b["image"], b["video"], b["seg_start"], fw, fh, repr(cfg.get("video"))),
                               lambda: _rounded_frame(_media_photo(cfg, b), fw, fh))
                add(photo, t0, t1, aw / 2.0, fh / 2.0)
            if b["caption"]:
                add(_cache(("cp", b["caption"], fw, ch_, repr(fonts)), lambda: _caption_sprite(b["caption"], fw, ch_, fonts)),
                    t0, t1, aw / 2.0, fh + 4 + ch_ / 2.0)
    return items


def _vid_ok(cfg, b):
    src = b["video"] or cfg.get("video")
    return bool(src and os.path.isfile(str(src)))


# ---- baked media video segments (video layers) -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def slot_prepare_layers(cfg, info, tmpdir):
    """Media blocks with a video segment -> alpha clips (rounded frame + ring + fade/slide baked), same mechanism as the floating
    cards: a video layer with area 'canvas' and a fixed position (_xy). Frozen on the last frame when shorter than the block."""
    if not slot_active(cfg) or cfg.get("_t2_still"):
        return []
    from mt.common import FFMPEG
    W, H = cfg["canvas"]
    fps = info["fps"]
    fps_f = float(fps)
    fps_s = f"{fps.numerator}/{fps.denominator}" if fps.denominator != 1 else str(fps.numerator)
    dur_eff = info["duration"]
    if cfg.get("preview"):
        dur_eff = min(dur_eff, float(cfg["preview"]))
    s = _scfg(cfg)
    (rx, ry, rw, rh), hh, area = slot_rects()
    ax, ay, aw, ah = area
    layers = []
    for n, b in enumerate(x for x in slot_resolve(cfg, info["duration"]) if x["type"] == "media" and not x["image"]):
        if b["t0"] >= dur_eff or not _vid_ok(cfg, b):
            continue
        src = b["video"] or cfg["video"]
        fw, fh, _ = _media_geom(b, area)
        t0, t1 = b["t0"], min(b["t1"], dur_eff)
        dx, dy = anim_state(s["anim"], 0.0, W, H)[1:3]
        padx, pady = int(abs(dx)) + 8, int(abs(dy)) + 8
        x0, y0 = int(round(ax)) - padx, int(round(ay)) - pady
        Wp, Hp = fw + 2 * padx, fh + 2 * pady
        Wp, Hp = Wp + Wp % 2, Hp + Hp % 2
        x0, y0 = max(0, x0), max(0, y0)
        Wp, Hp = min(Wp, W - x0), min(Hp, H - y0)
        Wp, Hp = Wp - Wp % 2, Hp - Hp % 2
        nfr = max(1, int(math.ceil((t1 - t0) * fps_f)))
        seg = (b["seg_end"] - b["seg_start"]) if b["seg_end"] else max(0.1, t1 - t0)
        out = os.path.join(tmpdir, f"t3slot{n}.mov")
        rd = subprocess.Popen([FFMPEG, "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-ss", f"{b['seg_start']:.3f}", "-t", f"{seg:.3f}",
                               "-i", str(src), "-an", "-vf",
                               f"fps={fps_s},scale={fw}:{fh}:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop={fw}:{fh},format=rgb24",
                               "-frames:v", str(nfr), "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "rgb24", "pipe:1"],
                              stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        wr = subprocess.Popen([FFMPEG, "-y", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "rgba",
                               "-video_size", f"{Wp}x{Hp}", "-framerate", fps_s, "-i", "pipe:0", "-c:v", "qtrle", "-pix_fmt",
                               "argb", out], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        print(f"Preparing slot media clip {n + 1} ({Path(str(src)).name}, {nfr} frames)...")
        last = None
        try:
            for i in range(nfr):
                raw = b""
                need = fw * fh * 3
                while len(raw) < need:
                    ch = rd.stdout.read(need - len(raw))
                    if not ch:
                        break
                    raw += ch
                fr = Image.frombytes("RGB", (fw, fh), raw) if len(raw) == need else last
                if fr is None:
                    fr = Image.new("RGB", (fw, fh), (96, 96, 96))
                last = fr
                spr = _rounded_frame(fr, fw, fh)
                it = SlotItem(spr, t0, b["t1"], ax - x0 + fw / 2.0, ay - y0 + fh / 2.0, s["anim"], s["anim_dur"])
                canvas = Image.new("RGBA", (Wp, Hp), (0, 0, 0, 0))
                draw_item(canvas, it, anim_state(it.anim, it.progress(t0 + i / fps_f), W, H))
                wr.stdin.write(canvas.tobytes())
            wr.stdin.close()
        except (BrokenPipeError, OSError):
            pass
        finally:
            rd.kill()
            rd.wait()
        err = wr.stderr.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
        if wr.wait() != 0 or not os.path.isfile(out):
            raise SystemExit("[!] Could not prepare the slot media clip:\n" + err[-800:])
        layers.append({"path": out, "start": t0, "end": t1, "area": "canvas", "mode": "fit", "fade": 0.0, "_xy": [x0, y0]})
    from mt.templates.t3.layout import split_hide                  # T3-9: the clip is cut where a split hides the bands
    for a, b in split_hide(cfg, info["duration"]):
        for L in layers[:]:
            if L["start"] >= a and L["start"] < b:
                layers.remove(L)
            elif L["start"] < a < L["end"]:
                L["end"] = a
    return layers


# ---- questions ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def t3_ask_slot():
    """Centre-slot questions (Enter = default / last answer). Returns {"slot": {...}} (on False = old placeholder)."""
    from mt.common import D, ask, ask_choice, yn
    from mt.templates.t3.dynamic import _c_start
    on = yn("Fill the panel's centre column with content blocks (key points, stat, media, chips)?",
            default=D.get("t3_slot", "y") == "y")
    D["t3_slot"] = "y" if on else "n"
    if not on:
        return {"slot": {"on": False}}
    title = ask("Centre title ('-' = none)", default=SLOT_DEFAULTS["title"], key="t3_slot_title",
                cast=lambda v: "" if v.strip() == "-" else v.strip())
    icon = ICONS[ask_choice("Centre icon:", list(ICONS), default=1, key="t3_slot_icon") - 1]
    mode = ask_choice("Centre blocks:", ["Demo blocks (points, stat, chips)", "My own blocks", "None (hide the header too)"],
                      default=1, key="t3_slot_mode")
    base = {"on": True, "title": title, "icon": icon}
    if mode == 1:
        return {"slot": base}
    if mode == 3:
        return {"slot": dict(base, blocks=[])}
    blocks = []
    while len(blocks) < MAX_BLOCKS:
        k = len(blocks)
        ty = TYPES[ask_choice(f"Block {k + 1} type:", ["Key points", "Big stat", "Image / video", "Keyword chips"], default=1,
                              key=f"t3_slot_ty{k}") - 1]
        kind, val = ask(f"  Block {k + 1} starts at (seconds / mm:ss / spoken phrase, Enter = after the previous)", default="",
                        key=f"t3_slot_st{k}", allow_empty=True, cast=lambda v: ("t", None) if not v.strip() else _c_start(v))
        hold = ask("  Stays (seconds, Enter = until the next block)", default="", key=f"t3_slot_hold{k}", allow_empty=True,
                   cast=lambda v: None if not v.strip() else float(v))
        b = {"type": ty, "start": val if kind == "t" else None, "trigger": val if kind == "p" else "", "hold": hold}
        if ty == "points":
            n = int(ask("  How many lines (1-6)", default=4, key=f"t3_slot_pn{k}", cast=lambda v: max(1, min(6, int(v)))))
            b["lines"] = [ask(f"    Line {j + 1}", default=DEMO_BLOCKS[0]["lines"][j % 4], key=f"t3_slot_pl{k}_{j}",
                              cast=lambda v: v.strip()) for j in range(n)]
            b["bullet"] = ("dot", "number")[ask_choice("  Bullets:", ["Orange dots", "Numbers"], default=1, key=f"t3_slot_bu{k}") - 1]
        elif ty == "stat":
            b["value"] = ask("  Big number / text (e.g. 250+, 98%)", default="250+", key=f"t3_slot_sv{k}", cast=lambda v: v.strip())
            b["label"] = ask("  Label", default="VIDEOS EDITED", key=f"t3_slot_sl{k}", cast=lambda v: v.strip())
            b["sub"] = ask("  Small sub-text ('-' = none)", default="and counting", key=f"t3_slot_ss{k}",
                           cast=lambda v: "" if v.strip() == "-" else v.strip())
            b["count_up"] = yn("  Count up from 0?", default=D.get("t3_slot_cu", "y") == "y")
            D["t3_slot_cu"] = "y" if b["count_up"] else "n"
        elif ty == "media":
            src = ask("  Image or video file ('-' = a segment of your video)", default="-", key=f"t3_slot_mf{k}",
                      cast=lambda v: "" if v.strip() == "-" else v.strip().strip('"'))
            vid = src.lower().endswith((".mp4", ".mov", ".mkv", ".webm", ".avi", ".m4v"))
            if src and not vid:
                b["image"] = src
            else:
                b["video"] = src
                b["seg_start"] = ask("  Segment start (seconds)", default=0, key=f"t3_slot_ms{k}", cast=float)
                b["seg_end"] = ask("  Segment end (seconds)", default=3, key=f"t3_slot_me{k}", cast=float)
            b["caption"] = ask("  Caption ('-' = none)", default="Behind the scenes", key=f"t3_slot_mc{k}",
                               cast=lambda v: "" if v.strip() == "-" else v.strip())
        else:
            raw = ask("  Keywords (comma separated, up to 8; 'word@phrase' highlights at that spoken phrase)",
                      default="Design, Motion, Code, Audio, Story, Reels", key=f"t3_slot_ck{k}", cast=lambda v: v.strip())
            b["chips"] = [{"text": p.split("@", 1)[0].strip(), "trigger": p.split("@", 1)[1].strip() if "@" in p else ""}
                          for p in raw.split(",") if p.strip()][:MAX_CHIPS]
        blocks.append(b)
        if not yn("Add another block?", default=False):
            break
    return {"slot": dict(base, blocks=blocks)}

# T4 RULES

1. Scope: Template 4 = registry id 5, package mt/templates/t4/, config namespace cfg['t4']. Never change behaviour of ids 1-4. Generic files (render.py, draw.py, captions.py, ask.py, common.py) get only minimal guarded edits (if template_id == 5) or purely additive helpers.
2. Concept: the user's video is the BASE and fills the canvas. Everything else is an overlay layer. No opaque plate over the video centre unless the module is an explicit takeover (split, b-roll).
3. Canvases: reels 1080x1920 and youtube 1920x1080 (short side always 1080). Author layouts in pixels, safe margin 48 px. Every visual module must work and be checked on BOTH canvases.
4. Size: new files <= 500 lines, functions <= 80 lines, one responsibility per file, names t4_*.
5. Robustness: normalisers never raise; missing media -> gray placeholder + one t4_warn line; trigger phrase not found -> warn once and skip.
6. Arabic/RTL: use mt.fonts.shape and is_rtl_text; test every text module with Arabic and English strings.
7. Performance: static design goes to the foreground plate (cfg['_t2_fg']) or one sprite Item; cache plates; no per-frame Python drawing beyond Item animations.
8. Verification per task: (a) tools/mt_quick.py, tools/mt_t3_quick.py, tools/mt_t4_quick.py pass; (b) render --still on both canvases to out/t4/<task>_<canvas>.png, VIEW the images, compare with the cited R-image, fix once, re-check once, record remaining differences in T4_NOTES.md. Full --selftest only in P0, P22, P23.
9. Finish: append <= 12 lines to T4_NOTES.md (done / public functions / cfg keys / known gaps), git commit 'T4-Pn' if a repo exists. Do NOT start the next task. If running out of room, write RESUME HERE + the exact next step in T4_NOTES.md.

##### .\mt\templates\t4\cfg.py (full) #####
"""mt.templates.t4.cfg - Template 4 "Overlay Studio": config defaults + normaliser (cfg["t4"]).
The user's video is the BASE and fills the canvas; every module below is an overlay layer (placeholders until their P-task)."""
import copy
import re

CANVAS_REELS = [1080, 1920]
CANVAS_YOUTUBE = [1920, 1080]
T4_MODULES = ("frame", "nameplate", "corner_list", "tags", "tiles", "cards", "scenes", "split", "broll")
T4_DEFAULTS = {
    "canvas_mode": "auto",                                   # 'auto' (by the video aspect) | 'reels' | 'youtube'
    "fit": "fill",                                           # 'fill' (crop to the canvas) | 'fit' (whole video, letterboxed)
    "backdrop": {"type": "color", "value": "#000000", "path": "", "strength": 5},   # type color|image|blur; only visible when fit leaves bars
    **{m: {"on": False} for m in T4_MODULES},
}
_HEX = re.compile(r"^#?([0-9a-fA-F]{6}|[0-9a-fA-F]{3})$")


def t4_canvas(mode, video_info=None):
    """-> [1080, 1920] (reels) or [1920, 1080] (youtube). 'auto' = by the video aspect (wider than tall -> youtube; no info -> reels)."""
    m = str(mode or "auto").strip().lower()
    if m == "youtube":
        return list(CANVAS_YOUTUBE)
    if m == "reels":
        return list(CANVAS_REELS)
    try:
        return list(CANVAS_YOUTUBE) if float(video_info["w"]) > float(video_info["h"]) else list(CANVAS_REELS)
    except (TypeError, KeyError, ValueError):
        return list(CANVAS_REELS)


def _hex(v, default):
    m = _HEX.match(str(v).strip()) if isinstance(v, str) else None
    if not m:
        return default
    h = m.group(1)
    h = "".join(c * 2 for c in h) if len(h) == 3 else h
    return "#" + h.lower()


def _choice(v, allowed, default):
    v = str(v).strip().lower() if isinstance(v, str) else ""
    return v if v in allowed else default


def t4_cfg(raw):
    """Normalise cfg["t4"]: always returns a complete dict, never raises (junk values fall back to the defaults).
    Module dicts keep their extra keys (later P-tasks own them); only `on` is coerced to bool."""
    out = copy.deepcopy(T4_DEFAULTS)
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        return out
    try:
        out["canvas_mode"] = _choice(raw.get("canvas_mode"), ("auto", "reels", "youtube"), out["canvas_mode"])
        out["fit"] = _choice(raw.get("fit"), ("fill", "fit"), out["fit"])
        bd = raw.get("backdrop")
        if isinstance(bd, dict):
            b = out["backdrop"]
            b["type"] = _choice(bd.get("type"), ("color", "image", "blur"), b["type"])
            b["value"] = _hex(bd.get("value"), b["value"])
            b["path"] = bd["path"].strip() if isinstance(bd.get("path"), str) else ""
            try:
                b["strength"] = max(1, min(10, int(bd.get("strength", b["strength"]))))
            except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError):
                pass
        for m in T4_MODULES:
            src = raw.get(m)
            if isinstance(src, dict):
                d = copy.deepcopy(src)
                d["on"] = bool(src.get("on", False))
                out[m] = d
            elif m in ("tiles", "cards") and isinstance(src, list):          # tiles / cards = a LIST (t4/tiles.py, t4/cards.py normalise it)
                out[m] = copy.deepcopy(src)
        for k, v in raw.items():                         # unknown keys survive (forward compatibility with newer jobs)
            if k not in out:
                out[k] = copy.deepcopy(v)
    except Exception:
        return copy.deepcopy(T4_DEFAULTS)
    return out


##### .\mt\templates\t4\warn.py (full) #####
"""mt.templates.t4.warn - Template 4: one-line [!] messages, printed once per render (items are rebuilt per frame / segment)."""
_MSGS = set()


def t4_warn_reset():
    _MSGS.clear()


def t4_warn(msg):
    """Print '   [!] msg' once per render; never raises."""
    msg = "   [!] " + str(msg).strip()
    if msg not in _MSGS:
        _MSGS.add(msg)
        print(msg)

def _canvas_ok(c):
    try:
        return len(c) == 2 and all(int(v) > 0 for v in c)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return False


# ---- the T4 foreground plate (cfg['_t2_fg']): ONE transparent full-canvas PNG over the video, merged from the static parts ---------------
# Each part = (name, builder); builder(W, H, t4) -> RGBA image W x H | None (module off). List order = bottom -> top. A later module
# (nameplate, tags, ...) adds ONE line here: T4_FG_PARTS.append(("nameplate", t4_nameplate_part)) - never its own _t2_fg.
T4_FG_PARTS = [("frame", t4_frame_part)]


def t4_compose_fg(cfg, tmp):
    """Alpha-composite every active part into one plate, save tmp/t4_fg.png and point cfg['_t2_fg'] at it (the pipeline's generic
    foreground slot). No active part -> cfg['_t2_fg'] removed, returns None. A failing part warns once and is skipped; never raises."""
    cfg.pop("_t2_fg", None)
    try:
        W, H = int(cfg["canvas"][0]), int(cfg["canvas"][1])
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, IndexError):
        return None
    plate = None
    for name, build in T4_FG_PARTS:
        try:
            part = build(W, H, cfg.get("t4"))
        except Exception as e:
            t4_warn(f"{name}: could not be drawn ({type(e).__name__}: {e}) - skipped")
            continue
        if part is None:
            continue
        if part.size != (W, H):
            t4_warn(f"{name}: plate is {part.size[0]}x{part.size[1]}, canvas is {W}x{H} - skipped")
            continue
        if plate is None:
            plate = part.convert("RGBA")
        else:
            plate.alpha_composite(part.convert("RGBA"))
    if plate is None:
        return None
    path = os.path.join(tmp or tempfile.gettempdir(), "t4_fg.png")
    plate.save(path, compress_level=1)
    cfg["_t2_fg"] = path
    return path


def t4_build_static_layers(cfg, tmp):
    """Hook build_background: solid backdrop + the foreground plate. The video is the base, so video_box is forced to the full canvas
    (fill / fit from cfg["t4"]); a job without a usable canvas gets one from canvas_mode + the video shape."""
    t4_warn_reset()
    t4 = t4_cfg(cfg.get("t4"))
    cfg["t4"] = t4
    if not _canvas_ok(cfg.get("canvas")):
        info = None
        try:
            info = probe(cfg["video"]) if cfg.get("video") and os.path.isfile(str(cfg["video"])) else None
        except Exception:
            info = None
        cfg["canvas"] = t4_canvas(t4["canvas_mode"], info)
    cfg["canvas"] = [int(cfg["canvas"][0]), int(cfg["canvas"][1])]
    cfg["video_box"] = _full_box(cfg["canvas"], t4["fit"])
    t4_apply_backdrop(cfg, t4)
    t4["frame"] = t4_frame_cfg(t4.get("frame"))        # complete {on, text, color, icon, show_ticks} (extras kept)
    t4["nameplate"] = t4_nameplate_cfg(t4.get("nameplate"))          # complete dicts (extras kept); drawn as Items by t4_build_items
    t4["corner_list"] = t4_corner_list_cfg(t4.get("corner_list"))
    t4["tiles"] = t4_tiles_cfg(t4.get("tiles")) or {"on": False}      # complete groups (extras kept), drawn as Items by t4_build_items
    t4["cards"] = t4_cards_cfg(t4.get("cards")) or {"on": False}      # complete image cards (extras kept), drawn as Items by t4_build_items
    t4_compose_fg(cfg, tmp)


def t4_build_items(cfg, duration, splits, lbox, rbox):
    return t4_caption_items(cfg, duration) + t4_nameplate_items(cfg, duration) + t4_tiles_items(cfg, duration) + t4_cards_items(cfg, duration)   # captions (render.py skips t4_style) + tag / list + logo tiles + image cards


##### .\mt\templates\t4\timing.py :: _num, _label, _start, t4_time, t4_stagger, t4_ask_when #####
def _num(v):
    """Seconds from a number or '12', '0:45', '3s' -> float; anything else (None, bool, nan, junk) -> None. Never raises."""
    if v is None or isinstance(v, bool):
        return None
    try:
        x = float(c_time(v)) if isinstance(v, str) else float(v)
    except (ValueError, TypeError, OverflowError):
        return None
    return x if math.isfinite(x) else None



def _label(entry):
    for k in ("label", "name", "title", "text", "trigger"):
        v = entry.get(k)
        if isinstance(v, str) and v.strip():
            return "'%s'" % v.strip()[:40]
    return "entry"



def _start(entry, cues, lab):
    """trigger (spoken phrase) first, else the fixed start; None + one warning when neither gives a time."""
    fixed = _num(entry.get("start"))
    phrase = entry.get("trigger")
    phrase = phrase.strip() if isinstance(phrase, str) else ""
    if phrase:
        t = _find(cues, phrase)
        if t is not None:
            return t
        if fixed is None:
            t4_warn("%s: phrase '%s' not found in the captions and no start time - skipped." % (lab, phrase))
            return None
        t4_warn("%s: phrase '%s' not found in the captions - using its start time." % (lab, phrase))
    if fixed is None:
        t4_warn("%s: no start time and no trigger phrase - skipped." % lab)
    return fixed



def t4_time(entry, cues, duration, default_hold):
    """-> (start, end) in seconds, or None (skip the entry).
    start: `trigger` (spoken phrase found in cues via find_trigger; cues = one cue list or a list of streams) else `start`.
    end:   `end` (absolute, must be after start) else start + `hold` else start + default_hold (None / <= 0 -> to the video end).
    Start at or after the video end -> None; an end past the video end is clamped to `duration` (duration None / <= 0 = unknown,
    no clamping). A negative start becomes 0. Junk input never raises (one t4_warn line, None)."""
    if not isinstance(entry, dict):
        t4_warn("timing: entry is not a dict - skipped.")
        return None
    lab = _label(entry)
    st = _start(entry, cues, lab)
    if st is None:
        return None
    st = max(0.0, st)
    dur = _num(duration)
    dur = dur if dur and dur > 0 else None
    if dur is not None and st >= dur:
        t4_warn("%s: starts at %.2f s, after the video end (%.2f s) - skipped." % (lab, st, dur))
        return None
    en = _num(entry.get("end"))
    if en is not None and en <= st + MIN_SPAN:
        t4_warn("%s: end %.2f s is not after the start %.2f s - using the hold time." % (lab, en, st))
        en = None
    if en is None:
        hold = _num(entry.get("hold"))
        if hold is None or hold <= 0:
            hold = _num(default_hold)
        en = st + hold if hold and hold > 0 else (dur if dur is not None else None)
    if en is None:
        t4_warn("%s: no end / hold and the video length is unknown - skipped." % lab)
        return None
    if dur is not None:
        en = min(en, dur)
    return (st, en) if en - st >= MIN_SPAN else None



def t4_stagger(n, step):
    """Entry delays for n items that appear one after another: [0, step, 2*step, ...]. n <= 0 -> []; bad step -> 0.0."""
    try:
        n = max(0, int(n))
    except (ValueError, TypeError, OverflowError):
        return []
    s = _num(step)
    s = s if s is not None and s > 0 else 0.0
    return [round(i * s, 6) for i in range(n)]



def t4_ask_when(prompt, default_hold=4.0, key=None):
    """The one shared 'when does it show' question. -> {"start": seconds, "hold": s} or {"trigger": phrase, "hold": s}
    (both shapes are accepted by t4_time). key = optional prefix that remembers the answers (mt.common.D)."""
    k = (lambda n: key + n) if key else (lambda n: None)
    mode = ask_choice(f"{prompt} - when should it appear?",
                      ["At a fixed time (seconds or mm:ss)", "When a phrase is spoken (it must be in the captions)"],
                      default=1, key=k("_mode"))
    if mode == 1:
        out = {"start": ask("Start at  (seconds or mm:ss)", default=0, key=k("_start"), cast=c_time)}
    else:
        out = {"trigger": ask("Spoken phrase", key=k("_trigger")).strip()}
    out["hold"] = ask("Keep it on screen for how many seconds", default=default_hold, key=k("_hold"), cast=_c_hold)
    return out

_TOKENS = ("group", "group-top", "group-bottom", "group-left", "group-right")
_TILE = {}


# ---- config -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _anchor(v, default):
    s = str(v).strip().lower().replace("_", "-").replace(" ", "-") if isinstance(v, (str, int)) and not isinstance(v, bool) else ""
    s = PRESETS.get(s, s)
    s = {"middle": "center", "centre": "center", "top-center": "top", "bottom-center": "bottom"}.get(s, s)
    return s if s in ANCHORS else default


def _num_or_pct(v):
    """12, '12', '40%' -> kept as given (number or 'NN%' string); anything else -> None."""
    if isinstance(v, bool):
        return None
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
        return float(v) if math.isfinite(v) else None
    if isinstance(v, str):
        t = v.strip()
        try:
            return t if t.endswith("%") and math.isfinite(float(t[:-1])) else float(t)
        except ValueError:
            return None
    return None


def _point(p):
    """[x, y] / (x, y) / 'x,y' / a group token -> [x, y] | token | None."""
    if isinstance(p, str):
        t = p.strip().lower()
        if t in _TOKENS:
            return t
        p = [a for a in t.replace(";", ",").split(",")]
    if isinstance(p, (list, tuple)) and len(p) == 2:
        a, b = _num_or_pct(p[0]), _num_or_pct(p[1])
        return [a, b] if a is not None and b is not None else None
    return None


def _conn(raw):
    out = copy.deepcopy(_CONN)
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        return {}
    pts = [_point(p) for p in raw.get("points", [])] if isinstance(raw.get("points"), (list, tuple)) else []
    out["points"] = [p for p in pts if p is not None][:12]
    out["color"] = _hex(raw.get("color"), out["color"])
    ed = raw.get("end_dot")
    out["end_dot"] = ed if ed in (True, False, "both", "start") else True
    out["width"], out["glow"] = _flt(raw.get("width"), 0.5, 30, 2.5), _flt(raw.get("glow"), 0, 60, 9.0)
    return out if len(out["points"]) >= 2 else {}


def _group(raw):
    out = copy.deepcopy(T4_TILES)
    out.update({k: copy.deepcopy(v) for k, v in raw.items() if k not in out})                       # extras survive
    imgs = raw.get("images")
    out["images"] = [i.strip() for i in imgs if isinstance(i, str) and i.strip()][:MAX_IMAGES] if isinstance(imgs, (list, tuple)) else []
    try:
        out["cols"] = max(1, min(8, int(raw.get("cols", 2))))
    except (TypeError, ValueError, OverflowError):
        out["cols"] = 2
    out["gap"], out["size"] = _flt(raw.get("gap"), 0, 200, 18.0), _flt(raw.get("size"), 40, 600, 150.0)
    out["anchor"] = _anchor(raw.get("anchor"), "left")
    xy = _point(raw.get("xy"))
    out["xy"] = xy if isinstance(xy, list) else None
    out["inset_x"], out["inset_y"] = _flt(raw.get("inset_x"), 0, 600, 0.0), _flt(raw.get("inset_y"), 0, 600, 0.0)
    out["border"] = _hex(raw.get("border"), "#c4d6ef")
    out["connector"] = _conn(raw.get("connector"))
    trig = raw.get("trigger")
    out["trigger"] = trig.strip() if isinstance(trig, str) else ""
    out["start"] = raw["start"] if raw.get("start") is not None else (None if out["trigger"] else 0.0)      # a phrase never falls back to 0
    out["end"], out["hold"] = raw.get("end"), raw.get("hold")
    a = raw.get("anim")
    a = ("reveal" if a.strip().lower() == "typewriter" else a.strip().lower()) if isinstance(a, str) else "pop"
    out["anim"] = a if a in ANIMS or a in ("pop", "none") else "pop"
    out["anim_dur"], out["stagger"] = _flt(raw.get("anim_dur"), 0.0, 5.0, 0.35), _flt(raw.get("stagger"), 0.0, 2.0, 0.12)
    out["on"] = _bool(raw.get("on"), True)
    return out


def t4_tiles_cfg(raw):
    """Normalise cfg['t4']['tiles'] -> list of complete groups. Accepts a list of groups, one group dict or {on, groups: [...]} (module
    default {'on': False} = no groups). Never raises; junk entries are dropped."""
    try:
        if isinstance(raw, dict) and "images" in raw:
            raw = [raw]
        elif isinstance(raw, dict):
            raw = raw.get("groups") if _bool(raw.get("on"), False) else []
        return [_group(g) for g in raw if isinstance(g, dict)] if isinstance(raw, (list, tuple)) else []
    except Exception:
        return []


# ---- sprites ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _load_logo(path):
    """-> RGBA image, or None (missing / not an image). First frame of animated files."""
    try:
        if not path or not os.path.isfile(str(path)):
            return None
        with Image.open(str(path)) as im:
            im.seek(0)
            return im.convert("RGBA")
    except Exception:
        return None


def _placeholder(box):
    """Gray rounded square with a small 'image' mark - stands in for a missing logo (box = px)."""
    n = max(8, int(box))
    ph = Image.new("RGBA", (n, n), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    t2_paint(ph, t2_rrect_mask((0, 0, n, n), n * 0.16), (128, 132, 140), 0.85)
    t2_paint(ph, t2_rrect_mask((n * 0.20, n * 0.24, n * 0.80, n * 0.76), n * 0.06), (60, 64, 72), 0.9)
    t2_paint(ph, t2_rrect_mask((n * 0.30, n * 0.56, n * 0.50, n * 0.68), n * 0.03), (160, 166, 176))
    return ph


def _build_tile(path, size, border, scale):
    sz = max(24, int(round(size * scale)))
    sp = glass_panel((sz, sz), sz * 0.22, TINT, border, 0, max(1.4, sz * 0.010), max(2.5, sz * 0.022))      # thin soft border as R2
    ox, oy = sp.info["origin"]
    box, msg = int(round(sz * LOGO_FRAC)), None
    logo = _load_logo(path)
    if logo is None:
        msg = "tiles: image '%s' is missing or not a readable image - gray placeholder." % (Path(str(path)).name or "(empty path)")
        logo = _placeholder(box)
    k = min(box / logo.width, box / logo.height)
    lw, lh = max(1, int(round(logo.width * k))), max(1, int(round(logo.height * k)))
    logo = logo.resize((lw, lh), Image.LANCZOS)
    kit_paste(sp, logo, ox + (sz - lw) / 2.0, oy + (sz - lh) / 2.0)
    sp.info["panel"] = sz
    return sp, msg


def t4_tile_sprite(path, size=150, border="#c4d6ef", scale=1.0):
    """One glass tile with the logo fitted + centred -> RGBA sprite (glow margin included; sprite.info['origin'] = the tile's top-left,
    sprite.info['panel'] = tile edge px). A missing / unreadable file gives a gray placeholder (the one-line warning goes through t4_warn).
    Cached per (path, size, border, scale); a cache hit warns again so a new render still reports it (t4_warn prints once per render)."""
    key = (str(path), round(float(size) * float(scale)), str(border), round(float(scale), 3), os.path.getmtime(path) if path and os.path.isfile(str(path)) else 0)
    sp, msg = _cached(_TILE, key, lambda: _build_tile(path, float(size), border, float(scale)), 48)
    if msg:
        t4_warn(msg)
    return sp


# ---- layout -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _grid(n, cols, size, gap):
    """Top-left of every tile inside the group box + the box size; a short last row is centred. -> ([(x, y)], gw, gh)."""
    cols = max(1, min(cols, n))
    rows = int(math.ceil(n / float(cols)))
    gw, gh = cols * size + (cols - 1) * gap, rows * size + (rows - 1) * gap
    pos = []
    for i in range(n):
        r, c = divmod(i, cols)
        in_row = min(cols, n - r * cols)
        pos.append((c * (size + gap) + (cols - in_row) * (size + gap) / 2.0, r * (size + gap)))
    return pos, gw, gh


def _footprint(tiles, pos, gw, gh, pad):
    """All tiles composited into one sprite - only used to measure the group's ink for the anchor / frame placement."""
    fp = Image.new("RGBA", (int(gw) + 2 * pad, int(gh) + 2 * pad), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    for sp, (x, y) in zip(tiles, pos):
        ox, oy = sp.info["origin"]
        fp.alpha_composite(sp, (int(round(pad + x)) - ox, int(round(pad + y)) - oy))
    return fp


def _coord(v, total, s):
    return total * float(v[:-1]) / 100.0 if isinstance(v, str) else float(v) * s


def _conn_points(c, gbox, W, H, s):
    """Resolve numbers / '%' / group tokens to canvas px, clamped so the line's VISIBLE ink (glow tail + end dot) stays in the 48 px safe area."""
    m, out = (T4_SAFE + c["glow"] * 1.6 + 2) * s, []
    gx0, gy0, gx1, gy1 = gbox
    named = {"group": ((gx0 + gx1) / 2.0, (gy0 + gy1) / 2.0), "group-top": ((gx0 + gx1) / 2.0, gy0), "group-bottom": ((gx0 + gx1) / 2.0, gy1),
             "group-left": (gx0, (gy0 + gy1) / 2.0), "group-right": (gx1, (gy0 + gy1) / 2.0)}
    for p in c["points"]:
        x, y = named[p] if isinstance(p, str) else (_coord(p[0], W, s), _coord(p[1], H, s))
        out.append((min(max(x, m), W - m), min(max(y, m), H - m)))
    return out


# ---- items ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class TileItem(Item):
    """Tile with anim 't4_pop': in = pop, out = pure fade (progress < 0 encodes the exit, see mt/anim.py)."""

    def progress(self, t):
        L = self.end - self.start
        d = min(self.dur, L / 2.0)
        if d <= 1e-6:
            return 1.0
        pin, pout = (t - self.start) / d, (self.end - t) / d
        if pout < 1.0 and pout <= pin:
            return -max(0.0, pout)
        return max(0.0, min(1.0, pin))


def _make_item(sp, st, en, cx, cy, c):
    if c["anim"] == "pop":
        return TileItem(sp, st, en, cx, cy, "t4_pop", c["anim_dur"], out=True)
    return Item(sp, st, en, cx, cy, c["anim"], c["anim_dur"], out=True)


def _conn_sprite(c, pts, s):
    """Connector sprite + the item centre that puts its local (0, 0) back on the canvas origin (points are canvas coordinates)."""
    k = c["connector"]
    sp = connector(pts, k["color"], k["end_dot"], k["width"] * s, k["glow"] * s)
    ox, oy = sp.info["origin"]
    return sp, -ox + sp.width / 2.0, -oy + sp.height / 2.0


def _one_group(cfg, c, idx, duration, W, H, s, fm, placed):
    label = "tiles group %d" % (idx + 1)
    if not c["images"]:
        t4_warn("%s: no images - skipped." % label)
        return []
    win = _window(cfg, c, label, duration, 5.0)
    if win is None:
        return []
    n, size, gap = len(c["images"]), c["size"] * s, c["gap"] * s
    tiles = [t4_tile_sprite(p, c["size"], c["border"], s) for p in c["images"]]
    pos, gw, gh = _grid(n, c["cols"], size, gap)
    pad = tiles[0].info["origin"][0]
    fp = _footprint(tiles, pos, gw, gh, pad)
    if c["xy"]:
        pl = _place_xy(fp, c["xy"], W, H, s)
    else:
        pl = _place(fp, c["anchor"], W, H, s, c["inset_x"], c["inset_y"], fm, label)
    if pl is None:
        return []
    fcx, fcy, rect, _ = pl
    placed.append((label, rect))
    left, top = fcx - fp.width / 2.0, fcy - fp.height / 2.0                       # the footprint sprite's top-left on the canvas
    steps = t4_stagger(n, c["stagger"])
    last = max(win[0], win[1] - 0.1)
    items = [_make_item(sp, min(win[0] + d, last), win[1], left + pad + x + size / 2.0, top + pad + y + size / 2.0, c)
             for sp, (x, y), d in zip(tiles, pos, steps)]
    if c["connector"]:
        gbox = (left + pad, top + pad, left + pad + gw, top + pad + gh)
        sp, cx, cy = _conn_sprite(c, _conn_points(c["connector"], gbox, W, H, s), s)
        items.append(Item(sp, min(win[0] + (steps[-1] if steps else 0.0) + c["anim_dur"], last), win[1], cx, cy, "fade", c["anim_dur"], out=True))
    return items


def _place_xy(fp, xy, W, H, s):
    """Group centred on xy (px / '%'), then clamped so its ink keeps the 48 px safe margin -> same tuple as nameplate._place."""
    from mt.templates.t4.nameplate import _ink_box
    box = _ink_box(fp)
    if box is None:
        return None
    w, h, m = box[2] - box[0], box[3] - box[1], T4_SAFE * s
    x = int(round(min(max(_coord(xy[0], W, s) - w / 2.0, m), W - m - w)))
    y = int(round(min(max(_coord(xy[1], H, s) - h / 2.0, m), H - m - h)))
    return x - box[0] + fp.width / 2.0, y - box[1] + fp.height / 2.0, (x, y, x + w, y + h), 0


def _warn_overlaps(placed):
    for i, (a, ra) in enumerate(placed):
        for b, rb in placed[i + 1:]:
            if ra[0] < rb[2] and rb[0] < ra[2] and ra[1] < rb[3] and rb[1] < ra[3]:
                t4_warn("%s and %s overlap - give one of them another anchor / xy." % (a, b))


def t4_tiles_items(cfg, duration):
    """Items of every tiles group: one per tile (staggered pop-in) + one for the connector; all fade out together. Never raises."""
    t4 = cfg.get("t4") if isinstance(cfg, dict) and isinstance(cfg.get("t4"), dict) else {}
    groups = [g for g in t4_tiles_cfg(t4.get("tiles")) if g["on"]]
    if not groups:
        return []
    try:
        W, H = int(cfg["canvas"][0]), int(cfg["canvas"][1])
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, IndexError):
        t4_warn("t4 tiles: the job has no canvas - skipped.")
        return []
    s, items, placed = min(W, H) / 1080.0, [], []
    try:
        fm = _frame_mask(W, H, t4_frame_cfg(t4.get("frame")), s)
        for i, g in enumerate(groups):
            items += _one_group(cfg, g, i, duration, W, H, s, fm, placed)
        _warn_overlaps(placed)
    except Exception as e:
        t4_warn("t4 tiles: could not be drawn (%s: %s) - skipped." % (type(e).__name__, e))
    return items


# ---- questions --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _c_points(s):
    pts = [_point(p.strip()) for p in s.replace("|", ";").split(";") if p.strip()]
    if len(pts) < 2 or any(p is None for p in pts):
        raise ValueError("enter at least 2 points like  100,900; 250,1000  (px or %, or the words group-bottom / group-right ...)")
    return pts


def t4_ask_tiles():
    """Question group 'tiles' (called by t4_ask_config). -> a list with ONE group, or {'on': False}. More groups: edit the job file."""
    if not yn("Add glass logo tiles (PNG logos in a grid - reference R2)?", default=False):
        return {"on": False}
    imgs = []
    while len(imgs) < MAX_IMAGES:
        p = ask("Logo %d (PNG / image path, Enter = %s)" % (len(imgs) + 1, "done" if imgs else "at least one is needed"),
                key="t4_tiles_img%d" % (len(imgs) + 1), cast=c_existing_file(IMAGE_EXTS), allow_empty=bool(imgs))
        if not p:
            break
        imgs.append(p)
    g = {"images": imgs, "cols": ask("Columns", default=2, key="t4_tiles_cols", cast=c_int),
         "size": ask("Tile size (px, for a 1080 px short side)", default=T4_TILES["size"], key="t4_tiles_size", cast=c_float)}
    a = ask_choice("Where?", ["Top-left", "Top", "Top-right", "Left", "Center", "Right", "Bottom-left", "Bottom", "Bottom-right"],
                   default=4, key="t4_tiles_anchor")
    g["anchor"] = ANCHORS[a - 1]
    if yn("Add a connector line ending in a glowing dot?", default=False):
        pts = ask("Connector points  x,y; x,y; ...  (px or %, first may be group-bottom / group-right)", default="group-bottom; 30%,55%",
                  key="t4_tiles_conn", cast=_c_points)
        g["connector"] = {"points": pts, "end_dot": yn("Dot at both ends (No = only at the target)?", default=False) and "both" or True}
    g.update(t4_ask_when("Logo tiles", 5.0, key="t4_tiles_when"))
    g["anim"] = ask_anim("Tile animation (pop = staggered pop-in, fade-out together)", default="pop", key="t4_tiles_anim")
    return [g]


##### .\mt\templates\t4\nameplate_tags.py (full) #####
"""mt.templates.t4.nameplate_tags - Template 4: the two name-tag sprites of the 'nameplate' module.
  tag_a  ref R2:  dark glass panel with hexagon-cut ends (big cuts on the left), neon border, '</>' icon | divider | name + role,
                  three slanted stripes inside the bottom-right corner.
  tag_b  ref R10: chamfered panel with a faint second outline, icon | divider | NAME (white) + ROLE (neon colour) in capitals, a bright
                  bar on the bottom edge and five slanted stripes hanging below it.
Public: TAG_STYLES, T4_TAG, t4_tag_sprite(style, name, role, icon, color, font, scale, max_w) -> RGBA sprite | None.
Authored in px at short side 1080 (scale = short side / 1080). The sprite carries its own glow margin (about 30 px); the placement
code (nameplate.py) measures the visible ink, so the margin never counts against the 48 px safe area. Arabic / RTL text is shaped with
mt.fonts.shape and right-aligned in the text area; Latin text is left-aligned."""
import os
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

from mt.draw import t2_lighten, t2_rgb
from mt.fonts import default_font, is_rtl_text, load_font, shape
from mt.templates.t4.kit import chamfer_rect, connector, glass_panel, hazard_stripes, kit_paste, neon_icon, neon_stroke

TAG_STYLES = ("tag_a", "tag_b")
T4_TAG = {                                    # px at short side 1080; cut = chamfers (top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left)
    "tag_a": {"h": 124, "min_w": 440, "icon_w": 112, "icon": 58, "name": 38, "role": 26, "right": 104, "cut": (26, 16, 12, 26), "caps": False},
    "tag_b": {"h": 112, "min_w": 520, "icon_w": 108, "icon": 54, "name": 34, "role": 24, "right": 44, "cut": (24, 24, 24, 16), "caps": True},
}
GLOW_PAD = 30                                 # transparent margin around the panel (glow room), px at short side 1080
TINT = (5, 12, 30, 214)                       # panel fill (rgba): darker than the kit's default glass, as R2 / R10


def _is_bold(path):
    n = Path(str(path)).stem.lower().replace("-", "").replace(" ", "")
    return any(k in n for k in ("bold", "black", "heavy", "extrabold", "semibold"))


def _fade(sp, a):
    sp.putalpha(sp.getchannel("A").point(lambda v: int(v * a)))
    return sp


def _fit(lines, fp, sizes, avail):
    """Shrink both font sizes together (down to 55 %), then cut the widest line with '...' until it fits `avail` px.
    -> (fonts, shaped lines, widest width). An empty line is allowed (width 0)."""
    texts, k = [str(t) for t in lines], 1.0
    for _ in range(120):
        fonts = [load_font(fp, max(8, int(round(sz * k)))) for sz in sizes]
        shaped = [shape(t) for t in texts]
        ws = [f.getlength(t) if t else 0.0 for f, t in zip(fonts, shaped)]
        if max(ws) <= avail or max(len(t) for t in texts) <= 2:
            break
        if k > 0.55:
            k -= 0.05
        else:
            i = ws.index(max(ws))
            texts[i] = texts[i][:-2].rstrip() + "…"
    return fonts, shaped, max(ws)


# ---- parts ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _panel(spr, style, w, H, g, col, s):
    """Glass panel + the style's extras (tag_a: stripes inside the corner; tag_b: outer outline, bottom bar, hanging stripes)."""
    sp = T4_TAG[style]
    cut = tuple(c * s for c in sp["cut"])
    if style == "tag_b":                                                # faint second outline, 8 px outside (R10's double border)
        d = 8 * s
        outer = neon_stroke(chamfer_rect((w + 2 * d, H + 2 * d), tuple(c + d for c in cut)), col, 1.4 * s, 5 * s)
        kit_paste(spr, _fade(outer, 0.45), g - d, g - d)
        ln = connector([(g + 44 * s, g + H + 9 * s), (g + w * 0.50, g + H + 9 * s)], col, False, 1.5 * s, 5 * s)
        kit_paste(spr, _fade(ln, 0.55), 0, 0)
    kit_paste(spr, glass_panel((w, H), 0, TINT, col, cut, 2.6 * s, 11 * s), g, g)
    if style == "tag_a":
        sw, sh = int(round(62 * s)), int(round(24 * s))
        kit_paste(spr, hazard_stripes((sw, sh), 35.0, col, 5, 10 * s, 6 * s), g + w - 24 * s - sw, g + H - 15 * s - sh)
    else:
        bar = connector([(g + w * 0.24, g + H), (g + w * 0.36, g + H)], t2_lighten(col, 0.30), False, 5 * s, 10 * s)
        kit_paste(spr, bar, 0, 0)
        sw, sh = int(round(116 * s)), int(round(18 * s))
        kit_paste(spr, hazard_stripes((sw, sh), 35.0, col, 5, 12 * s, 7 * s), g + w * 0.53, g + H - 4 * s)


def _emblem(spr, icon, left, H, g, col, s):
    """Neon icon centred in the left block + the thin vertical divider on its right edge. No icon -> nothing."""
    if not icon:
        return
    isz = int(round(T4_TAG["tag_a"]["icon"] * s))
    ic = neon_icon(icon, isz, col, 8 * s)
    kit_paste(spr, ic, g + left / 2.0 - isz / 2.0, g + H / 2.0 - isz / 2.0)
    x = g + left
    kit_paste(spr, connector([(x, g + H * 0.24), (x, g + H * 0.76)], t2_lighten(col, 0.15), False, 2.0 * s, 5 * s), 0, 0)


def _texts(spr, fonts, shaped, x0, x1, ymid, rtl, bold, fills, s):
    """Lines stacked and centred on ymid. LTR: left edge x0; RTL: right edge x1. Non-bold fonts get a thin same-colour stroke."""
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(spr)
    gap = 7 * s
    lines = [(f, t, c) for f, t, c in zip(fonts, shaped, fills) if t]
    total = sum(f.getmetrics()[0] + f.getmetrics()[1] for f, _, _ in lines) + gap * (len(lines) - 1)
    y = ymid - total / 2.0
    for i, (f, t, c) in enumerate(lines):
        asc, desc = f.getmetrics()
        sw = 1 if (i == 0 and not bold and f.size >= 24) else 0
        d.text((x1 if rtl else x0, y + asc), t, font=f, fill=c + (255,), anchor="rs" if rtl else "ls", stroke_width=sw, stroke_fill=c + (255,))
        y += asc + desc + gap


# ---- public -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def t4_tag_sprite(style, name, role="", icon="code", color="#19D3FF", font=None, scale=1.0, max_w=None):
    """RGBA sprite of a name tag, or None when name and role are both empty. Unknown style -> 'tag_a'. max_w = widest allowed PANEL (px):
    text shrinks, then is cut with '...'. sprite.info: panel (w, h in px), rtl. Never raises on odd text / colour / font values."""
    style = style if style in T4_TAG else "tag_a"
    sp = T4_TAG[style]
    name, role = str(name or "").strip(), str(role or "").strip()
    if not name and not role:
        return None
    if sp["caps"]:
        name, role = name.upper(), role.upper()
    s = max(0.2, float(scale))
    fp = font if font and os.path.isfile(str(font)) else default_font()
    col = t2_rgb(color)
    H, g = int(round(sp["h"] * s)), int(round(GLOW_PAD * s))
    left, right = int(round((sp["icon_w"] if icon else 34) * s)), int(round(sp["right"] * s))
    gapx = int(round(26 * s)) if icon else 0                              # divider -> text
    avail = (float(max_w) - left - gapx - right) if max_w else 10.0 ** 6
    fonts, shaped, tw = _fit([name, role], fp, (sp["name"] * s, sp["role"] * s), max(40.0, avail))
    w = int(max(sp["min_w"] * s, left + gapx + tw + right))
    if max_w:
        w = min(w, int(max_w))
    ext = int(round(14 * s)) if style == "tag_b" else 0
    spr = Image.new("RGBA", (w + 2 * g, H + ext + 2 * g), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    _panel(spr, style, w, H, g, col, s)
    _emblem(spr, icon, left, H, g, col, s)
    rtl = is_rtl_text(name + " " + role)
    role_col = t2_lighten(col, 0.15) if style == "tag_b" else (226, 234, 246)
    area0, area1 = g + left + gapx, g + w - right
    _texts(spr, fonts, shaped, area0, area1, g + H / 2.0, rtl, _is_bold(fp), [(255, 255, 255), role_col], s)
    spr.info["panel"], spr.info["rtl"] = (w, H), rtl
    return spr

##### .\mt\templates\t4\nameplate.py :: _cached, _frame_mask, _ink_box, _pooled, _place, _clear_shift, _font, _cues, _window #####
def _cached(cache, key, make, limit=12):
    if key not in cache:
        if len(cache) >= limit:
            cache.pop(next(iter(cache)))
        cache[key] = make()
    return cache[key]



def _frame_mask(W, H, fcfg, s):
    """Quarter-size 'L' mask of where the frame is solid, grown by GAP px (conservative). None when the frame is off."""
    if not fcfg["on"]:
        return None

    def make():
        a = t4_frame_plate(W, H, fcfg).getchannel("A").point(lambda v: 255 if v > FRAME_THR else 0)
        q = a.resize(((W + 3) // 4, (H + 3) // 4), Image.BOX).point(lambda v: 255 if v > 0 else 0)
        return q.filter(ImageFilter.MaxFilter(2 * int(math.ceil((GAP * s + 4) / 4.0)) + 1))
    return _cached(_FM, (W, H, round(s, 3), repr(sorted(fcfg.items()))), make, 4)



def _ink_box(spr):
    return spr.getchannel("A").point(lambda v: 255 if v > INK_THR else 0).getbbox()



def _pooled(spr, box):
    """Quarter-size ink mask of the sprite (cropped to its ink), grown by one cell so a placement that is not a multiple of 4 px stays safe."""
    a = spr.getchannel("A").crop(box).point(lambda v: 255 if v > INK_THR else 0)
    q = a.resize((max(1, (a.width + 3) // 4), max(1, (a.height + 3) // 4)), Image.BOX).point(lambda v: 255 if v > 0 else 0)
    padded = Image.new("L", (q.width + 2, q.height + 2), 0)             # 1 cell of room on every side, then grow by 1 cell
    padded.paste(q, (1, 1))
    return padded.filter(ImageFilter.MaxFilter(3))



def _place(spr, anchor, W, H, s, inx, iny, fm, label):
    """Item centre for `spr` anchored at a corner -> (cx, cy, ink rect on the canvas, moved px) or None for an empty sprite.
    Ink at the 48 px safe margin (+ inset); with a frame mask: moved vertically (down from the top, up from the bottom) until clear."""
    box = _ink_box(spr)
    if box is None:
        return None
    w, h = box[2] - box[0], box[3] - box[1]
    m = T4_SAFE * s
    sx = 1 if anchor.endswith("left") else -1 if anchor.endswith("right") else 0          # inward direction; 0 = centred on that axis
    sy = 1 if anchor.startswith("top") else -1 if anchor.startswith("bottom") else 0     # (the 4 corners behave exactly as before)
    x = m + inx * s if sx > 0 else W - m - inx * s - w if sx < 0 else (W - w) / 2.0
    y = m + iny * s if sy > 0 else H - m - iny * s - h if sy < 0 else (H - h) / 2.0
    x, y = int(round(min(max(x, m), W - m - w))), int(round(min(max(y, m), H - m - h)))
    moved = 0
    if fm is not None:
        dx, dy = _clear_shift(fm, _pooled(spr, box), x, y, sx, sy, W, H, s)
        if dx is None:
            t4_warn("%s: no free place next to the frame in the %s corner - kept at the safe margin." % (label, anchor))
        else:
            x, y, moved = x + dx, y + dy, abs(dx) + abs(dy)
    return x - box[0] + spr.width / 2.0, y - box[1] + spr.height / 2.0, (x, y, x + w, y + h), moved



def _clear_shift(fm, q, x, y, sx, sy, W, H, s):
    """Smallest inward shift (dx toward the canvas centre horizontally first, then dy vertically) that leaves the sprite clear of the
    frame mask -> (dx, dy), or (None, None). Rails run the full side height, so a horizontal step is tried before a vertical one."""
    step = max(2, int(round(4 * s)))
    nx, ny = int(180 * s) // step, int(H * 0.45) // step
    for c in range(0, nx + ny + 1):                                     # total shift in steps: the cheapest clear place wins
        for i in range(max(0, c - ny), min(c, nx) + 1):                 # i steps inward horizontally, c - i vertically
            dx, dy = i * step, (c - i) * step
            xx, yy = x + sx * dx, y + sy * dy
            if xx < 0 or yy < 0 or xx + q.width * 4 > W + 8 or yy + q.height * 4 > H + 8:
                continue
            if not _hits(fm, q, xx, yy):
                return sx * dx, sy * dy
    return None, None



def _font(path):
    if path and os.path.isfile(str(path)):
        return str(path)
    if path:
        t4_warn("t4 nameplate: font '%s' not found - using the default bold font." % Path(str(path)).name)
    p = t2_font("arabic", "ع")[0]
    return p if p and os.path.isfile(p) else default_font()



def _cues(cfg):
    out = []
    for c in caption_streams(cfg):
        try:
            out.append(parse_srt(c["srt"]))
        except Exception:
            continue
    return out



def _window(cfg, entry, label, duration, default_hold):
    return t4_time(dict(entry, label=label), _cues(cfg) if entry.get("trigger") else None, duration, default_hold)
